items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay xiisadda Magaalada Muqdisho
items.description: Xaaladda Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa aad u kacsan, iyadoo gelinkii dambe ee maanta illaa caawa ay ka dhaceen iska horimaadyo goos goos ah oo u dhaxeeyay Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwo taabacsan Siyaasiyiinta Mucaaradka ee ka tirsan Golaha Mustaqbalka Somaliya. Isku dhacyada ayaa imanaya, ka hor mudaaharaadka ay mucaaradku qorsheeyeen inay Khamiista ka dhigaan magaalada, kaas oo lagu diidan yahay muddo kororsiga Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Ex Raysal Wasaare Xasan Cali Khayre ayaa waxa uu ku sheegay taliska uu waqtigiisu dhamaaday ee Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu hoggaamiyo uu ku soo weeraray hoygiisa Muqdisho, iyagoo shir kula jira Ugaaska Beesha Murusade iyo Odayaasha Dhaqanka. Khayre ayaa wax ayaan darro ah ku sheegay in mar labaad caawa lagu soo weeraray hoygiisa, iyadoo ay nala joogaan buu yiri guddiga dhexdhexaadinta ee uu hoggaaminayo Ugaas Maxamuud Cali Ugaas. Wasaaradda Warfaafinta iyo Taliska Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed ayaa dhinacooda sheegay in maleeshiyaad ka amar qaata Xasan Cali Khayre ay weerareen ciidamada ka shaqeynaya nabadgelyada. Wariyeyaasha ka hawlgala Muqdisho ayaa soo sheegaya in Ciidamada Dowladda ay caawa caweyskii weerareen hoyga Shariif Sheekh Axmed, Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka uu ku leeyahay Degmada Cabdicasiis, waana wax yar uun ka dib, markii Shariifku uu ka digay in la soo weeraro, haddii kalena uu iska caabin doono. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in xabaddu ay istaagtay, isla-markaana ay ciidamadu ku sugan yihiin meel aan sidaasi uga fogayn hoyga Shariif Sheekh Axmed. Dhanka kale Saraakiisha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidamada Militariga ka soo saaray furimaha Gobolada Shabellaha Hoose iyo Shabellaha Dhexe, iyagoona isugu keenay bartamaha magaalada, kuwaas oo haatan lagu arkayo Waddada Maka Al Mukarama. Ciidamada laga soo saaray aagagga dagaalka ayaa waxaa qayb ka ah Ciidanka Kumaandooska Gorgor, waana markii ugu horreysay oo walaac amni oo ka jira Muqdisho awgeed loogu soo celiyo magaaladii ay sanado ka hor ka qalab qaateen. Dhaqdhaqaaqyadan ciidan ee ka jira magaalada ayaa xiisad baahsan ka huriyay gudaha caasimadda, wuxuuna qof walba oo reer Muqdisho uu isweydiinaya, waxa berrito dhici kara. Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ayaa maanta ogolaaday in bannaanbax nabadeed laga dhigi karo magaalada, iyagoona xididay in saddex goobood oo keliya lagu qaban karo, halka Siyaasiyiinta Mucaaradka ay doonayaan in ay bannaanbaxa ka qabtaan magaalada oo dhan. Dad u badan qoysas ayaa bilaabay inay ka barakacaan meelaha ay ku wada sugan yihiin ciidamada iska soo horjeeda. Waxaan oo dhan waxay imanayaan, iyadoo uu buuq xoog leh ka taagan yahay muddo dhaafka Madaxtooyada iyo Baarlamaanka, isla-markaana ay mucaaradku dalbanayaan in lagu heshiiyo nooc doorasho oo si dhakhsa ah dalka looga qaban karo.

items.title: Shariif oo si adag u hanjabay: Ninkii xabad igu soo rida xabad baa ku ridaya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed ayaa si adag uga hadlay weerar uu sheegay inay ku soo qaadeen ciidamada dowladda, xilli ay kasii dareyso xiisadda siyaasadeed ee dalka. Sheekh Shariif ayaa si cad u sheegay inuu is-difaacayo, isla markaana uu xabbad ku ridi doono cid kasta oo xabbad ku soo ridda, isagoo intaas ku daray inuusan mar dambe ka aamusi doonin falalka uu ku tilmaamay kuwa guracan ee lagu bartilmaameedsanayo. “Saraakiisha ciidanka iyo ciidamada qalabka sida su’aashan ayaan rabaa inaan weydiiyo: Madaxweynaha waqtigiisii waa dhammaaday, annagana dambi ma gelin. Maxaa keenaya in nala cabsi-geliyo oo ciidan nalagu hareereeyo? Maxaad sidaas u sameyneysaan? Ma mushaarka dartii mise sharciga ayaa idin faraya? Arrintaas ayaan rabaa inaan fahmo,” ayuu yiri Sheekh Shariif. Sidoo kale, wuxuu sheegay inaysan marnaba carari doonin, haddii Xasan Sheekh iyo ciidamadiisu u maleynayaan in mucaaradku cararayo marka la weeraro, sida uu hadalka u dhigay madaxweynihii hore. “Habeen iyo maalin dad ayuu noo soo dirayaa, iyadoo dadkii uu noo soo diray nala fadhiyaan ayaa haddana la leeyahay ciidan ayaa la keenay,” ayuu yiri Sheekh Shariif, oo sheegay in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu mar kasta mucaaradka u soo dirayo ergo aanu daacad ka ahayn. Hadalka Sheekh Shariif ayaa yimid kadib iska horimaad ka dhacay agagaarka bar koontarool oo ku dhow hoyga uu ka degan yahay xeebta Liido, kaas oo dhexmaray ciidamo ka tirsan dowladda iyo kuwa ilaaladiisa. Iska horimaadka oo socday muddo kooban ayaa waxaa la maqlayay rasaas culus, iyadoo daqiiqado gudahood ay xaaladdu noqotay mid deggan. Dagaalkan ayaa ku billowday si kedis ah oo aan la fileyn. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sidoo kale ciidamo xooggan oo ku hubeysan gaadiidka dagaalka iyo hubka culus dhigtay waddooyinka gala guriga uu Sheekh Shariif ka degan yahay xeebta Liido, gaar ahaan agagaarka gurigii madaxweynihii hore Cali Mahdi Maxamed. Ciidamadan ayaa xiray waddooyinka, waxayna gaadiidka iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada kale ka hor istaageen inay maraan, taas oo culeys ku noqotay Sheekh Shariif, maadaama la xaddiday isu socodka dadka iyo gaadiidka ku sii jeeda hoygiisa. Sidoo kale, qeybo kale oo ka mid ah magaalada ayaa la geeyay ciidamo xooggan oo xiray waddooyin, isla markaana xaddidaya isu socodka gaadiidka. Ciidamo ka tirsan booliska ayaa galabta dagaal muddo socday ku galay bar koontarool oo ay ku lahaayeen aagga uu degan yahay ra’iisul wasaarihii hore Xasan Cali Kheyre. Taliska Booliska Soomaaliyeed ayaa sheegay in kooxo maleeshiyaad abaabulan ay weerareen bartaas koontarool, halkaas oo boolisku ku sugayay amniga. Guud ahaan, xaaladda magaalada Muqdisho ayaa xilligan ah mid laga dareemayo xiisad iyo kacsanaan, iyadoo dadku ay ka cabsi qabaan in gacan-ka-hadalka uu intaas ka sii ballaarto. items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo ka hadashay dagaalkii maanta ka dhacay Muqdisho
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay si adag u cambaareyneysay dhacdadii nasiib-darrada ahayd ee galabta ka dhacday degmada Howlwadaag ee Gobolka Banaadir, taas oo ay ku lug lahaayeen maleeshiyaad hubeysan oo wejiyada soo duubtay, Kuwaasoo uu soo abaabulay Raiisul wasaare hore Xasan Cali Khayre. Maleeshiyaadkan oo ku hubeysan hub culus ayaa si toos ah u beegsaday xarun ay leeyihiin Ciidanka Booliska ee saldhigga degmada Howlwadaag, taasoo xalay fiidkii uu ku soo daabulay maleeshiyaadkan, waxaana nasiib darro ah in maleeshiyaadkaas ay hubka culus ee ay wateen ku garaaceen xaafado ay degan yihiin dad shacab ah. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay mar kale ku celinaysay in aan la aqbali doonin isku day kasta oo lagu wiiqayo amniga caasimadda, lagu carqaladeynayo shaqada ciidamada ammaanka, ama lagu abuurayo cabsi iyo qalalaase. Hay’adaha amnigu waxay bilaabeen baaritaan rasmi ah oo la xiriira fal dambiyeedkan, si tallaabo sharciga waafaqsan looga qaado cid kasta oo ku lug yeelata. Ugu dambeyn Dowladda Federaalka Waxay uga mahadcelineysay shacabka Soomaaliyeed wadashaqeynta wanaagsan ee ay la leeyihiin hey’adaha Amniga, waxayna ugu baaqeysay dowladdu inay sii laba-laabaan dadaalkooda si wadajir loogu hortago fal kasta oo carqaladeyn kara degegaanshaha iyo nabadgelyada ka jirta Caasimadda Muqdisho.

items.title: Gunfire erupts in Mogadishu before protests against Somali president’s rule
items.description: Heavy gunfire has broken out in central Mogadishu as Somalia’s former Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire says he has been attacked by government forces before planned protests. “An attack was launched against us by forces commanded by the president whose term has expired,” Khaire said in a social media post on Wednesday, adding they had been preparing for a “peaceful demonstration” the following day. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud “bears full responsibility for today’s violent attack on our consultative meeting”, he said . Somalia has fallen into yet another political crisis after Mohamud announced that his term had been extended for a year after it was due to expire on May 15. The opposition and regional leaders have rejected the move and demonstrations were due to take place on Thursday. Khaire relocated from his base in the heavily fortified green zone around the airport to his residence in the city, in order to take part in the protests. RPGs, gunshots An AFP news agency journalist filmed images of panicked residents in the Howl Wadaag district near his home, with loud gunshots heard in the background. Witnesses told AFP they saw armed opposition forces clashing with Somali police. “The shooting lasted for about 15 minutes before it subsided. They even used RPGs [rocket-propelled grenades], and the sound of the explosions could be heard across the surrounding neighbourhoods,” said one witness, Saleban Mahad. The president has been attempting to move Somalia towards democratic elections, replacing a system based around clan elders. Mohamud argues he was given an extra year in the presidency when a new constitution was passed by parliament in March that set the framework for polls. But with the country deeply divided between rival clans, and much of it under the control of al-Shabab, an al-Qaeda-linked armed group, there has been little progress on organising elections beyond a few localised pockets. Opposition and regional leaders have strongly opposed Mohamud’s plan, seeing it as an attempt to centralise power. Foreign powers, primarily the United States and the United Kingdom, have attempted to broker talks between the government and opposition to little avail. Reaction to attack on Khaire Ex-President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed has also moved into central Mogadishu for Thursday’s protest. He criticised the attack on Khaire, saying the president “seeks to cause further bloodshed despite not having a legitimate official mandate – his time has expired”. “This attack will not stop the demonstrations by residents of the capital who are protesting against injustice, displacement, and the abuse of government power,” he said on X. Previous presidents have also stayed in office beyond their mandates. Former President Mohamed Abdullahi Farmaajo stayed more than a year in office after the official end of his mandate in 2021, triggering violence and condemnation from the international community. Al Jazeera.

items.title: Dedaallo Nabadeed oo socda iyo Imaamka iyo Ugaaska Mudulood oo Kulan Degdeg ah la Leh Ugaaska Murusade iyo Xasan Cali Kheyre
items.description: MUQDISHO, Goobjoog – Kulan xasaasi ah oo daba-jooga dhacdooyinkii maanta ayaa caasimadda Muqdisho uga socda wafdi ballaran oo odayaal dhaqameed ah, kuwaas oo uu hoggaaminayo Imaamka Beelaha Mudulood, Imaam Daahir Imaam Cumar, iyadoo uu qeyb ka yahay Ugaaska Mudulood, Ugaas Maxamuud Cali Ugaas. Wafdigan dhaqanka ayaa xaruntiisa ku booqday Ugaaska Beesha Murusade, Ugaas Cabdillaahi Maxamed Cali, ayadoo kulanka ay qeyb ka yihiin odayaal dhaqameed iyo siyaasiyiin miisaan leh oo uu ka mid yahay Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Cali Kheyre. Ujeeddada ugu weyn ee kulankan degdegga ah ayaa lagu sheegay inay tahay sidii loo qaboojin lahaa xiisaddii siyaasadeed iyo tii amni ee maanta ka dhacday degmada Howlwadaag ee gobolka Banaadir, loona helari lahaa is-afgarad buuxa oo lagu ilaalinayo xasiloonida caasimadda. Dhaqdhaqaaqan oo ay hormuudka u yihiin hoggaanka dhaqanka ugu sarreeya ee deegaanka ayaa muujinaya dedaal weyn oo loogu jiro in lagu xakameeyo wixii isku-dhac ah, iyadoo la adeegsanayo hab-dhaqameedka nabadeynta Soomaaliyeed.

items.title: Somalia: Gun battles erupt in Mogadishu after raid on ex-PM’s home
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Heavy gun battles erupted in Somalia’s capital on Wednesday after federal government forces launched an assault on the residence of prominent opposition figure and former Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire, sparking fears of a descent into protracted civil conflict. The afternoon clashes in Mogadishu’s central Howlwadag district followed a tense 24-hour military buildup by both administration forces and powerful clan militias aligned with the political opposition. The flare-up comes on the eve of mass anti-government demonstrations scheduled for Thursday, which opposition leaders vow to push ahead with despite the outbreak of hostilities. The violence represents the most severe domestic political crisis facing President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration, mirroring the volatile street battles of 2021 that previously pushed the Horn of Africa nation to the brink of fragmentation. Security sources said the government raid was triggered by the circulation of social media images showing heavily armed, masked opposition fighters patrolling strategic arteries in the capital earlier in the day. The state security apparatus viewed the deployment as an unacceptable provocation and an attempt to establish parallel control over municipal sectors. Khaire, who served as prime minister between 2017 and 2020, confirmed the attack via a social media statement, asserting that federal troops targeted his compound while he was convening a high-level meeting with the traditional chief of the influential Murursade clan. Khaire reported that the ensuing firefight resulted in multiple casualties, though precise figures could not be immediately verified independently. He placed the legal and moral culpability for the bloodshed directly on the presidency. The political opposition, unified under an umbrella framework, has positioned armed units across various northern and southern neighborhoods of Mogadishu. Some opposition-aligned technicals – pickup trucks mounted with heavy weaponry – were reported within striking distance of the heavily fortified presidential palace, Villa Somalia. Former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed, who currently leads the opposition coalition, issued a strongly worded condemnation of the military operation. Ahmed characterized the assault as a desperate bid by the incumbent to cling to authority through state-sponsored violence. The opposition maintains that the president’s mandate has effectively expired, rendering his administration illegitimate. The impending protests are driven by deep-seated grievances surrounding allegations of state-sanctioned land grabs, forced displacements, and institutional abuses of power. Opposition strategists altered their tactical approach following a botched demonstration attempt last month, when federal forces successfully neutralized the movement by placing opposition leaders under siege and erecting stone barricades around their residences. By dispersing armed loyalists across decentralized sectors this week, the opposition sought to prevent another tactical encirclement by state forces. The current militarization of Mogadishu heavily undercuts decades of international state-building efforts. Foreign donors, including the United States, the European Union, and international bodies, have invested billions of dollars in professionalizing Somalia’s security architecture and fostering democratic transitions. The visual layout of the current crisis bears an unsettling resemblance to the political impasse of April 2021. At that time, former President Mohamed Abdullahi Farmajo’s attempts to extend his term triggered a mutiny within the armed forces along clan lines, dividing the capital into hostile sectors. That crisis was ultimately defused through intense diplomatic intervention and a subsequent indirect electoral process that brought the current president to power. Ironically, Mohamud was a key opposition figure during that period, utilizing similar armed resistance to check presidential overreach. Analysts in the region warn that without immediate de-escalation and high-level mediation, the skirmishes could catalyze a broader clan-based conflagration. The federal government has defended its deployment as a necessary measure to maintain public order and prevent unauthorized armed groups from paralyzing the capital. However, with both factions deeply entrenched and refusing to yield ground, the fragile stability of Mogadishu remains highly compromised ahead of the planned demonstrations. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

That crisis was ultimately defused through intense diplomatic intervention and a subsequent indirect electoral process that brought the current president to power. Ironically, Mohamud was a key opposition figure during that period, utilizing similar armed resistance to check presidential overreach. Analysts in the region warn that without immediate de-escalation and high-level mediation, the skirmishes could catalyze a broader clan-based conflagration. The federal government has defended its deployment as a necessary measure to maintain public order and prevent unauthorized armed groups from paralyzing the capital. However, with both factions deeply entrenched and refusing to yield ground, the fragile stability of Mogadishu remains highly compromised ahead of the planned demonstrations. items.title: Ethiopia’s Predictable Election: Democracy by Appointment
items.description: By Abdikarim H. Abdi Buh The election held in Ethiopia on June 2, 2026, produced what may be the least surprising political result in the Horn of Africa this year. Long before the first ballot was cast, before polling stations opened, and before election officials began counting votes, most Ethiopians already knew who would emerge victorious: Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed and his ruling Prosperity Party. That certainty says less about the popularity of the government than it does about the nature of Ethiopian politics itself.For decades, Ethiopia has held elections. What it has struggled to hold is an election in which power genuinely appeared at risk of changing hands. The latest vote unfolded against the backdrop of armed conflict, political unrest, economic hardship, and deep national divisions. Large portions of the country were either partially excluded from the process or affected by security conditions that made meaningful participation difficult. Yet despite these extraordinary circumstances, the outcome remained almost universally predictable. To understand why, one must look beyond the current government and examine the political traditions inherited from Ethiopia’s modern ruling elite. A Long Tradition of Predetermined Outcomes Ethiopia’s history of elections has often been characterized less by competition than by confirmation. During the era of the military Derg regime under Mengistu Haile Mariam, elections existed primarily as instruments of state authority. The ruling communist establishment viewed political pluralism not as a strength but as a threat. Opposition was suppressed, dissent was criminalized, and the state monopolized political life. When the Derg collapsed in 1991, many Ethiopians hoped the arrival of the Ethiopian People’s Revolutionary Democratic Front (EPRDF) would usher in a new democratic era. Initially, the EPRDF presented itself as a coalition committed to federalism, political participation, and national reconstruction. Under the leadership of Meles Zenawi, the government introduced economic reforms that transformed parts of the country and delivered years of impressive economic growth. Yet while the economy modernized, political competition remained tightly controlled.The EPRDF perfected a system that combined elections with overwhelming dominance. Opposition parties were permitted to exist, but rarely on equal terms. State institutions, security structures, and political networks remained firmly under the control of the ruling establishment. The most striking example came during the 2015 elections when the EPRDF and its allies claimed 100 percent of parliamentary seats. While such a result might be impressive in a one-party state, it raised obvious questions in a country officially described as a multiparty democracy. The Prosperity Party Inherits the System When Abiy Ahmed rose to power in 2018, he was initially celebrated as a reformer. Political prisoners were released. Exiled opposition figures returned home. Media restrictions were eased. The Prime Minister received international acclaim and was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for his role in ending the long-standing conflict with Eritrea. Many believed Ethiopia was finally moving toward genuine democratic competition. But optimism gradually gave way to reality. The EPRDF was dissolved and replaced by the Prosperity Party. Officially, the new party was presented as a vehicle for national unity. Critics, however, argued that the change amounted to a rebranding exercise rather than a fundamental transformation of Ethiopia’s political culture. The structures changed. The concentration of power did not. Today, many opposition figures argue that the Prosperity Party inherited the habits of its predecessors while adopting the language of reform. An Election Missing Large Parts of the Country The latest election illustrates that contradiction. All of Tigray remain politically and socially scarred by one of Africa’s deadliest wars in recent decades. The conflict displaced millions, devastated infrastructure, and left deep wounds that remain far from healed. Despite repeated calls from international actors for dialogue, the war continued for years before a fragile settlement emerged. Meanwhile, violence continues to affect significant areas of Amhara and Oromia. In Amhara, clashes involving armed groups and federal forces have destabilized large portions of the region. In Oromia, Ethiopia’s largest region, security operations and insurgent activity continue to disrupt normal life in many districts. As a result, election authorities themselves acknowledged that numerous polling stations could not operate because of security concerns. Yet somehow, despite these extraordinary obstacles, confidence in the final result remained absolute. Not confidence in the process. Confidence in the winner. Opposition Without Threat Perhaps the most fascinating aspect of Ethiopian politics is the relationship between the ruling party and its opposition. Officially, Ethiopia remains a multiparty democracy. In practice, critics argue that many opposition groups lack the resources, access, organizational capacity, or political space necessary to challenge the ruling establishment effectively. Some opposition parties are fragmented. Others face internal divisions. Some operate under severe political constraints. The result is an electoral landscape in which competition often appears symbolic rather than transformative. Skeptics frequently joke that Ethiopia’s opposition exists primarily to demonstrate that opposition exists. The Prosperity Party, meanwhile, enjoys the advantages of incumbency, state infrastructure, administrative reach, and nationwide organizational networks. That does not guarantee victory. But it certainly improves the odds. The Curious Mechanics of Election Day Election day itself provided several moments of unintended comedy.Officials announced that approximately 40 million of Ethiopia’s 54 million registered voters were expected to participate. Later, turnout estimates were compiled using information collected through telephone calls from local officials. Communication failures delayed reporting from numerous areas. Some polling stations closed at the scheduled time. Others remained open hours later. In certain locations, voting reportedly continued until midnight—six hours after the official closing time. Election officials also acknowledged irregularities. In one location, polling was suspended after authorities discovered election workers allegedly marking ballots themselves. The revelation raised uncomfortable questions. If election workers were caught filling out ballots in one polling station, what guarantees exist regarding polling stations where no one was caught? Authorities promised investigations. Observers have heard similar promises before. Democracy as Performance The broader issue extends beyond one election. The problem is not whether the Prosperity Party enjoys genuine support among segments of the population. It undoubtedly does. The question is whether Ethiopian elections are structured in a manner capable of producing an outcome the ruling party does not want. Many citizens increasingly believe the answer is no. This perception is damaging because legitimacy ultimately depends not only on victory but also on public confidence that defeat was possible. When elections become exercises in confirming expectations rather than testing them, democracy risks becoming political theater. The Predictable Ending By the time the final votes are counted, Ethiopia will almost certainly have a winner. What remains uncertain is whether the election will strengthen confidence in the country’s democratic institutions or deepen existing skepticism. For now, the verdict of many Ethiopians appears straightforward. The names of the candidates may change. The slogans may change. The parties may change—from the communist era, to the EPRDF, to the Prosperity Party. But the outcome, they say, remains remarkably consistent. In Ethiopia, elections often feel less like contests for power and more like ceremonies confirming decisions that were already made long before the first voter arrived at the ballot box. Abdikarim H. items.title: Odowaa oo si kulul uga hadlay weerarkii Kheyre: Xasan damicii ayaa indho tiray
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaan Cabdiraxmaan Odowaa ayaa si adag uga hadlay dagaalkii galabta ka dhacay degmada Hawl-wadaag, kaas oo u dhexeeyay ciidamada dowladda iyo ciidamada ilaalada u ah Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Cali Kheyre. Odowaa ayaa Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh dusha u saaray mas’uuliyadda weerarkii galabta, isagoo sheegay in tallaabadan ay caddeyn u tahay sida uu damiciisa kursiga uga indho tiray xaaladda taagan. “Weerarka galabta uu soo qaaday Madaxweynaha waqtigiisu dhammaaday waxa uu daliil u yahay in damaciisu indha tiray, diyaarna u yahay dadka u laayo muddo kororsiga gardarrada ah ee uu kaligiis wato,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Cabdiraxmaan Odowaa. Waxa uu intaas ku sii daray: “Wixii soo gaara ugaaska beesha Murusade, madaxda halkaas joogta iyo shacabkaba waxaa mas’uuliyaddeeda qaadaya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud.” Odowaa iyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo hore saaxiibo dhow u ahaa ayaa isku khilaafay hanaanka doorashooyinka dalka iyo wax ka beddelka dastuurka, kadib markii madaxweynuhu ku adkeystay in dastuurka cusub uu dhaqan-gal yahay. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa doonaya in dalka laga qabto doorasho qof iyo cod ah, taas oo hore uga dhacday gobolka Banaadir iyo dowlad-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, isla markaana uu haatan doonayo in maamullada kale lagu soo doorto hanaankaas, iyadoo muran badan uu ka taagan yahay. Madaxweynaha oo dhowr jeer sheegay inuu diyaar u yahay inuu la fariisto mucaaradka ayaan weli wax tanaasul ah ka muujin qorshihiisa doorashooyinka, taas oo sii adkaysay xaaladda murugsan ee siyaasadeed. Si kastaba, xiisaddan oo haatan u muuqata inay isu rogtay gacan-ka-hadal ayay si weyn uga digaysaa beesha caalamka, oo dooneysa in la gaaro xal loo dhan yahay, isla markaana marxaladda kala-guurka ah looga gudbo doorasho ay dhinacyadu ku wada qanacsan yihiin. items.title: The opposition remains firm: Somalia’s Political Crisis Enters Dangerous New Phase
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN)- Former President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, whose constitutional term has expired, appears to have reverted to a familiar political playbook: dispatching emissaries to engage the opposition while showing little willingness to compromise on the issues at the heart of Somalia’s political crisis. Opposition figures argue that Hassan Sheikh’s approach has remained unchanged throughout the standoff. While publicly calling for dialogue, they contend that his position has consistently been that others must concede accepting his term extension, the constitutional changes he championed, and the electoral framework and election commission established under his administration. Critics describe a leader unwilling to make the concessions necessary to break the political deadlock. They point to several previous rounds of talks with opposition leaders, as well as separate mediation efforts involving Somali elders and influential members of the Abgaal community, all of which reportedly ended without tangible results. Those who participated in the discussions have frequently complained that negotiations with Hassan Sheikh yielded little progress, describing him as deeply resistant to compromise. According to sources, a delegation reportedly sent from Villa Somalia arrived at the residence of former President Sheikh Sharif Sheikh Ahmed in Muqdisho’s Marina neighborhood in an effort to ease mounting tensions. The delegation was led by Mudulood traditional elder Ugaas Mahmoud Ali Ugaas and included several known political intermediaries who have often played mediation roles during periods of national crisis. Among those reportedly involved were MP Yusuf Geele Ugaas and Cabdi Axmed Dhuxulow (Dhagdheer). The delegation also held lengthy discussions with former Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire and a number of opposition lawmakers, including MP Mohamed Abukar Ali “Jaafar.” And MP Abdullahi Mohamed Ali (Sanbaloolshe). Sources close to the meetings claim that Khaire and the opposition figures present adopted a firm position, insisting that meaningful negotiations cannot proceed unless Hassan Sheikh first abandons what they describe as his unilateral political agenda and accepts a genuinely inclusive national dialogue. The talks reportedly failed to make progress on the Khaire side, prompting the delegation to continue its efforts with former President Sheikh Sharif. As of now, no official outcome has emerged from the discussions with Sharif. However, sources indicate that before the delegation’s arrival, the former president had already signaled skepticism toward mediation efforts led by individuals he reportedly views as political brokers acting on behalf of Hassan Sheikh. According to those sources, Sharif’s position is that any serious negotiations must begin with what he considers a reversal of the current political impasse. He is said to have argued that meaningful dialogue can only occur after Hassan Sheikh relinquishes what the opposition characterizes as an unconstitutional extension of his stay in Villa Somalia and accepts a negotiated political settlement. Whether these latest mediation efforts can succeed where previous initiatives have failed remains uncertain. What is clear is that Somalia’s political crisis continues to deepen, with trust between the government and opposition at one of its lowest points in recent years and neither side showing signs of backing down. items.title: Madaxweyne Cirro oo wafti Maraykan ah ku qaabilay Madaxtooyada Somaliland
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa maanta Qasriga Madaxtooyada JSL ku qaabilay wefti uu hoggaaminayo Ku-xigeenka Safiirka Maraykanka ahna ku-simaha, Mudane Justin Davis iyo wefti uu hoggaaminayo, kuwaasi oo booqasho rasmi ah ku yimid Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Madaxweynaha ayaa ugu horrayn weftiga uga mahad naqay booqashada iyo xiisaha sii kordhaya ee ay Dawladda Maraykanku u muujisay Somaliland. Kulanka waxa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xidhiidhka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo Dawladda Maraykanka, gaar ahaan xagga arrimaha amniga gobolka, amniga marin-biyoodka Badda Cas, xog-isdhaafiga, kobcinta fursadaha maalgashi, horumarinta dhaqaalaha, dimuqraadiyadda iyo adkaynta danaha istaraatiijiga ah ee ay wadaagaan labada dhinac. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu Dawladda Maraykanka uga mahad naqay Hindiseyaasha Sharci iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada Siyaasiga ah ee ka dhex socda Goleyaasha Sharci-dejinta Maraykanka, kuwaasi oo si toos ah u khuseeya arrimaha Somaliland. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu Ku-xigeenka Safiirka Maraykanka u xaqiijiyey in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay tahay dal nabad ah, dimuqraadi ah, xasilloon oo ah saaxiib ay Dawladda Maraykanku isku hallayn karto. Isaguna dhankiisa, Ku-xigeenka Safiirka Dawladda Maraykanka ayaa Madaxweynaha iyo Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ku bogaadiyey nabadda, xasilloonida iyo hannaanka dimuqraadiga ah ee ka hana qaaday Somaliland. Waxa uu xaqiijiyey in Dawladda Maraykanku ay diyaar u tahay xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga, difaaca, amniga badda, xog-isdhaafsiga, maalgashiga, ganacsiga, kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha, macdanta iyo tamarta. Sidoo kale, Danjire Justin Davis waxa uu carrabka ku adkeeyey in aan la iska indho-tiri karin xaqiiqada dhabta ah, horumarka iyo doorka istaraatiijiga ah ee ay Somaliland ku leedahay gobolka Geeska Afrika. Kulankan ayaa waxa uu ka tarjumayaa xidhiidhka sii adkaanaya ee u dhexeeya Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo Maraykanka iyo dedaallada ay Somaliland ku horumarinayso iskaashi diblomaasiyadeed, mid amni iyo dhaqaale oo ay la yeelato Maraykanka kaasi oo ku dhisan ixtiraam, dano-wadaag iyo is-faham dhinacyo badan leh.

Madaxweynuhu waxa uu Ku-xigeenka Safiirka Maraykanka u xaqiijiyey in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay tahay dal nabad ah, dimuqraadi ah, xasilloon oo ah saaxiib ay Dawladda Maraykanku isku hallayn karto. Isaguna dhankiisa, Ku-xigeenka Safiirka Dawladda Maraykanka ayaa Madaxweynaha iyo Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ku bogaadiyey nabadda, xasilloonida iyo hannaanka dimuqraadiga ah ee ka hana qaaday Somaliland. Waxa uu xaqiijiyey in Dawladda Maraykanku ay diyaar u tahay xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga, difaaca, amniga badda, xog-isdhaafsiga, maalgashiga, ganacsiga, kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha, macdanta iyo tamarta. Sidoo kale, Danjire Justin Davis waxa uu carrabka ku adkeeyey in aan la iska indho-tiri karin xaqiiqada dhabta ah, horumarka iyo doorka istaraatiijiga ah ee ay Somaliland ku leedahay gobolka Geeska Afrika. Kulankan ayaa waxa uu ka tarjumayaa xidhiidhka sii adkaanaya ee u dhexeeya Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo Maraykanka iyo dedaallada ay Somaliland ku horumarinayso iskaashi diblomaasiyadeed, mid amni iyo dhaqaale oo ay la yeelato Maraykanka kaasi oo ku dhisan ixtiraam, dano-wadaag iyo is-faham dhinacyo badan leh.

items.title: RW Kheyre ” taliska uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweynaha waqtigiisu dhammaaday ayaa nasoo weeraray”
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Ra’iisul wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya Xasan Cali Kheyre, ayaa ka hadlay dagaalkii galabta ka dhacay Muqdisho, isaga oo sheegay in lasoo weeraray asiga iyo Ugaaska Beesha Mursade. Kheyre ayaa tilmaamay in weerarkaasi uu ahaa isku day lagu doonayay in lagu dilo isaga iyo Ugaas Cabdirisaaq. “Waxaa annaga oo shir kula jirna ugaaska beesha Murusade iyo odayaasha dhaqanka weerar nagu soo qaaday taliska uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweynaha waqtigiisu dhammaaday. Waxaan Alle ka baryayaa in uu u naxariisto intii ku dhimatay, una boogadhayo intii ku dhaawacantay.” Ayuu yiri Kheyre. Sidoo kale Kheyre, ayaa sheegay in khasaaro kasta oo ka dhasha falkan uu mas’uuliyadiisa qaadan doono madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. “Khasaaro kasta oo ka dhasha falkan waxaa masuuliyaddiisa qaadaya Madaxweynaha waqtigiisu dhammaaday oo na soo weeraray annaga oo diyaargarow ugu jirna bannaanbaxa nabadeed ee berri noo madlan.” Ayuu yiri Ra’iisul wasaare Kheyre. Waxaa sii kordhay xiisada siyaasadeed ee dalka sacaadihii lasoo dhaafay, iyada oo mucaaradka ay bilaabeen dhoolatus ciidan oo ku doonayay in si xoog ah ay Banaanbaxa uga qabtaan Muqdisho. Wararkii ugu dambeeyay ayaa sheegaya in xaalada ay hadda deggan tahay, isla markaana mucaaradka ay wadaan dhaq-dhaqaaq ciidan iyaga oo ka arrinsanaya qorshahooda ku aadan banaanbaxa Berri. items.title: Booliska Soomaaliya oo Faahfaahin Ka Bixiyey Is-rasaaseyntii Ka Dhacday Degmada Howl-wadaag
items.description: Afhayeenka Ciidanka Boliiska Soomaaliyeed ayaa ka warbixiyey dhacdadii galabta ka dhacday degmada Howl-wadaag ee magaalada Muqdisho, halkaas oo ay ka dhacday is-rasaaseyn dhalisay walaac amni. Shir jaraa’id oo uu qabtay afhayeenka Boolisku ayuu ku sheegey in ciidamada ammaanka lagu weeraray xilli ay ku guda jireen waajibaadkooda qaran ee sugidda amniga iyo ilaalinta shacabka. Booliska ayaa sheegay in ciidamada ay si degdeg ah uga jawaabeen weerarkaasi, islamarkaana ay qaadeen tallaabooyin sharci ah oo ka dhan ah waxa ay ku tilmaameen koox u abaabulan qaab ka hor imaanaya amniga iyo xasilloonida dalka. Afhayeenka Boliiska ayaa xusay in ciidamada ammaanku ay sii wadi doonaan gudashada waajibaadkooda dastuuriga ah, isagoo carrabka ku adkeeyey in aan loo dulqaadan doonin fal kasta oo khatar ku ah nabadgelyada shacabka iyo hay’adaha dowladda. Dhacdadan ayaa timid kaddib markii galinkii dambe ee maanta ay soo baxeen warar ku saabsan iska horimaad hubeysan oo ka dhacay degmada Howl-wadaag, kaas oo ku lug lahaa ciidamo kala duwan. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaan weli faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka bixin sababaha rasmiga ah ee keenay isku dhaca, hase yeeshee war-saxaafadeedka Booliska ayaa muujinaya dhacdada loo dhigay ama loo yeelay fasiraad amni iyo tallaabooyin sharci oo ay ciidamada qaadeen.

items.title: Daawo: Booliska oo war kasoo saaray dagaalkii galabta ka dhacay Howl-wadaag
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliska Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed ayaa ka hadlay iska horimaad galabta ka dhacay degmada Howlwadaag ee magaalada Muqdisho, gaar ahaan agagaarka hoyga uu degmadaas ka degan yahay Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Cali Kheyre. Dagaalka ayaa sababay dhimasho, dhaawac iyo cabsi xooggan oo soo wajahday dadka shacabka ah ee ku nool xaafadaha ku dhow goobta uu iska horimaadku ka dhacay. Afhayeenka Booliska Soomaaliyeed, G/le Cabdifataax Aadan Xasan, oo qabtay shir jaraa’id oo degdeg ah, ayaa sheegay in dagaalku bilowday kadib markii kooxo uu ku tilmaamay “maleeshiyaad hubeysan” ay weerar ku qaadeen bar-kantarool ay ku sugnaayeen ciidamada booliska. “Taliska Booliska Soomaaliyeed wuxuu u caddeynayaa bulshada Soomaaliyeed in galabta 5:00 galabnimo, ciidanka booliska oo gudanaya waajibaadkiisa shaqo, kuna sugnaa bar-kantarool, ay soo weerareen koox maleeshiyaad ah oo u abaabulan qaab lid ku ah nabadgelyada ummadda Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu yiri Afhayeenka Booliska. Wuxuu sheegay in ciidamada booliska ay ka jawaabeen weerarkaasi, isla markaana ay qaadeen tallaabo uu ku sheegay mid sharciga waafaqsan. “Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed oo gudanaya waajibaadkiisa shaqo ayaa ka jawaabay falkii guracnaa ee maleeshiyaadkaasi kusoo weerareen. Boolisku tallaabo sharciga waafaqsan ayuu ka qaaday kooxihii weerarka kusoo qaaday goobtaas,” ayuu yiri Cabdifataax Aadan Xasan. Afhayeenka ayaa intaas ku daray in kooxihii weerarka qaaday aysan u kala soocin ciidamada ammaanka iyo dadka shacabka ah, taas oo uu sheegay inay muujineyso in ujeedkoodu ahaa carqaladeynta amniga magaalada Muqdisho. Sidoo kale, wuxuu sheegay in wixii galabta dhacay looga gol lahaa in lagu qalqal geliyo nabadgelyada caasimadda, xilli uu sheegay in Muqdisho ay muddooyinkii dambe ka nasatay falal amni darro oo ay geysan jireen kooxaha argagixisada. Dagaalka galabta ayaa, sida ay wararku sheegayaan, dhexmaray ciidamada dowladda iyo ciidamo ilaalo u ah Xasan Cali Kheyre. Labada dhinac ayaa isu adeegsaday rasaas xooggan, taasoo cabsi gelisay dadka ku nool xaafadaha ku dhow halka uu iska horimaadku ka socday. Xasan Cali Kheyre ayaa dhankiisa sheegay in isaga iyo Ugaaska beesha Murusade la geliyay xaalad halis ah, xilli uu kulan kula jiray odayaasha dhaqanka. Ma jiro war madax-bannaan oo si buuxda u xaqiijinaya khasaaraha rasmiga ah ee ka dhashay dagaalka. Afhayeenka Booliska ayaa sidoo kale digniin adag u diray dhinacyada siyaasadeed ee abaabulaya bannaanbax ay sheegeen inuu berri ka dhacayo magaalada Muqdisho, kaas oo looga soo horjeedo waxa mucaaradku ku tilmaamayaan muddo kororsi loo sameeyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. “Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed umadda Soomaaliyeed uguma wakiil aha la dagaallanka cudurrada faafa, balse waxay u jiraan ilaalinta nabadgelyada iyo kala dambeynta,” ayuu yiri Afhayeenka. Wuxuu intaas raaciyay: “Qof kasta ama koox kasta, magac kasta ha lahaadeene, haddii ay dhibaateynayaan nabadgelyada ummadda Soomaaliyeed, waxaa laga qaadayaa tallaabo sharciga waafaqsan.” Xaaladda magaalada Muqdisho ayaa caawa gashay jawi kacsan, iyadoo ciidamo badan oo dowladda ka tirsan lagu arkayo waddooyinka muhiimka ah iyo xaafadaha ay deggan yihiin qaar ka mid ah hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka. Isu socodka qeybo ka mid ah magaalada ayaa xaddidan, waxaana dadka shacabka ah soo food saaray cabsi iyo welwel la xiriira xiisadda siyaasadeed iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada ciidan ee ka socda caasimadda. Kooxaha mucaaradka ayaa doonaya inay maalinta berri ah dhigaan dibadbax ay uga soo horjeedaan muddo kororsiga ay ku eedeynayaan dowladda federaalka. Dowladda ayaa sheegtay inay ogolaatay in dibadbaxu ka dhaco saddex goobood oo cayiman, balse mucaaradka ayaa diiday xaddidaaddaas, iyagoo ku adkeysanaya in la siiyo xorriyad buuxda oo ay ku muujiyaan aragtidooda siyaasadeed. Xiisadda ayaa timid xilli khilaafka siyaasadeed ee ka dhashay arrimaha doorashooyinka iyo muddada xilka dowladda uu sii xoogeysanayo, waxaana dhacdadii Howlwadaag ay sare u qaaday cabsida laga qabo in muranka siyaasadeed uu isu beddelo xaalad amni oo ka ballaaran. items.title: Deadly Attack Ahead of Planned Demonstration Raises Fears of Escalating Political Violence in Somalia
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – In a statement posted on his X (formerly Twitter) account, former Somali Prime Minister Hassan Ali Kheyre said that an armed attack targeted a meeting he was holding with his traditional leader, resulting in deaths and injuries. The attack, which has intensified concerns over Somalia’s worsening political and security climate, reportedly caused multiple casualties, although the exact number of victims has not yet been officially disclosed. Kheyre directly accused former President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud of being behind the attack, stating that it was deliberately organized and orchestrated against opposition figures. The serious accusations come amid escalating political tensions and deepening divisions within Somalia’s leadership, raising fears of further instability and confrontation. The development comes just a day before a major opposition-led demonstration scheduled for June 4, an event that has already heightened political anxiety and prompted increased security deployments across the capital. Political tensions in Somalia’s capital escalated dramatically armed forces reportedly loyal to former Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire and Member of Parliament Jafar established positions in the vicinity of the Presidential Palace in Mogadishu’s Warta Nabada district. Sources familiar with the situation say Khaire has relocated from the Jazeera Hotel vicinity to an area close to Villa Somalia, where he is coordinating preparations for the planned protest. The move is being interpreted by political observers as a sign that opposition leaders are preparing for a prolonged political confrontation with the federal government. The government, meanwhile, has intensified security operations throughout Mogadishu. Security forces have increased patrols and established additional checkpoints in strategic locations as authorities seek to contain potential unrest ahead of the demonstration. The growing standoff reflects the deepening political divide between the opposition and the federal administration at a time when disagreements over governance, elections, and constitutional issues continue to dominate Somalia’s political landscape. According to reports, former President Sheikh Sharif also held consultations with prominent elders and community leaders from his Abgaal sub-clan. While the details of those discussions remain undisclosed, unconfirmed reports suggest the meetings focused on security concerns and the rapidly evolving political situation in the capital. Adding another layer to the unfolding drama, the former President Sheikh Sharif, has also recently received a camel from elders of his community in a symbolic ceremony that many interpreted as a public show of solidarity amid rising political tensions. The gesture evoked memories of the political crisis of 2021–2022, when former President Mohamed Abdullahi Farmaajo faced intense pressure from opposition groups following disputes over his extended tenure in office. Government officials have responded sharply to recent statements by opposition leaders. Deputy Minister of Information Abdirahman Yusuf Al-Adala criticized opposition figures, including Sheikh Sharif, Hassan Ali Khaire, and Abdirahman Abdishakur Warsame, accusing them of abandoning constructive political discourse in favor of inflammatory rhetoric. “It is deeply unfortunate that senior political figures from whom the public expected national vision and responsible leadership instead resorted to insults, accusations of apostasy, and threats,” Al-Adala wrote on social media. “Ironically, the same individuals now claim the government intends to harm them.” Al-Adala, alongside Defense Minister Ahmed Moallim Fiqi, has become one of the government’s most vocal defenders, frequently responding to criticism from opposition leaders and challenging their narrative regarding the country’s political crisis. As both sides harden their positions, Mogadishu is bracing for what could become one of the most consequential political showdowns in recent years. With opposition leaders mobilizing supporters and the government strengthening its security posture, all eyes are now on the capital ahead of Thursday’s planned demonstration. Whether the competing political camps can avoid confrontation and preserve stability remains one of the most pressing questions facing Somalia in the days ahead. Political tensions in Somalia’s capital escalated dramatically armed forces reportedly loyal to former Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire and Member of Parliament Jafar established positions in the vicinity of the Presidential Palace in Mogadishu’s Warta Nabada district. Sources familiar with the situation say Khaire has relocated from the Jazeera Hotel vicinity to an area close to Villa Somalia, where he is coordinating preparations for the planned protest. The move is being interpreted by political observers as a sign that opposition leaders are preparing for a prolonged political confrontation with the federal government. The government, meanwhile, has intensified security operations throughout Mogadishu. Security forces have increased patrols and established additional checkpoints in strategic locations as authorities seek to contain potential unrest ahead of the demonstration. The growing standoff reflects the deepening political divide between the opposition and the federal administration at a time when disagreements over governance, elections, and constitutional issues continue to dominate Somalia’s political landscape. According to reports, former President Sheikh Sharif also held consultations with prominent elders and community leaders from his Abgaal sub-clan. While the details of those discussions remain undisclosed, unconfirmed reports suggest the meetings focused on security concerns and the rapidly evolving political situation in the capital. Adding another layer to the unfolding drama, the former President Sheikh Sharif, has also recently received a camel from elders of his community in a symbolic ceremony that many interpreted as a public show of solidarity amid rising political tensions. The gesture evoked memories of the political crisis of 2021–2022, when former President Mohamed Abdullahi Farmaajo faced intense pressure from opposition groups following disputes over his extended tenure in office. Government officials have responded sharply to recent statements by opposition leaders. Deputy Minister of Information Abdirahman Yusuf Al-Adala criticized opposition figures, including Sheikh Sharif, Hassan Ali Khaire, and Abdirahman Abdishakur Warsame, accusing them of abandoning constructive political discourse in favor of inflammatory rhetoric. “It is deeply unfortunate that senior political figures from whom the public expected national vision and responsible leadership instead resorted to insults, accusations of apostasy, and threats,” Al-Adala wrote on social media. “Ironically, the same individuals now claim the government intends to harm them.” Al-Adala, alongside Defense Minister Ahmed Moallim Fiqi, has become one of the government’s most vocal defenders, frequently responding to criticism from opposition leaders and challenging their narrative regarding the country’s political crisis. As both sides harden their positions, Mogadishu is bracing for what could become one of the most consequential political showdowns in recent years. With opposition leaders mobilizing supporters and the government strengthening its security posture, all eyes are now on the capital ahead of Thursday’s planned demonstration. Whether the competing political camps can avoid confrontation and preserve stability remains one of the most pressing questions facing Somalia in the days ahead. items.title: Kheyre oo sheegay in isku-day dil ka badbaadeen isaga iyo Ugaaska Murusade
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Cali Kheyre oo ka hadlay dagaalkii galabta ka dhacay Muqdisho ayaa sheegay in la soo weeraray isaga iyo Ugaaska cusub ee beesha Murusade. Kheyre ayaa sheegay in weerarkaasi uu ahaa isku-day lagu doonayay in lagu dilo isaga iyo Ugaas Cabdirisaaq oo dhawaan la caleemo saaray. “Annaga oo shir kula jirna Ugaaska beesha Murusade iyo odayaasha dhaqanka ayaa waxaa weerar nagu soo qaaday ciidan ka amar qaata taliska uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweynaha waqtigiisu dhammaaday,” ayuu yiri Kheyre oo ka hadlay dagaalkii maanta. Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ayaa sheegay in khasaare kasta oo ka dhasha falkan ay mas’uuliyaddiisa qaadi doonto dowladda uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, oo uu ugu yeeray “Madaxweynaha waqtigiisu dhammaaday.” “Khasaare kasta oo ka dhasha falkan waxaa mas’uuliyaddiisa qaadaya Madaxweynaha waqtigiisu dhammaaday ee na soo weeraray annaga oo diyaargarow ugu jirna bannaanbaxa nabadeed ee berri noo muddaysan,” ayuu yiri Kheyre. Ugu dambeyn, wuxuu Alle uga baryay inuu u naxariisto dadkii ku dhintay iska horimaadka, isla markaana uu caafimaad degdeg ah siiyo kuwii ku dhaawacmay. Xiisadda siyaasadeed ee ka taagan Muqdisho ayaa sii korortay saacadihii u dambeeyay, iyadoo mucaaradku magaalada ku soo bandhigay awood ciidan, halka dhinaca kale ay socdaan dadaallo lagu doonayo in xaaladda lagu dejiyo wada-hadal. Siyaasiyiin iyo shaqsiyaad dhex-dhexaadinaya labada dhinac ayaa sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay diyaar u tahay wada-hadal, haddii mucaaradku ka laabto qorshaha bannaanbaxa isla markaana ay dib ugu noqdaan aagga xayndaabka garoonka diyaaradaha ee Muqdisho oo ay hore uga soo guureen. Hase yeeshee, hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka ayaa ku adkaystay inay sii wadi doonaan qorshahooda bannaanbaxa, iyagoo sheegay inay diyaar u yihiin wada-hadal, balse aysan ka tanaasuli doonin isu-soo-baxa weyn ee ay qorsheeyeen in berri lagu qabto nawaaxiga Villa Soomaaliya. items.title: DEG-DEG: Dagaal u dhexeeya Ciidamada Dowladda iyo Ilaalada Xasan Cali Kheyre oo ka Qarxay Muqdisho
items.description: Dagaal culus ayaa la soo sheegayaa inuu ka dhex qarxay ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo ciidamo la sheegay inay la socdaan Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Cali Kheyre, sida ay xaqiijinayaan dad goob-joogayaal ah. Wararka hordhaca ah ayaa sheegaya in iska horimaadka uu billowday kaddib markii ciidamo ka kala tirsan labada dhinac ay isku soo dhowaadeen, taasoo dhalisay is-afgaranwaa iyo muran degdeg ah oo isu beddelay dagaal hubeysan. Goob-joogayaal ayaa sheegay in rasaas xooggan laga maqlayo aagga uu dagaalku ka socdo, iyadoo la tilmaamay in labada dhinac ay isku adeegsanayaan hub culus iyo mid fudud. Ilaa iyo hadda ma cadda khasaaraha ka dhashay iska horimaadka, mana jiraan warar rasmi ah oo ka soo baxay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ama dhinaca Xasan Cali Kheyre oo ku saabsan sababta keentay dagaalka iyo xaaladda goobta. Xiisaddan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli magaalada Muqdisho ay ka jiraan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo siyaasadeed oo xooggan iyo kulamo ay wadaan mucaaradka iyo dowladda, taasoo sare u qaadaysa walaaca laga qabo amniga caasimadda.

items.title: Secretary of State Marco Rubio Before the House Appropriations Subcommittee on State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs On the FY27 Department of State Budget Request
items.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio Before the House Appropriations Subcommittee on State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs On the FY27 Department of State Budget Request Marco Rubio, Secretary of State Washington, D.C. SECRETARY RUBIO: Thank you. Thanks for having me here today. I think I’m going to skip the long opening – you have it in writing – I’ll just do a couple brief points. I’d rather spend the time on your questions. It’ll probably be a better use of our time. Just suffice it to say what I told you a year ago, and getting back to that point now – a couple things. The – in terms of U.S. foreign policy — (Protest utterances.) SECRETARY RUBIO: All right. The core of our – am I – is that – can continue now? All right. CHAIRMAN DIAZ-BALART: Mr. Secretary. SECRETARY RUBIO: So the core of our foreign policy must always be the national interest of the United States. That is basically defining what that national interest is and then operationalizing it in such a way that our foreign policy reflects it. This is across the board, in the work of diplomacy and the place in which we – and that requires prioritization, by the way. It requires us to prioritize some parts of the world over other parts of the world, some issues over other issues. That’s just the reality of limited resources, and every country in the world has limited resources, including the United States, despite our vast resources. The second is in terms of how we procure aid and in how we provide aid. We are still the world’s largest aid provider, and I mean by far. Like, there isn’t a close second. But we don’t want aid to solely be judged by how much you spend. We want it to be judged by what its results are. And I think we can talk about it today, but there are a couple points that I would raise that I think are very promising. The first is we’ve now entered, in the Global Health Strategy, over 32 health compacts with countries around the world. And these health compacts basically are – the countries that are signing them love it, not just because they’re getting the resources but because we’re investing in their domestic resources. In essence, we are trying to lay the groundwork in many of these countries where, one day, they will no longer need foreign aid, because they will be able to sustain it. We’re helping build the internal infrastructure, other than – as opposed to relying on extensive NGOs and things of this nature in the long term. We want them to build their own domestic capacity, we’ll help them, and they’re very happy, because it also gives them sovereignty over the way some of their aid is being disbursed in those countries. Likewise with humanitarian assistance. One of the great success stories of the last year is we are able in a time of disaster to respond faster than we were responding under previous administrations and organizations, and with – much more effectively. Jamaica is a great example. They had a hurricane in the Caribbean; Jamaica was heavily impacted. We were able to respond very quickly and very effectively. The same has been the case in a couple of typhoons, and we’re doing it now with Ebola, where we were able to program upwards of over $200 million very quickly in responding to it, down to the point of being able to even, through diplomatic means, establish a facility in Kenya for any Americans that are infected as an observation post for Americans. If someone’s infected with Ebola, they will be transferred to a facility that could care for them; if they’re not infected after the observation period, they’ll be able to return to the United States or wherever it is they’re traveling to. But we’ve also provided assistance to the individual partners that we have at the UN and in other places in providing aid immediately. So I would say that today, foreign aid has become more nimble, more responsive, it’s operating faster because of some of the flexibility that you’ve given us to respond, but also more creative. And that’s particularly true in the Global Health Strategy. We can talk more in depth later on about some of the arrangements that we’ve made with international organizations – as an example, the Global Fund, and our ability to meet our commitments to them. We’ve worked very closely with them. They’re very, very happy with the way we’ve outlined our contributions to the Global Fund. I think there was a statement today from the UN and OCHA on the work that we’ve done with them, and the ability to provide them the funds and resources necessary to carry out their mission. So I would just say that I feel like – while it is still ongoing and there’s always a process, I feel like we have made dramatic improvements in the way American foreign assistance is delivered across the world, but we’re able to do it now not just in a targeted way but in a more effective way, in which the – it’s not simply being judged by how much money you’re spending; it’s being judged by what results are you getting from it. And there’ll be more to talk about in the field of PEPFAR and otherwise if you want to ask about those, and I’ll find a way to work it in. But I don’t want to take any more time; I want to get to your questions. So thanks for having me.

items.title: Dagaal galabta ka dhacay guriga Xasan Cali Kheyre
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wararka naga soo gaaraya magaalada Muqdisho ayaa sheegaya in dagaal culus uu ka socdo afaafka hore ee hoyga Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Cali Kheyre, iyadoo xaaladda amni ee halkaasi ay aad u kacsan tahay. Sida ay sheegayaan ilo kala duwan, iska horimaadka ayaa u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda iyo ciidamo ilaalo u ah Xasan Cali Kheyre, waxaana si weyn looga maqlayaa aagga guriga dhawaaqa rasaasta iyo hubka culus. Goob-joogayaal ayaa sheegay in ciidamada labada dhinac ay isku adeegsanayaan hub kala duwan, taasoo sababtay cabsi soo wajahday dadka ku nool xaafadaha ku dhow halka uu dagaalku ka socdo. Ka hor inta uusan dagaalku qarxin, guriga Xasan Cali Kheyre waxaa ka socday kulamo ay lahaayeen mucaaradka iyo odayaasha dhaqanka, xilli mucaaradka wado qaban-qaabada banaanbax ballaaran oo ka dhan ah dowladda. Xiisadda siyaasadeed ee ka taagan Muqdisho ayaa sii korortay saacadihii u dambeeyay, iyadoo mucaaradku magaalada ku soo bandhigay awood ciidan, halka dhinaca kale ay socdaan dadaallo lagu doonayo in xaaladda lagu dejiyo wada-hadal. Siyaasiyiin iyo shaqsiyaad dhex-dhexaadinaya labada dhinac ayaa sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka ay diyaar u tahay wada-hadal, haddii mucaaradku ka laabto qorshaha banaanbaxa isla markaana ay dib ugu noqdaan aagga xayndaabka garoonka diyaaradaha ee Muqdisho oo ay hore uga soo guureen. items.title: Helitaanka Badda Cas”: Cutub cusub oo ku saabsan khilaafka Masar iyo Itoobiya
items.description: Bilihii u dambeeyay, Geeska Afrika waxa uu markhaati ka ahaa korodhka tartanka ku saabsan saamaynta siyaasadeed iyo helitaanka marin u helidda Badda Cas. Tani waxay dhacaysaa xilli iska horimaadka u dhexeeya Masar iyo Itoobiya uu u muuqdo inuu ka gudbay murannadii soo jireenka ahaa ee la xiriiray biyaha Webiga Niil iyo Biyo-xireenka Weyn ee Itoobiya (Renaissance Dam), isagoo hadda u xuub-siibtay arrimo ballaaran oo la xiriira dekedaha, marin-biyoodka ganacsiga iyo habaynta amniga gobolka. Murankan ayaa dhowaan mar kale soo cusboonaaday kadib markii Itoobiya ay ku eedaysay Masar inay isku dayayso inay hor istaagto helitaankeeda Badda Cas, maalmo yar kadib booqashadii Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Masar, Badr Abdel-Aty, uu ku tagay Eritrea. Intii uu booqashada ku jiray, wuxuu adkeeyay in amniga iyo maamulka Badda Cas ay yihiin mas’uuliyad gaar u ah dalalka xeebaha ku leh baddaas. Tartanka sii xoogaysanaya ee Geeska Afrika wuxuu ka tarjumayaa laba aragtiyood oo iska soo horjeeda oo ku saabsan mustaqbalka gobolka. Dhinac, Itoobiya waxay doonaysaa inay hesho joogitaan iyo saameyn badeed; dhinaca kalena, Masar waxay kordhinaysaa dadaallada ay ku xoojinayso xiriirkeeda dalalka Geeska Afrika iyo kuwa ku teedsan Badda Cas. Tani waxay ka dhacaysaa gobol horeba ula tacaalaya dhibaatooyin iyo qalalaase muddo dheer ka jiray Sudan, Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya, sida ay sheegeen cilmi-baarayaal iyo falanqeeyayaal ay wareysatay BBC-da. Laga soo bilaabo biyaha Niil ilaa Badda Cas Xiisadda Biyo-xireenka Weyn ee Itoobiya ayaa ahayd asalka ugu weyn ee xiisadda u dhexeysa Qaahira iyo Addis Ababa tobankii sano ee la soo dhaafay. Masar, oo inta badan biyaha ay isticmaasho ka hesha buuraha Itoobiya, waxay ka cabsi qabtaa saameynta uu biyo-xidheenku ku yeelan karo amnigeeda biyaha. Dhanka kale, Itoobiya waxay ku adkaysanaysaa in mashruucan uu muhiim u yahay daboolidda baahideeda horumarineed iyo soo saarista koronto. Cilmi-baare Suudaani ah oo ku takhasusay arrimaha Afrika, Maxamed Torshin, ayaa aaminsan in isbeddelkan uu yahay sii socoshada dabiiciga ah ee khilaafaadka labada dal. items.title: Maamulka gobolka oo go’aanno kasoo saaray dibadbaxa mucaaradka + Video
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir oo awaamiir culus kasoo saaray banaanbaxyada mucaaradka ee lagu wado inay berri ka dhacaan magaalada Muqdisho ayaa u asteeyay saddex goobood oo ku yaalla caasimada. Kulan deg-deg ah oo uu guddoomiyay duqa Muqdisho, Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab) ayaa go’aankan lagu gaaray, iyada oo amniga dibadbaxayaash ay sugayaan ciidamada dowladda. Goobaha banaanbaxyada loo asteeyay waxay kala yihiin garoonka kubadda cagta ee Injineer Yariisow ee degmada Cabdicasiis, garoonka kubadda cagta Stadium Muqdisho ee degmada Warta Nabadda iyo garoonka kubadda cagta Jaamacaha ee degmada Hodan. Afhayeenka Gobolka oo faah-faahiyay go’aannada soo baxay ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in aan dibadbaxayaasha loo ogoleyn hub, balse ay si nabad ah ku dibadbixi karaan. “Waxaa waajib ah in banaanbaxyada ay noqdaan kuwa nabadeed oo suurtageliya in dadku ay si xor ah oo xasilooni ah ay aragtidooda usoo gudbiyaan,” ayuu yiri Afhayeenka Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir. Sidoo kale wuxuu ku daray “Waxaa reeban in la isticmaalo hub iyo agab kale oo qatar ku ah amniga iyo xasiloonida caasimada ee dadaalka badan la geliyay”. Go’aannada kasoo baxay maamulka gobolka ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo saaka mucaaradka ay sheegeen in aysan ogolaan doonin in loo xadido goobaha ay ku qabsanayaan mudaharaadyada, sida uu shaaciyay Xildhibaan Daahir Amiin Jeesow. Mucaaradka oo hadda wadda abaabulkii ugu dambeeyay ayaa ku andacoonaya in dareenkooda ah si nabad ah ku muujinayaan, waxayna diidan yihiin muddo kororsiga halka sano ee Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo barakicinta shacabka magaalada Muqdisho. The post Maamulka gobolka oo go’aanno kasoo saaray dibadbaxa mucaaradka + Video appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Maamulka Gobolka oo soo saaray go’aamo culus oo ku aadan banaanbaxa mucaaradka ee Berri.
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Kulan saacado badan qaatay oo xarunta dowladda hoos ee Xamar ku dhex-maray guddoomiyaha gobolka Banaadir, ku-xigeenadiisa iyo saraakiisha kala duwan ee ciidanka Booliska gobolka Banaadir, ayaa waxaa laga soo saaro qodobo culus oo ku saabsan amniga caasimada iyo banaanbaxa mucaaradka ay ku qabanayaan Muqdisho. Afhayeenka maamulka gobolka Banaadir Saalax Carab, ayaa warbaahinta u akhriyay amarada kasoo baxay maamulka Gobolka, waxa uuna sheegay in maamulka gobolka uu mucaaradka u ogol yahay in banaanbax ay ku qabsadaan caasimada, balse waxa uu tilmaamay in loo ogyahay oo kaliya saddex goobood ee kala ah garoonka Eng Yariisow Stadium, garoonka Stadium Muqdisho iyo garoonka Jaamacadaha ee degmada Hodam. Waxa uu xusay in maamulka gobolka uu ka digayo in wax hub iyo agab kale oo khatar ku ah amniga lala yimaado goobaha banaanbaxa, waxa uu sheegay in amniga caasimada dedaal badan la geliyay sida uu hadalka u dhigay Afhayeenka gobolka Banaadir. Sidoo kale Saalax Carab, ayaa sheegay in banaanbaxayaasha lagu boorinayo in ay ka fogaadan falal rabshado wata, sida in ay xiraan waddooyinka ama waxyeelo la gaarsiiyo goobaha ganacsiga ee magaalada. items.title: NISA oo Dishay Sarkaal Sare oo Al-Shabaab u Qaabilsanaa qaraxyadda
items.description: MUQDISHO – NISA oo sheegtay in 9 xubnood oo ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab lagu dilay howlgallo amni oo ka dhacay gobollada Shabelle dhexe iyo Hiiraan. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka NISA, 23 dagaalyahan ayaa lagu dilay howlgal ka dhacay deegaanka Masaajid Cali Gaduud ee Shabeellaha Dhexe, halkaas oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday koox la sheegay inay qorsheynayeen weerarro ka dhan ah deegaannada ay dhowaan la wareegeen ciidamada dowladda iyo shacabka deegaanka. Howlgal kale oo ka dhacay degmada Buq-aqable ee gobolka Hiiraan ayaa lagu dilay lix xubnood oo Al-Shabaab ah, kuwaas oo uu ku jiray Cabdiraxmaan “Cabdi Mudallib”, oo NISA ku tilmaantay madaxii qaraxyada iyo walxaha qarxa ee Al-Shabaab u qaabilsanaa gobolka Hiiraan. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay in Cabdi Mudallib uu door weyn ku lahaa abaabulka iyo qorsheynta qaraxyada ka dhici jiray degmooyinka Buulo-burde iyo Jalalaqsi, isla markaana uu ka mid ahaa xubnaha ugu muhiimsan ee kooxda uga howlgalayay gobolka. Saraakiisha amniga ayaa ku tilmaamay dilkiisa dharbaaxo culus oo ku dhacday awoodda Al-Shabaab ee samaynta iyo adeegsiga walxaha qarxa (IED-yada), kuwaas oo kooxda u ah hubka ugu badan ee ay ku bartilmaameedsato shacabka, ciidamada iyo xarumaha dowladda. Howlgalladan ayaa qeyb ka ah gulufka militari ee ay dowladda Soomaaliya ka waddo gobollada dhexe iyo kuwa koonfureed, iyadoo la beegsanayo hoggaanka kooxda, shabakadaha qaraxyada, ilaha dhaqaalaha iyo silsiladaha sahayda ee Al-Shabaab. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, waxayna shacabka ku boorrisay inay la shaqeeyaan hay’adaha amniga si looga hortago weerarro mustaqbalka dhici kara.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo UNDP oo Daahfuray Nidaam Qaran oo looga Hortagayo Masiibooyinka Cimilada
items.description: MUQDISHO – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa iskaashi la sameysay hay’addq UNDP iyo Green Climate Fund si loo daahfuro nidaamka cusub ee digniinta hore ee masiibooyinka dabiiciga ah. Mashruucan oo qayb ka ah barnaamijka caalamiga ah ee “Early Warnings for All” ayaa loogu talagalay in lagu xoojiyo ka hortagga iyo u diyaar garowga masiibooyinka sida abaaraha, fatahaadaha iyo khataraha kale ee cimilada la xiriira. Mas’uuliyiinta UNDP ayaa sheegay in qorshuhu yahay in marka la gaaro sannadka 2030 la dhimo dhimashada ka dhalata masiibooyinka ilaa 42%, isla markaana digniinta hore lagu gaarsiiyo dhammaan dalka, halka hadda ay gaarto qiyaastii 20% shacabka. Waxaa lagu maalgelinayaa deeq dhan 12.7 milyan oo dollar. Sida lagu sheegay qorshaha, in ka badan 1.2 milyan oo qof ayaa si toos ah uga faa’iideysan doona helitaanka digniinaha hore, halka ku dhawaad 8 milyan oo qof si dadban looga ilaalin doono khataraha masiibooyinka. Barnaamijkan ayaa si gaar ah diiradda u saaraya haweenka, dhalinyarada, barakacayaasha iyo bulshada reer miyiga ah, iyadoo la dhisayo hannaan sharci iyo isgaarsiin degdeg ah oo wax ku ool u noqda marka ay dhacaan masiibooyin.

items.title: Daawo: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo ergo u diray Sheekh Shariif
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ergo uu soo diray Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa goordhow gaaray guriga uu Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed ka dagay agagaarka xeebta Liido ee magaalada Muqdisho, halkaas oo uu ka socdo abaabulka dibadbaxa mucaaradka. Ergada ayaa waxaa hoggaaminayo Ugaas Maxamuud Cali Ugaas, waxaana sidoo kale qayb ka ah xubno ay kamid yihiin Senator Cabdi Axmed Dhuxuloow (Dhagdheer), Xildhibaan Yuusuf Geelle Ugaas iyo mas’uuliyiin kale. Sanator Dhagdheer oo dhex-dhexaadintan uu wax ka waydiiyay Telefishinka Universal ayaa si kooban uga warbixiyay ujeedkooda, xili uu sii galayay hoyga uu dagay Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed. “Haa ergo ayaan u nimid,” ayaa ku jawaabay Senator Cabdi Axmed Dhuxuloow (Dhagdheer) oo kamid ah xubnaha ka socda Xasan ee u tegay Sheekh Shariif. Wararka ayaa intaas kusii daraya in haatan ay labada dhinac u socdaan wad-hadallo ku aadan sidii loo dajin lahaa xaaladda, maadaama dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan oo iska soo horjeedo laga dareemayo gudaha magaalada Muqdisho. Mucaaradka ayaa weli ku adkeysanaya in dibadbaxooda ay qabsadaan berri oo Khamiis ah, halka dowladdana ay rabto in lagu qabto meelo gaar oo loo cayimay. “Meel naloo xadidaayo oo aan ogolnahay ma jirto annaga wax colaad ah oo aan hurineyno malaha mudaharaadka berri waayay, wuxuuna noogu dhacayaa si nabad ah. Wax wada-hadal ah marnaba kama galeyno sida aan u mudaharaadeyno iyo sida aan xuquuqdeenna u muujineyno,,” ayuu goor sii horeysay yiri Xildhibaan Daahir Amiin Jeesow. Ergada ayaa waxaa hoggaaminayo Ugaas Maxamuud Cali Ugaas, waxaana sidoo kale qayb ka ah xubno ay kamid yihiin Senator Cabdi Axmed Dhuxuloow (Dhagdheer), Xildhibaan Yuusuf Geelle Ugaas iyo mas’uuliyiin kale. Sanator Dhagdheer oo dhex-dhexaadintan uu wax ka waydiiyay Telefishinka Universal ayaa si kooban uga warbixiyay ujeedkooda, xili uu sii galayay hoyga uu dagay Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed. “Haa ergo ayaan u nimid,” ayaa ku jawaabay Senator Cabdi Axmed Dhuxuloow (Dhagdheer) oo kamid ah xubnaha ka socda Xasan ee u tegay Sheekh Shariif. Wax wada-hadal ah marnaba kama galeyno sida aan u mudaharaadeyno iyo sida aan xuquuqdeenna u muujineyno,,” ayuu goor sii horeysay yiri Xildhibaan Daahir Amiin Jeesow. items.title: Djibouti Awaits Ethiopian Funding to Activate New Fuel Import Corridor
items.description: Mintesinot Nigussie A new fuel import facility being developed on Djibouti’s southeastern coast will remain idle until Ethiopia moves ahead with plans to finance and develop large-scale fuel storage infrastructure linked to the project, according to officials overseeing the port development. The offshore jetty at the Damerjog Liquid Bulk Port has reached the final stages of construction, but operations cannot begin without the accompanying onshore terminal and storage farm intended to handle Ethiopian fuel imports. Aboubaker Hadi Omar, chairman of the Djibouti Ports and Free Zones Authority (DPFZA), said negotiations are continuing with Ethiopian Investment Holdings (EIH) over the proposed investment. He said authorities expect financing discussions to advance around the beginning of the coming budget year in July. The terminal sits near the border with Somaliland and roughly 13 kilometres from the Ethio-Djibouti railway network. Moroccan contractor SOMAGEC carried out installation works on the offshore jetty, which extends around three kilometres into the sea. Djibouti authorities say the facility is designed to handle fuel volumes far beyond the capacity of the existing infrastructure currently serving Ethiopia. The new jetty is projected to process 25 million tonnes annually and accommodate up to 12 vessel rotations. The project also includes plans for multiple storage installations with a combined static capacity of nearly two million cubic metres.       Source Fsxbusiness
