items.title: From Protest to Liberation: How Digital Platforms Transformed the SSC Community Struggle for Self-Determination
items.description: By Abdirahman A. Issa Note: The article is based on extensive research, including field visits and in-depth interviews with dozens of youth leaders who were instrumental in the revolution between May and June 2024. It offers firsthand accounts of the revolution from activists. It also explains how the clan was mobilized through digital platforms, transforming spontaneous protests into a coordinated movement known as the “Blue Revolution.” To understand the Laascaanood revolution, one must trace the role digital platforms played at every stage: raising consciousness, coordinating protest, mobilizing for war, and reshaping power dynamics on the ground. Introduction On December 26, 2022, Abdifitah Abdullahi Abdi, known as Hadraawi Sangub, a member of Somaliland’s Waddani Party in the Sool region was assassinated in Laascaanood. Although he was affiliated with a party officially registered in Somaliland, the general sentiment in Laascaanood was one of opposition to Somaliland’s secession. This tragic event was not an isolated incident; it was the latest in a series of targeted killings that had begun in 2009, following Somaliland’s takeover of the town from Puntland. In the aftermath of his burial, the youth took to the streets to protest against the ongoing assassinations and to demand accountability from the Somaliland government. After two days of spontaneous protests, the situation evolved dramatically. Tech-savvy youth residing outside the city began to organize the protesters, transforming what had started as a Spontaneous protest into a coordinated movement known as the “Blue Revolution.” Protesters raised the Somali flag in public places across the city, expressing their desire for a united Somalia and the formation of their own administration. Previous protests had faltered due to a lack of leadership and direction, but this time, the youth were guided with purpose. Each neighborhood in Laascaanood was assigned a leader who coordinated actions via WhatsApp groups, connecting participants in real time. Prior to the revolution, closed WhatsApp groups had already united like-minded youth, facilitating discussions about liberating their territory from Somaliland and raising awareness within their community. When the protests began, these groups became the organizational backbone of the movement, expanding their membership to encourage broader participation. WhatsApp was instrumental in scheduling protests and disseminating videos and images from the demonstrations. Social media acted as a catalyst for mobilizing youth to take to the streets and sustain protest momentum. In response to the escalating protests, Somaliland troops resorted to violence, which led to the deaths of 20 protesters and injuries to 30 others. Yet the youth refused to be silenced. Abdishakuur Ahmed Salad, a protester, poignantly wrote on his Facebook on December 27, 2022: “Better to die with dignity than to live with humiliation and indignity.” Tragically, Abdishakuur was killed the following day, an act that, rather than extinguishing the movement, only deepened the youth’s resolve. They continued to share images and videos of the protests on social media, amplifying public outrage far beyond the city’s borders. Recognizing that social media was the lifeblood of the movement’s coordination, Somaliland authorities blocked internet access on January 1, 2023. The revolution’s dynamics shifted decisively when a civilian named Mohamoud Ali Saadle was killed. His clansmen retaliated against Somaliland forces, igniting an armed conflict that would ultimately compel Somaliland to retreat to the outskirts of the city. Roots of Revolt: Identity, History, and Collective Consciousness To understand the depth of the uprising, one must recognize the political awakening processes that had been unfolding in the years leading up to the first shot. Social media has played a significant role in raising political awareness and fostering a collective consciousness among Dhulbahante youth long before December 2022. It became a platform for discussions and the sharing of information about their history, particularly the Daraawiish movement and the anti-colonial struggle waged by their forefathers against the British Empire. This rich history served as a constant point of reference and pride. Blue revolution Prior to the “ blue revolution ”, the Dhulbahante clan had experienced a noticeable division along sub-clan and administrative lines. The formation of the Somaliland (1991) and Puntland (1998) administrations had resulted in a political split, with some clans aligning with Puntland while others associated with Somaliland. This division came at the expense of their unity and solidarity. Conflicts within the Dhulbahante clan became prevalent, and it was widely alleged that the Somaliland administration played a role in fuelling them to weaken opposition. In late 2007 Lasanod was occupied by Somaliland forces. Subsequently, armed resistance groups emerged in the area around Laascaanood and Buuhoodle. But those groups did not manage to unite the clan for collective action due to prevailing mistrust and suspicion. However, a significant turning point occurred in December 2022, when youth embraced social media to foster trust and dismantle barriers to unity. The mistrust that had long divided the Dhulbahante crumbled as tribal chiefs and politicians, who had perpetuated it, witnessed a rising consciousness, especially among young people, online. Individuals who had been quietly seeking financial support from Somaliland found themselves publicly exposed and shamed on social media. Consequently, no one dared openly oppose the people’s wishes, and those who had previously collaborated with Somaliland were coerced into joining the revolution.  On social media platforms, the Dhulbahante youth used their voices to challenge the prevailing notion of their subjugation and to assert their determination to unite. They drew upon their proud history of resistance against British colonialism to question a painful paradox: why had their ancestors confronted a global empire, yet their own generation seemed hesitant to confront Somaliland, dominated by the Isaaq clan? Many of these youth were born or grew up during Somaliland’s rule of Laascaanood. They did not find a sense of belonging within the national myth of Somaliland, as its history, symbols, and memorials revolved primarily around the Isaaq struggle and SNM heroism. Social media became the arena where these competing historical narratives collided. The Isaaq often portrayed the Daraawiish as religious extremists, while the Dhulbahante accused the Isaaq of collaboration with colonial powers. These debates, however charged, were the arena in which a new generation forged its political identity. Adding to this sense of urgency, the Dhulbahante youth observed their peers from other clans celebrating the founding of their own federal administrations on social media. Mocked for lacking their own state while remaining under Isaaq control, the Dhulbahante youth were propelled by a mixture of bitterness, pride, and a determination to achieve territorial liberation. The defunct Khatumo State, which had emerged in resistance to Somaliland 2012-2015, though politically unsuccessful, had left behind a crucial legacy: a distinctive flag that youth displayed on social media to assert their unique identity and collective purpose. From Protest to War: Digital Mobilization on the Battlefield On February 6, 2023, a day scheduled for clan elders to issue a self-determination statement, war broke out unexpectedly in the early morning. One month of digital organizing now gave way to armed conflict, yet social media did not retreat from its central role; it simply shifted its purpose from coordinating protests to mobilizing fighters. The Dhulbahante sub-clans swiftly organized to recruit fighters and procure arms. Through WhatsApp groups, youth from each sub-clan coordinated with their clansmen both inside and outside the country, urging them to actively participate in the liberation of their land. This level of unified participation from all Dhulbahante sub-clans was unprecedented in their history. Initially, their Harti brethren, including the Majeerteen and Warsangali clans, were skeptical, having witnessed previous short-lived conflicts initiated by the Dhulbahante. However, after 20 days of relentless fighting, during which Dhulbahante forces proved their seriousness by driving out Mahad Canbaashe, a top Somaliland commander from the Jaamac Siyaad sub-clan of Dhulbahante, and his ca. 200 men force from Laascaanood, the sentiment shifted. Youth then took to social media to express their disappointment at the lack of support from their Harti brethren, warning that history would not be kind to those who did not stand with them. The appeal worked. Gradually, the Majeerteen and Warsangali clans responded, sending troops to join the war. A YouTuber named Kabtan Ayuub, residing in Germany, played a notable role in mobilizing the Majeerteen clans. He used ridicule and derogatory language to ignite their clan pride and stir them to action. This approach proved effective; every other day, a sub-clan would send reinforcements, which were warmly welcomed in Laascaanood by the Garaads (clan leaders). These arrivals were broadcast on social media, showcasing the fighters’ determination and further boosting morale. The highly publicized arrival of external Harti sub-clan contingents in March and April created the psychological impression of an ever-growing force to instill fear among Somaliland troops. Social media also played a critical role in emotional mobilization by documenting and exposing the atrocities committed by Somaliland forces. Activists provided daily updates from the ground, documenting killings and injuries during the suppression of protests and throughout the conflict. Posts tagged to foreign embassies raised international awareness of the humanitarian situation. GPS coordinates authenticated the locations where bombs were dropped, with images of bomb remains being widely shared. Adding to the outrage, Somaliland troops themselves recorded videos of bombardments while making genocidal statements, content that spread rapidly online and shattered the sympathy that many Somalis had previously held for Somaliland. The Dhulbahante also skilfully leveraged their clan identity to rally the wider Harti community worldwide. The Harti diaspora organized fundraising activities, made possible by coordinated social media campaigns. Winning the Narrative: Propaganda and Information Warfare The armed conflict was simultaneously fought on two fronts: the battlefield and the information space. The Dhulbahante’s proactive strategy in crafting their war narrative enabled them to win the propaganda war on social media against Somaliland, which traditionally relied on conventional media. Somaliland was consistently reactive to the Dhulbahante claims. The Dhulbahante effectively used social media trolls to spread morale-boosting content and misinformation. They falsely posted images of military equipment claiming to have captured them from Somaliland troops, reported defections in the Somaliland army, and repeatedly claimed that enemy troops had abandoned their weapons and fled. They employed a divide-and-conquer strategy, propagating the notion that they were fighting particular sub-clans within the Isaaq supporting Somaliland (i.e., the Habar Jeclo) while others (i.e. Habar Yoonis) were not much involved. This was an attempt to fracture the cohesion of the Somaliland forces. The Dhulbahante posted live videos from the frontline, claiming advances, and exaggerated enemy casualties while minimizing their own. The other side, of course, did the same. But Dhulbahante did this additionally with the spirit of those fighting for their survival against an overly powerful aggressor. On the diplomatic front, the Dhulbahante’s aggressive engagement garnered significant international attention. Their narrative, portraying their clan as victims of massacre/genocide (Somali : xasuuq ), proved persuasive. The World Health Organization director publicly condemned the shelling of hospitals; human rights organizations issued reports documenting atrocities; and the United Nations Security Council convened to discuss the matter, calling for an urgent ceasefire and the withdrawal of Somaliland troops. On August 25, 2023, after seven months of intense fighting, Dhulbahante and their Harti allies secured a decisive victory, overrunning Somaliland military bases on the outskirts of Laascaanood, capturing hundreds of prisoners, and seizing a large number of weapons. It was the culmination of a struggle that had begun not with guns, but with WhatsApp messages and Facebook posts. Conclusion: The Transformation of Power Dynamics in Social Media Use The revolution not only reshaped the relationship between the Dhulbahante and Somaliland but also fundamentally transformed the internal power dynamics of the Dhulbahante community itself. Social media provided the youth with a platform to express themselves, mobilize, and hold traditional power holders accountable in ways that had simply not been possible before. What began as a spontaneous protest evolved into an organized movement. This transformation did not happen by accident. It was driven, shaped, and sustained by social media, ultimately overturning the political order in Laascaanood, leading to the expulsion of Somaliland forces and the establishment of a new administration called the Northern Eastern State.   Abdirahman A. Issa   Email: Cadced99@gmail.com The post From Protest to Liberation: How Digital Platforms Transformed the SSC Community Struggle for Self-Determination appeared first on WardheerNews .

Initially, their Harti brethren, including the Majeerteen and Warsangali clans, were skeptical, having witnessed previous short-lived conflicts initiated by the Dhulbahante. However, after 20 days of relentless fighting, during which Dhulbahante forces proved their seriousness by driving out Mahad Canbaashe, a top Somaliland commander from the Jaamac Siyaad sub-clan of Dhulbahante, and his ca. 200 men force from Laascaanood, the sentiment shifted. Youth then took to social media to express their disappointment at the lack of support from their Harti brethren, warning that history would not be kind to those who did not stand with them. The appeal worked. Gradually, the Majeerteen and Warsangali clans responded, sending troops to join the war. A YouTuber named Kabtan Ayuub, residing in Germany, played a notable role in mobilizing the Majeerteen clans. He used ridicule and derogatory language to ignite their clan pride and stir them to action. This approach proved effective; every other day, a sub-clan would send reinforcements, which were warmly welcomed in Laascaanood by the Garaads (clan leaders). These arrivals were broadcast on social media, showcasing the fighters’ determination and further boosting morale. The highly publicized arrival of external Harti sub-clan contingents in March and April created the psychological impression of an ever-growing force to instill fear among Somaliland troops. Social media also played a critical role in emotional mobilization by documenting and exposing the atrocities committed by Somaliland forces. Activists provided daily updates from the ground, documenting killings and injuries during the suppression of protests and throughout the conflict. Posts tagged to foreign embassies raised international awareness of the humanitarian situation. GPS coordinates authenticated the locations where bombs were dropped, with images of bomb remains being widely shared. Adding to the outrage, Somaliland troops themselves recorded videos of bombardments while making genocidal statements, content that spread rapidly online and shattered the sympathy that many Somalis had previously held for Somaliland. The Dhulbahante also skilfully leveraged their clan identity to rally the wider Harti community worldwide. The Harti diaspora organized fundraising activities, made possible by coordinated social media campaigns. Winning the Narrative: Propaganda and Information Warfare The armed conflict was simultaneously fought on two fronts: the battlefield and the information space. The Dhulbahante’s proactive strategy in crafting their war narrative enabled them to win the propaganda war on social media against Somaliland, which traditionally relied on conventional media. Somaliland was consistently reactive to the Dhulbahante claims. The Dhulbahante effectively used social media trolls to spread morale-boosting content and misinformation. They falsely posted images of military equipment claiming to have captured them from Somaliland troops, reported defections in the Somaliland army, and repeatedly claimed that enemy troops had abandoned their weapons and fled. They employed a divide-and-conquer strategy, propagating the notion that they were fighting particular sub-clans within the Isaaq supporting Somaliland (i.e., the Habar Jeclo) while others (i.e. Habar Yoonis) were not much involved. This was an attempt to fracture the cohesion of the Somaliland forces. The Dhulbahante posted live videos from the frontline, claiming advances, and exaggerated enemy casualties while minimizing their own. The other side, of course, did the same. But Dhulbahante did this additionally with the spirit of those fighting for their survival against an overly powerful aggressor. On the diplomatic front, the Dhulbahante’s aggressive engagement garnered significant international attention. Their narrative, portraying their clan as victims of massacre/genocide (Somali : xasuuq ), proved persuasive. The World Health Organization director publicly condemned the shelling of hospitals; human rights organizations issued reports documenting atrocities; and the United Nations Security Council convened to discuss the matter, calling for an urgent ceasefire and the withdrawal of Somaliland troops. On August 25, 2023, after seven months of intense fighting, Dhulbahante and their Harti allies secured a decisive victory, overrunning Somaliland military bases on the outskirts of Laascaanood, capturing hundreds of prisoners, and seizing a large number of weapons. It was the culmination of a struggle that had begun not with guns, but with WhatsApp messages and Facebook posts. Conclusion: The Transformation of Power Dynamics in Social Media Use The revolution not only reshaped the relationship between the Dhulbahante and Somaliland but also fundamentally transformed the internal power dynamics of the Dhulbahante community itself. Social media provided the youth with a platform to express themselves, mobilize, and hold traditional power holders accountable in ways that had simply not been possible before. What began as a spontaneous protest evolved into an organized movement. This transformation did not happen by accident. It was driven, shaped, and sustained by social media, ultimately overturning the political order in Laascaanood, leading to the expulsion of Somaliland forces and the establishment of a new administration called the Northern Eastern State.   Abdirahman A. items.title: Wadahadalladii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo Madasha Mustaqbalka oo Ismariwaa ku Burburay
items.description: Muqdisho (WDN)- Shirkii u socday Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Madasha Mustaqbalka,oo ay garwadeen ka ahaayeen dowladaha Ingiriiska iyo Maraykanka, ayaa la sheegay in maanta uu ku dhammaaday is-afgaranwaa siyaasaddeed. Kulanka, oo ay soo qabanqaabiyeen safiirrada Ingiriiska iyo Maraykanka u fadhiya Soomaaliya, ayaa dhinaca dowladda waxaa uga qeyb galay Madaxweyne Xasan Shekh Maxamuud iyo Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka 1-aad Saalax Axmed Jaamac, halka dhinaca Madasha Mustaqbalka waxaa uga qeyb galeen Madaxweynihii hore Shariif Sheekh Axmed iyo Madaxweynaha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni. Xukuumadda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, oo maanta uu kaga egyahay muddo-xileedkeedu, ayaa ku adkaysatay in ay weli sharci ahaan haysato hal sano oo dheeraad ah, iyada oo cuskanaysa wax-ka-beddelladii dastuurka lagu sameeyay. Dowladda ayaa sidoo kale ku adkaysanaysa hirgelinta doorasho qof iyo cod ah oo dalka ka dhacda. Dhanka kale, mucaaradka ayaa sheegay in maanta oo ku beegan 15-ka May 2026 wixii ka dambeeya uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh noqonayo madaxweyne hore, isla markaana aysan suuragal ahayn in dalka laga qabto doorasho hal dhinac ah oo aan lagu heshiin. Mucaaradka ayaa caawa yeelanaya kulan degdeg ah oo ay kaga arrinsanayaan xaaladda siyaasadeed ee sii cakirmaysa iyo jihada tallaabooyinka xiga ee la qaadi doono. Xiisaddan siyaasaddeed ee sii xoogeysanaysa ayaa laga cabsi qabaa in ay dalka u horseedi karto qalalaase siyaasaddeed, burbur dowladeed, iyo dagaallo hor leh oo ka Soomaaliya. items.title: Wada-hadalladii Xalane oo fashilmay iyo DF oo ku dhawaaqday in dalku galay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wada-hadalladii u dhaxeeyay Madaxda Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Golaha Mustaqbalka ayaa kusoobdhamaaday natiijo la’aan, xilli ay beesha caalamka dadaal badan gelisay sidii loo gaari lahaa xal wadar-ogol av oo looga gudbo xiisadda taagan. Wada-hadalladan ayaa saddex maalmood oo xiriir ah ka socday gudaha xerada Xalane, iyadoo kulankii u dambeeyay ee galabta lagu kala kacay. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online markale dhinacyadu uma ballamin kulan kale, taas oo wada-hadalladdii socday ka dhigaysa mid guul-dareystay. Madaxweynaha Puntland, Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni iyo Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka, Shariif Sheekh Axmed oo Golaha Mustaqbalka ku metalayay wada-hadallada ayaa miiska soo saaray in xukuumadda muddo xileedkeedu dhammaaday, isla markaana la galo marxalad kala-guur ah. Mucaaradka oo iyagu maanta dib u dhigay dibad-baxyadoodii ayaa haatan galay shirar degdeg ah, iyagoo abaabulaya kacdoonno ka dhan ah Villa Somalia. Dhinaca kale, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa markii lagu kala kacay shirka ku dhawaaqday in dalka uu galay xilligii loo guuri lahaa nidaam dimuquraaddi ah oo ka hana qaada dalka kuna dhisan mabda’a qof iyo cod. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay wasaaradda warfaafinta Soomaaliya ayaa lagu sheegay in siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka keeneen aragti ka duwan doorasho dadweyne, taas oo ay sheegtay inay ka hor imanayso xuquuqda aas-aasiga ah ee muwaadinka uu u leeyahay in uu wax doorto lana doorto. “Dowladda waxay la wadaagaysaa shacabka Soomaaliyeed in dalka ay ka qabsoomi doonto doorasho qof iyo cod ah, xor iyo xalaal ah, hufan, isla markaana waafaqsan dastuurka, shuruucda dalka iyo barnaamijka siyaasadeed ee dowladdu ballanqaaday,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeed. Dowladda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in albaabka wada-xaajoodka iyo wadatashigu uu weli furan yahay, iyadoo si cad u sheegtay in aan marnaba laga gorgortami doonin in doorashada lagu celiyo dadweynaha. “Dowladda Federaalka iyada oo fulinaysa waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee ka saaran dhaqan-galinta doorasho qof iyo cod ah oo muwaadiniinta fursad u siineysa in ay helaan xaqooda dastuuriga ah, waxay dowladdu cadaynaysaa in dalku uu galay xilligii loo guuri lahaa nidaam dimuquraaddi ah oo ka hana qaada dalka kuna dhisan mabda’a qof iyo cod,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka dowladda. items.title: DEG DEG: Dowladda Federaalka oo ku dhawaaqday in Soomaaliya ay galayso doorasho qof iyo cod ah
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si rasmi ah u shaacisay in dalka uu galay marxalad siyaasadeed cusub oo ku dhisan hirgelinta doorasho qof iyo cod ah, kadib warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay dowladda. Qoraalka ayaa lagu sheegay in dowladda ay gudaneyso waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee ka saaran xaqiijinta hannaan dimuquraadi ah oo shacabka Soomaaliyeed si toos ah ugu dooranayaan hoggaankooda, si muwaadiniintu u helaan xuquuqdooda dastuuriga ah ee doorashada. Dowladdu waxay sheegtay in muddooyinkii lasoo dhaafay ay wadatashiyo la yeelaneysay qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada iyo daneeyayaasha siyaasadda, si loo helo aragti mideysan oo ku saabsan nooca doorasho ee dalka ka dhaceysa. Sidoo kale, dowladda ayaa xaqiijisay inay saddexdii maalmood ee ugu dambeysay wadahadallo la lahayd xubno kamid ah mucaaradka, balse ay jiraan qodobo ay ku tilmaamtay kuwo ka hor imanaya xaqa muwaadinka Soomaaliyeed ee ah inuu wax doorto lana doorto. Warsaxaafadeedka ayaa lagu caddeeyay in Soomaaliya ay ka dhici doonto doorasho qof iyo cod ah oo xor, xalaal, hufan isla markaana waafaqsan dastuurka iyo sharciyada dalka. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa ugu dambeyn sheegtay in albaabka wada-hadalka iyo wadatashigu uu weli u furan yahay dhammaan dhinacyada siyaasadda si loo gaaro is-afgarad qaran.

items.title: Xog: Lacago laaluush ah oo garoonka Muqdisho looga qaado dadka u dhoofa…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Bilihii u dambeeyay waxaa soo xoogeysanayay eedeymo ku saabsan musuq baahsan oo ka dhex jira Garoonka Diyaaradaha Aadan Cadde ee magaalada Muqdisho, kaas oo ah albaabka ugu weyn ee dalka laga galo, lagana dhoofo. Sida ay sheegeen dad kala duwan oo u dhoofayay dalka Masar, waxaa lacago sharci-darro ah looga qaatay gudaha garoonka, inkastoo aysan wax dhibaato ah ka jirin dokumentiyadooda safarka. Qaar ka mid ah dadkaas ayaa sheegay inay diideen bixinta lacagaha ay ku tilmaameen laaluush. Dadka sida gaarka ah loo beegsado ayaa lagu sheegay dhalinyarada u safraysa Masar, gaar ahaan kuwa lagu tuhmo inay halkaas uga sii gudbayaan waddada tahriibka ee loo maro Liibiya iyo badda Mediterranean-ka. Lacagaha laga qaado dadkaas ayaa la sheegay inay u dhexeeyaan 150 ilaa 200 oo dollar. Dhalinyarada u dhoofaysa Masar ayaa, sida ay dadka safarka ah sheegeen, mararka qaar la weydiiyaa sababta safarkooda iyo qof damiin ka ah. Hase yeeshee, dadka lagu tuhmo tahriibka ayaa inta badan ku adkaata inay helaan qof damiinan kara, taas beddelkeedana waxaa lagu cadaadiyaa inay bixiyaan lacag laaluush ah si loogu fududeeyo safarkooda. Lacagaha laga qaado dadkaas, oo u badan dhalinyaro, ayaa la sheegay in lagu shubo taleefanka qofka maalintaas ka shaqeynaya qeybaha baarista ama socdaalka ee garoonka. Dhacdooyinkan ayaa soo bilowday kadib markii ay furantay waddada tahriibka ee dhalinyarada Soomaaliyeed uga sii gudbaan Masar, halkaas oo ay uga sii tallaabaan Liibiya, kahor inta aysan isku dayin inay ka gudbaan badda Mediterranean-ka, oo sababtay dhimashada kumannaan muhaajiriin ah sanadihii la soo dhaafay. Magaalada Muqdisho waxaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay inay ka howlgalaan kooxo isku xiran oo dhalinyarada ku dhiirrigeliya tahriibka. Kooxahan ayaa dhalinyarada u ballanqaada inay daboolayaan qarashaadka safarka laga bilaabo Muqdisho ilaa Liibiya, balse lacagtaas ayaa dib looga qaadaa marka qofka la geeyo Liibiya. Haddii qofka tahriibka ah uusan awoodin inuu bixiyo lacagtaas, waxaa la sheegay in muuqaal laga duubo isagoo la jirdilayo ama xaalad adag ku jira, kadibna loo diro qoyskiisa. Arrintaas ayaa qoysaska ku qasabta inay si degdeg ah u bixiyaan lacagaha laga dalbado, si ay u badbaadiyaan wiilkooda ama gabadhooda. items.title: Golaha Mustaqbalka oo war cusub kaso saaray qabsoomida banaanbaxa Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ayaa ku dhawaaqay in dib loo dhigay bannaanbixii la qorsheeyey inuu maalinta berri ah ka dhaco magaalada Muqdisho ee caasimadda Soomaaliya. Go’aankan ayay Madasha Samatabixinta sheegtay inay u qaateen si fursad loo siiyo wada-hadallo u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ee ka socda gudah xerada Xalane. Wada-hadalladan oo ay dhex-dhexaadinayaan xubno ka tirsan beesha caalamka ayaa looga dan leeyahay sidii xal looga gaari lahaa barakicinta, xabsiga sharci darrada ah, doorashooyinka iyo maamulka marxaladda kala guurka siyaasadeed ee dalka, sida ay sheegeen siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka. “Madasha Samatabixinta Soomaaliyeed waxay mar kale caddeynaysaa in bannaanbaxa la qorsheeyey uu ahaa mid nabadeed oo lagu dalbanayo jooginta barakicinta, iyo doorashooyinka halla dhinca ah, ilaalinta dastuurka, amniga iyo xuquuqda muwaadinka,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal kasoo baxay mucaaradka. Hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka ayaa sheegay in taariikhda cusub ee bannaanbaxa uu qabsoomayo ay dib kasoo sheegi doonaan, iyadoo lagu salaynayo natiijada iyo horumarka laga gaaro wada-hadallada socda. Si kastaba, wakiillada beesha caalamka, gaar ahaan danjirayaasha Mareykanka iyo Ingiriiska oo qayb ka ah dadaallada dhex-dhexaadinta ayaa ku cadaadinaya Villa Soomaaliya iyo Golaha Mustaqbalka inay heshiis gaaraan. Haddii taas la waayana, waxaa la filayaa inay ku dhawaaqaan in Soomaaliya gashay marxalad cusub oo halis badan leh, taas oo dib u dhigeysa horumarradii la sameeyay. Wada-hadalladan ayaa noqonaya kuwii ugu horreeyay ee noocooda ah ee lagu qabto Xalane, iyadoo beesha caalamku door weyn ku leedahay dadaallada lagu raadinayo xal kama dambeys ah oo laga gaaro khilaafka ka taagan doorashooyinka Soomaaliya. DF oo shaacisay inay duqeysay ciidankii Lafta-gareen iyo xubno Shabaab ah ‘oo isku milmay’
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa shaacisay in howlgal qorsheysan oo ay ciidamadu ka fuliyeen duleedka magaalada Baydhabo lagu dilay dagaalyahanno ka tirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab iyo maleeshiyaad taabacsan Cabdicasiis Laftagareen oo ay sheegeen in ay isku milmeen. Howlgalka oo ahaa duqeyn ayaa lagu dilay 50 xubnood oo isugu jiray Al-Shabaab iyo maleeshiyaad hubeysan oo garab siinayay, sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya. Ciidanka ayaa sidoo kale burburiyay gaadiid dagaal iyo agab ciidan oo ay kooxuhu u adeegsanayeen abaabulka weerarro ka dhan ah Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, sida ay xaqiijisay wasaaraddu. “Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga waxay caddeyneysaa in weerarkii gaadmada ahaa ee Baydhabo ay ku lug lahaayeen maleeshiyaad taabacsan Cabdicasiis Laftagareen, kuwaas oo si toos ah ugu milmay Khawaarijta Al-Shabaab,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in sheegashada weerarkaas ay muujinayso in maleeshiyaadkaasi ay noqdeen garab u adeegaya argagixisada, isla markaana khatar ku ah amniga qaranka iyo xasilloonida deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed. “Dowladdu waxay xaqiijineysaa in aysan marnaba u dulqaadan doonin cid kasta oo hub ama maleeshiyaad u adeegsata dano siyaasadeed, carqaladeynta amniga, isla markaana cid kasta oo gacan siisa Khawaarijta ama u noqota weji ay ku dhuuntaan laga qaadi doono tallaabo sharciga waafaqsan,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Hoos ka aqriso war-saxaafadeedka: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa xalay howlgal qorsheysan ka fuliyay duleedka magaalada Baydhabo, kaddib weerar gaadmo ah oo shalay subax ay kooxo nabad-diid ah iyo maleeshiyaad argagixiso oo wada socday ay kusoo qaadeen ciidan ku howlanaa sugidda amniga. Howlgalka ayaa lagu dilay 50 xubnood oo isugu jiray Khawaarijta Al-Shabaab iyo maleeshiyaad hubeysan oo garab siinayay. Ciidanka ayaa sidoo kale burburiyay gaadiid dagaal iyo agab ciidan oo ay kooxuhu u adeegsanayeen abaabulka weerarro ka dhan ah Ciidanka Qaranka iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga waxay caddeyneysaa in weerarkii gaadmada ahaa ay ku lug lahaayeen maleeshiyaad taabacsan Cabdicasiis Laftagareen, kuwaas oo si toos ah ugu milmay Khawaarijta Al-Shabaab. Sheegashada weerarka ee Khawaarijta ayaa muujinaysa in maleeshiyaadkaas ay noqdeen garab u adeegaya argagixisada, isla markaana khatar ku ah amniga qaranka iyo xasilloonida deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga XFS waxay tacsi u direysaa ehellada, qoysaska iyo guud ahaan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ee ay ka shahiideen geesiyaashii naftooda u huray difaaca qaranka intii uu socday weerarkii shalay. items.title: Trump: Shiinuhu wuxuu doonayaa in marin biyoodka Hormuz uu furnaado
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump, ayaa sheegay in Shiinuhu uu doonayo in marin biyoodka Hormuz uu sii furnaado, isagoo sharraxay in tallaabadani ay muhiim u tahay shixnadaha saliidda. Waxa kale oo uu sheegay in Shiinuhu uu saliid badan ka iibsado gobolka, sidaas darteedna uu doorbidayo in hawlahani ay sii socdaan iyada oo aan wax xayiraad ah la saarin. Trump ayaa intaa ku daray in Madaxweynaha Shiinaha Xi Jinping uu muujiyay rabitaankiisa ah inuu gacan ka geysto heshiis si loo hubiyo in marinku furnaado. “Qofkii saliiddaas badan iibsada wuxuu xiriir la leeyahay iyaga, laakiin wuxuu sheegay inuu jeclaan lahaa inuu caawiyo haddii uu awoodo,” ayuu yiri Trump, isagoo ku nuuxnuuxsaday in Shiinuhu uu jeclaan lahaa inuu arko marin biyoodka Hormuz oo furan. Trump ayaa sidoo kale ku soo gabagabeeyay in Mareykanka iyo Shiinuhu ay aragti isku mid ah ka qabaan arrinta Iiraan.

items.title: Diyaarad Ruushku leeyahay oo maanta kasoo degtay Muqdisho, DF-na ku wareejisay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Ruushka ayaa maanta Soomaaliya ku wareejisay deeq gargaar ah oo loogu talagalay dadka ay saameeyeen xaaladaha adag ee bani’aadannimo, gaar ahaan abaaraha iyo duruufaha nololeed ee ka jira qaybo kamid ah dalka. Deeqdan ayaa lagu wareejiyay mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo ku sugnaa garoonka Diyaaradaha Aadan Cadde ee magaalada Muqdisho, halkaas oo ay kasoo degtay diyaaraddii sidday gargaarka bani’aadannimo. Safiirka Ruushka ee Soomaaliya, Mikhail Golovanov ayaa dowladda Soomaaliya si rasmi ah ugu wareejiyay shixnadan gargaar oo gaareysa 25-tan oo raashin ah, isaga oo ay dhinac taagnaayeen qunsulka Ruushka iyo mas’uuliyiin kale oo ka socotay dowladda Moscow. Mas’uuliyiinta dowladda Soomaaliya ee goobta ku sugnaa waxaa kamid ahaa wasiirka warfaafinta, guddoomiyaha hay’adda SODMA iyo xubno kale oo ka socday hay’adaha dowladda ee qaabilsan arrimaha gargaarka iyo gurmadka. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in deeqdan ay qeyb ka tahay taageerada caalamiga ah ee lagu garab istaagayo shacabka Soomaaliyeed ee wajahaya xaaladaha bani’aadannimo, xilli qaybo badan oo dalka kamid ah ay weli ka jiraan saameynta abaarta iyo barakaca. Sidoo kale, Dowladda Federaalka ayaa hore dalalka saaxiibada la ah Soomaaliya ugu baaqday inay kordhiyaan taageerada bani’aadannimo si wax looga qabto baahiyaha sii kordhaya ee shacabka nugul, gaar ahaan dadka ku nool deegaanada ay abaaruhu saameeyeen. items.title: Muxuu madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh sameeyay maanta?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Dr. Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta ubax xusuuseed dhigay taallada dhallinyaradii halgamayaasha ahaa ee SYL, munaasabadda lagu maamuusayay 83-guurada kasoo wareegtay aas-aaskii ururkaas taariikhiga ah ee horseedka u ahaa halgankii gobannimo-doonka dalka. Munaasabadda oo ka dhacday fagaaraha taallada SYL ee ku taalla agagaarka Madaxtooyada Qaranka ayaa waxaa ka qayb-galay mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan dowladda federaalka, maamulka gobolka Banaadir, xubno ka socday ururrada dhallinyarada iyo bulshada rayidka ah. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo guddoomay ubaxa xusuusta ah ayaa si rasmi ah u dhigay taallada, iyadoo la filayo inuu khudbad ka jeediyo munaasabadda, taas oo uu diiradda ku saari doono doorkii ay dhallinyaradii SYL ku lahaayeen xorriyaddii dalka iyo muhiimadda ay leedahay in jiilka maanta uu ka dhaxlo waddaniyaddii iyo midnimadii ay ku caanbaxeen halgamayaashaas. Madaxweynaha ayaa la filayaa in sidoo kale ka hadlo xaaladda ay maanta ku sugan yihiin dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed iyo kaalinta looga baahan yahay inay ka qaataan dib u dhiska dalka, ilaalinta dowladnimada iyo horumarinta nabadda iyo wadajirka bulshada. Wasiir ku-xigeenka dhallinyarada iyo ciyaaraha Soomaaliya, Dahabo Suusow oo munaasabadda ka hadashay ayaa sheegtay in shacabka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan dhallinyarada, ay si weyn u xusuustaan geesiyadii SYL ee u istaagay xorriyadda iyo karaamada ummadda Soomaaliyeed. Waxay tilmaantay in jiilka cusub looga baahan yahay inay ka shaqeeyaan ilaalinta midnimada iyo qaranimada dalka, isla markaana ay ku daydaan halgankii iyo himiladii ay lahaayeen aas-aasayaashii SYL, kuwaas oo ay sheegtay inay naftooda u hureen sidii Soomaaliya u noqon lahayd dal xor ah. Dhankiisa, Guddoomiyaha gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Magaalada Muqdisho, Xasan Maxamed Xuseen Muungaab ayaa munaasabadda ku tilmaamay mid qaran oo lagu xusayo halgamayaal taariikh weyn ku leh Soomaaliya. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sheegay in dhallinyaradii SYL ay si fog u fakareen, una mideysnaayeen badbaadinta dalka iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Muungaab ayaa ugu baaqay shacabka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan dhallinyarada inay ilaashadaan mirihii ka dhashay halgankii SYL iyo xorriyadda maanta jirta. 15-ka May sanadkii 1943-dii ayay ahayd markii la aas-aasay Ururka SYL, oo ay dhiseen dhallinyaro Soomaaliyeed oo u istaagay sidii looga xoroobi lahaa gumaystayaashii kala qaybiyay dalka, iyadoo ugu dambeyn Soomaaliya ay 17 sano kadib heshay madax-bannaanideeda. items.title: Mudug: Dad roob yari ku cayroobay oo xeryo ku yaalla deegaan Xarfo ku wajahaya nolol xumo
items.description: (ERGO) – In ka badan boqol qoys oo abaaraha ku xoolo beelay ayaa xaalado adag oo cunno xumo, biyo yari iyo hoy la’aan ah ku wajahaya xero ku taalla deegaanka Xarfo ee gobolka Mudug. Waxay culeysyadan haystaan tan iyo bishii Fabraayo. Waris Maxamed Cismaan oo ka mid ah ayaa sheegtay inay maarayn la’dahay nolosha carruurteeda oo shan ah. Barakaca ayay maciinsadeen horraantii bishii labaad, markii ay ka le’deen intii ugu danbaysay 120 ari ah oo ay ku tiirsanaayeen. Waxay sheegtay inay keli ku tahay xaaladaan adag oo ilmaheeda aabbahood ay horay u kala tageen. Waxay hal mar karsadaan raashin yar oo ay soo dayntaan, markii loo diidana waxay ku joogaan qatooyo. “Wax raashin ah oo nagu filan oo aan cunno meeshaan ma yaallo. Dad gaajaysan ayaa nahay. Magaalada ayaan ka soo daymanaa kiilooyin. Wax aan halkaan ku haysanno ma jiraan. Waa qadnaa ama wax yar ayaan helnaa.” Waris ayaa tilmaamtay in xerada Ramaas oo ay degan yihiin aysan ka jirin adeegyada biyaha, caafimaadka iyo waxbarashada, taas oo meesha ka saartay filashadoodii ahayd in ay heli doonaan nolol u dhaanta tii ay ka yimaadeen. Xaaladdan ka hor waxay ku jireen nolol wanaagsan. Arigooda – u dhamaaday gaajo iyo haraad, markii ay u waysay biyo iyo calaf –  ayay ka heli jireen nacfi ay isku dabbaraan. Abaarta saamaysay, in aysan lahayn xirfad ay magaalada uga shaqaysato iyo gargaar la’aan ayaa isku raacday. “Awal xoolahayaga ayaan ku tiirsanayn oo gadanaynay oo qalanaynay oo xaaladii hore waa noo fiicnayd ari waxaan haysannay badan oo nagu filan ee abaaraha nadhaafiyay. Raqdiisii ayaan deegaankii uga soo guuray, qaarba mar ayuu dhintay intii shan bilood ah.” Waris ayaa sheegtay in xerada ay degan yihiin aysan lahayn ceel, taas oo ku qasabtay in ay dhabarka uga doonto mid u jira qiyaastii 3 km oo 20 liitar iibiya $0.25 oo aysan awoodin. Ehelkeeda ayaa hal caag u iibiya oo aan ku filnayn. Waxay culays kala kulmaysaa dayn $770 oo inta badan looga leeyahay deegaanka Maygaagle oo ay ka yimaadeen, qaybna ay dukaamo Xarfo ku yaalla raashin uga qaadatay. Waxay sheegtay in joogto loo soo waydiiyo. Waxaa u joogta gabadh neerfaha ka xanuunsan oo aysan ka tagi Karin, haddii ay shaqo magaalada ka raadsan lahayd. Waxay xustay inaysan u awoodin lacag ay uga bixiso daawooyin ay u iibin jirtay intii aysan xooluhu ka dhamaan oo caawin jiray. “Gabadha waa iga xanuunsan tahay oo qallal ayay qabta. Markii ay qalasho geedaha ayay ku dhacaysaa, waxba ma kala oga in ay dhibaato gaarto ayaan uga baqayaa. Wax badan ayayna iga jirran tahay.” Qoyskeeda waxay weligood deganaayeen miyiga tuulada Maygaagle oo hoos tagta degmada Burtinle ee gobolka Nugaal. Barakaca oo ku cusub ayay la qabsan la’yihiin. Abaaraha waxay sababeen in dadka reer guuraaga ah ee ku tiirsanaa xoolaha ay mutaan xaalado adag, kuwaas oo galay xeryo aysan ku haysan nolol badbaado leh. Qoyska Xaawo Cali Xasan oo 11 qof ah waxay xerada Ramaas ee duleedka Xarfo ku wajahayaan cuno xumo. Hal mar ayay si dhib ah dabka ugu shitaan wax yar oo aan joogto ahayn oo ay ku caawiyaan qaraabadooda. Dhaqaale xumada waxaa u raacday in aysan deegaanka cidna ka aqoon oo aysan waxba ka daynsan karin. Tan iyo horraantii bishii Fabraayo oo ay yimaadeen ayay sheegtay in ay marar badan qatooyo ku seexisay carruurteeda oo yar-yar. “Mar waa helnaa marna waa weynaa noloshaas ayaan ku jirnaa. Magaalada adeeg uma doonan karo qofna kama garanayo. Awal deegaankayagii markii wax naga dhamaadaan bakhaaro aan garanayno ayaan ka soo qaadan jirnay oo dib ka bixin jirnay.” Xaawo ayaa sheegtay in tan iyo sanadkii hore ay roob la’aanta uga dhinteen 45 ari ah oo noloshoodu ay ku tiirsanayd, markay u wayday daaq iyo biyo. Waxaa u joogta 5 neef oo wayd ah, kuwaas oo aan cad, caano iyo suuq midna lahayn.  Xoolo beelka ku dhacay ayaa yareeyay rajada ay ka qabto inay ka soo kabsadaan dhibaatadan. Waxay ka soo guureen deegaanka Habar-jiil oo Burtinle hoos taga. Xaawo ayaa sheegtay in ceel-biyoodka ugu dhow uu u jiro qiyastii hal saac oo socod ah. Dusha ayay uga soo qaadaa labo caag oo qoyskeeda aan kaafin karin, kuwaas oo lagu caawiyo. Maalmaha qaar oo ceelku cilladoobo ayay xustay inay oon ku joogaan. “Caqabado ayaa na haysta, dowlad nooma imaan meeshaan iskuul, dugsi iyo biyo midna ma leh. Gaadiid aan ku dhaansano ma haysano. Dad maras ah ayaa nahay. Guryuhu waa buushash jawaano iyo calalo ah oo qorrax iyo dhaxan aan celin.” Xaawo ayaa xustay inay haysato nolol adag oo aysan waligood soo marin. Odaygeeda oo horay dhismaha uga shaqayn jiray ayaa ka waayay shaqooyin xamaal ah oo uu magaalada Xarfo ka raadiyay dhowr mar. Haweeneydan ayaa sheegtay in cadaadis lagu saarayo inay bixiso dayn gaaraysa $500 oo looga leeyahay deegaankii ay ka yimaadeen. Waxay filaysay in ay ku dhiibto xoola markay u doogsadaan, balse dhimashadooda ayaa ka soo hormartay. Shan carruurteeda ah oo gaaray da’da waxbarashada ayaa daruus la’aan ka ah. Horay fursad u helin, balse waxay naawilaysay inay magaalada ugu heli doonaan iskuul, taas oo aan u suuragalin. Faadumo Jaamac Ciis oo ah gudoomiyaha xerada Ramaas oo qoysaskaan ay soo maciin bideen ayaa sheegtay inay ka siman yihiin baahida oo aysan iscaawin karin, iyaguna aysan waxba u awoodin. Waxay soo jeedisay in dadkan laga taageero dhinacyada nolosha ee muhiimka u ah si ay dib mar kale ugu helaan isku filnaansho iyo soo kabasho ay isku maareeyaan. “Hadda in ay oon iyo gaajo u le’daan ayay khatar ugu jiraan. Gabaad ay qoraxda iyo dhaxanta ka galaan ma haystaan. Daruuf waxay ku nool yihiin aysan horay u aqoon oo ku adag, xaquuq ayayna Puntland ku leeyihiin waa in ay qorshe ka yeelato.” Faadumo ayaa sheegtay in haddii aan xal loo helin dadkan ay noloshoodu halis gali karto. Xeradan waxay yimaadeen iyadoo horay ay u joogeen in 350 qoys oo aan ku haysan dhamaan adeegyada aas-aasiga ah, taas oo meesha ka saartay fursadihii nolosha. Dhibaatooyinka ka dhashay xilli roobaadyada gaabiska noqday waxaa ka mid ah inay kordheen dadka barakacay. Xeryaha ay tageen kama helaan nolol wanaagsan, taas oo galisa xaalad ka sii daran middii ay ka soo tageen. Maalmaha qaar oo ceelku cilladoobo ayay xustay inay oon ku joogaan. “Caqabado ayaa na haysta, dowlad nooma imaan meeshaan iskuul, dugsi iyo biyo midna ma leh. Gaadiid aan ku dhaansano ma haysano. Dad maras ah ayaa nahay. Guryuhu waa buushash jawaano iyo calalo ah oo qorrax iyo dhaxan aan celin.” Xaawo ayaa xustay inay haysato nolol adag oo aysan waligood soo marin. Odaygeeda oo horay dhismaha uga shaqayn jiray ayaa ka waayay shaqooyin xamaal ah oo uu magaalada Xarfo ka raadiyay dhowr mar. Haweeneydan ayaa sheegtay in cadaadis lagu saarayo inay bixiso dayn gaaraysa $500 oo looga leeyahay deegaankii ay ka yimaadeen. Waxay filaysay in ay ku dhiibto xoola markay u doogsadaan, balse dhimashadooda ayaa ka soo hormartay. Shan carruurteeda ah oo gaaray da’da waxbarashada ayaa daruus la’aan ka ah. Horay fursad u helin, balse waxay naawilaysay inay magaalada ugu heli doonaan iskuul, taas oo aan u suuragalin. Faadumo Jaamac Ciis oo ah gudoomiyaha xerada Ramaas oo qoysaskaan ay soo maciin bideen ayaa sheegtay inay ka siman yihiin baahida oo aysan iscaawin karin, iyaguna aysan waxba u awoodin. Waxay soo jeedisay in dadkan laga taageero dhinacyada nolosha ee muhiimka u ah si ay dib mar kale ugu helaan isku filnaansho iyo soo kabasho ay isku maareeyaan. “Hadda in ay oon iyo gaajo u le’daan ayay khatar ugu jiraan. Gabaad ay qoraxda iyo dhaxanta ka galaan ma haystaan. Daruuf waxay ku nool yihiin aysan horay u aqoon oo ku adag, xaquuq ayayna Puntland ku leeyihiin waa in ay qorshe ka yeelato.” Faadumo ayaa sheegtay in haddii aan xal loo helin dadkan ay noloshoodu halis gali karto. Xeradan waxay yimaadeen iyadoo horay ay u joogeen in 350 qoys oo aan ku haysan dhamaan adeegyada aas-aasiga ah, taas oo meesha ka saartay fursadihii nolosha. Dhibaatooyinka ka dhashay xilli roobaadyada gaabiska noqday waxaa ka mid ah inay kordheen dadka barakacay. Xeryaha ay tageen kama helaan nolol wanaagsan, taas oo galisa xaalad ka sii daran middii ay ka soo tageen. items.title: Soomaaliya Oo Gashay Marxalad Cusub Kadib Dhammaadka Muddo-Xileedka Dowladda
items.description: Maanta oo taariikhdu tahay 15-ka May ayaa si rasmi ah u dhammaanaya muddo-xileedka afarta sano ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Xilligan ayaa kusoo aadaya iyadoo ay socdaan wada-hadallo u dhaxeeya madaxda dowladda iyo siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka, kuwaas oo looga hadlayo arrimaha doorashooyinka iyo xaaladda siyaasadeed ee dalka. Mucaaradka ayaa dowladda ku cadaadinaya in heshiis laga gaaro nooca doorasho ee dalka lagu geli doono, halka dowladda ay sheegtay inay diyaar u tahay wadahadal iyo is-afgarad siyaasadeed. Sidoo kale, beesha caalamka iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed ayaa si dhow ula socda xaaladda siyaasadeed ee dalka, iyagoo ku baaqaya in khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo wadahadal iyo heshiis.

items.title: Golaha Mustaqbalka Oo Dib U Dhigay Bannaanbaxii Muqdisho
items.description: Xubnaha siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ee ku mideysan Golaha Mustaqbalka ayaa ku dhawaaqay inay dib u dhigeen bannaanbaxii la filayay in maalinta berri ah oo taariikhdu ku beegan tahay 16-ka May uu ka qabsoomo magaalada Muqdisho. Mucaaradka ayaa sheegay inay go’aankaasi qaateen si fursad loo siiyo wada-hadallada socda ee u dhaxeeya madaxda Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo xubno ka tirsan siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka. Bayaan kasoo baxay Golaha Mustaqbalka ayaa lagu sheegay in muhiimad gaar ah la siinayo dadaallada lagu doonayo in heshiis looga gaaro arrimaha doorashooyinka, amniga iyo xaaladda siyaasadeed ee dalka. Sidoo kale, Golaha Mustaqbalka ayaa shacabka ugu baaqay inay muujiyaan dulqaad iyo taageero ku aaddan xal kasta oo wadahadal lagu gaari karo, iyagoo xusay in ay weli ka go’an tahay difaaca xuquuqda shacabka iyo hirgelinta hannaan doorasho oo lagu wada qanacsan yahay.

items.title: Dowladda Ingiriiska oo digniin ka soo saartay SOOMAALIYA
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Ingiriiska ayaa markale cusboonaysiisay digniinta safarka ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo muwaadiniinteeda uga digtay inay u safraan qeybo badan oo kamid ah dalka sababo lagu sheegay xaaladdo amni oo weli taagan. War kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Biritayn ayaa lagu sheegay in dowladdaasi ay mamnuucday dhammaan safarrada aan daruuriga ahayn ee lagu tagayo Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan gobollada Koonfurta iyo qaar kamid ah waqooyiga dalka. Digniinta ayaa si gaar ah u xustay gobollada Togdheer, Sanaag iyo Sool, kuwaas oo lagu tilmaamay deegaanno ay ka jiraan khataro amni, colaado iyo weerarro ay fuliyaan kooxaha argagixisada, gaar ahaan Al-Shabaab. Sidoo kale, warbixinta ayaa lagu sheegay in dagaallada u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Al-Shabaab ay sii xoogeysteen bilihii lasoo dhaafay, gaar ahaan deegaannada ku dhow magaalada Muqdisho iyo gobollada kale ee Koonfurta dalka. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Ingiriiska ayaa sheegtay in khatarta weerarrada argagixiso ay weli sareyso, isla markaana ay suuragal tahay in bartilmaameed laga dhigo goobaha ay isugu yimaadaan dadka rayidka ah, xarumaha dowladda iyo goobaha ganacsiga. Dowladda Britain ayaa sidoo kale uga digtay muwaadiniinteeda in haddii ay go’aansadaan inay sii joogaan Soomaaliya ay yeeshaan qorshe amni iyo mid degdeg ah oo u gaar ah, maadaama aysan si buuxda ugu tiirsanaan karin taageero rasmi ah oo dowladdaasi bixiso marka ay dhacaan xaalado degdeg ah. Digniintan cusub ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli Soomaaliya ay wajahaysa xaalado amni oo cakiran, inkastoo dowladda federaalka ay sheegtay inay guulo ka gaartay dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo sugidda amniga qeybo kamid ah dalka. items.title: SYL: Maxaan ka Baran Karnaa Nidaamkii ay ku Shaqayn Jireen?
items.description: Siddeetan iyo saddex sano ka hor, maanta oo kale, magaalada Muqdisho ma ahayn caasimadda xorta ah ee aynu maanta ku dhex soconno, waxay ahayd xarun gumaysi oo lagu tijaabiyo kalaqaybinta iyo cabburinta dadka Soomaaliyeed. Ma jirin ciidan, ma jirin bangiyo lacageed, mana jirin aqoonsi caalami ah. Waxaase jirtay awood ka xoog badan intaas oo dhan, waxayna ahayd: awood iyo garaad midaysan iyo nidaam wadashaqayneed oo layaab lahaa. 15kii May 1943, maanta oo kale, waxaa dhashay kacdoonkii horseedka ahaa ee ugu weynaa sooyaalka Soomaalida ee Geeska Afrika degen. Somali Youth League (SYL) ma ahayn kaliya xisbi siyaasadeed, balse wuxuu ahaa madal hal-abuureed iyo urur dhallinyaro oo go’aansaday inay beddelaan jihada Sooyaalka. Gogashii ugu horraysay waxaa dhigay 13 dhallinyaro ah oo u dhignaa sida ‘unug sirdoon’ oo midaysan. Laga soo billaabo hoggaamintii Cabdulqaadir Sheekh Sakhaawaddiin, asaasihii Yaasiin Xaaji Cismaan, ilaa dhiirinaantii xubnihii kale sida Maxamed Xirsi Siyaad, Xaaji Maxamed Cabdulle, iyo Dheere Xaaji Dheere. Dhallinyaradan ma ahayn kaliya magacyo ku qoran warqad. Waxay se ahaayeen aqoonyahanno, shaqaale, iyo hal-abuuro isugu yimid inay dumiyaan gidaarka gumaysiga iyo qabyaaladda, iyagoo dhisay nidaam ay ku midoobeen 13kaas xubnood iyo boqollaal kale oo la dhabar-adaygay cadaadiskii gumaysiga. Kacdoonkan, oo uu hormuud u ahaa aqoonyahan Yaasiin Xaaji Cismaan iyo saaxiibbadiis, waxay u dhabar-adaygeen cadaadiskii labadii gumaysi ee isbeddelay. Waxay dhiseen nidaam maamul oo layaab leh, iyaga oo xafiisyo ka furtay dhulka Soomaaliyeed ee shanta ah, iyaga oo adeegsanaya qorshe isku xiran oo ku dhisan: xograadin, iskufillaansho dhaqaale, iyo wacyigelin bulsho. Inkastoo ay ka soo wareegtay wax ku dhow qarni, haddana maanta iskuma hawlayno inaan dib u akhrino taariikhdooda laga wada dharagsan yahay ee caadiga ah ee dugsiyada lagu dhigo. Waxaan rabaa inaan si qotodheer u lafagurno maskaxdii iyo matoorkii ka dambeeyay guusha SYL. Haddaba qodobbada aan ku dul istaagayno sadarradeena soo socdo waxaa ka mid ah: Sidee bay u maareeyeen dhaqaalahooda iyagoon cidna gacanta u fidin? Sidee bay u dhiseen sirdoon shacab oo ka dhex shaqeeya xaafadaha iyo xafiisyada gumaysiga? Sidee bay 13 dhallinyaro ah, oo aan haysan telefishin, raadiye, ama baraha bulshada, ku gaareen in farriintoodu ay gaarto miyi iyo magaalo? Maxayse tahay casharka ay ka baran karaan dhallinyarada maanta ee haysta internedka iyo baraha bulshada iyo agab kasta oo wax suuraggalin kara, balse weli raadinaya jihadii midnimada? Maqaalkan, waxaynu ku qaadaadhigaynaa istaraatiijiyaddii SYL, annagoo ka eegayna nidaamkoodii xeeladaysnaa ee lagula tacaalayay gumaysiga iyo qabyaaladda. Waxaynu adeegsanaynaa xigashooyin aan soo ururinnay iyo baaritaanno dhab ah, si ay noogu soo baxdo sheeko ka duwan sheekooyinkii caadiga ahaa ee SYL ku saabsanaa ee dhegaha dadka ku dhici jiray. Dawlad-hoosaad Dahsoon Baaritaannada casriga ah ee lagu sameeyay nidaamkii SYL, waxay muujinayaan in ururku uu dhisay nidaam loogu yeero dawlad-hoosaad qarsoon oo ka dhex shaqaynayay maamulkii gumaysiga. Dadkaas ku dhex beernaa xafiisyadii gumaysiga ma ahayn uun inay xogta keeni jireen, balse waxay gaareen heer ay faro-geliyaan go’aannada gumaysiga, iyaga oo adeegsanaya farsamooyin doqon-magarato ah. Sarkaal sirdoon oo Biritish ah oo la dhaho Major A.S. Pankhurst, ayaa ku qoray buuggiisa “Ex-Italian Somaliland” oo la baahiyay sannadkii 1951: “Ururka SYL wuxuu lahaa laan sirdoon oo layaab leh. Karraaniyiinta Soomaaliyeed ee xafiisyadayada u fadhiya waxay ahaayeen kuwo daacad u ah ururkooda in ka badan intay noo ahaayeen. Amarrada aan soo saarno waxay gaari jireen xarunta ururka kahor intaanan saxiixin.” Bishii Nofeenbar 1947dii, markii guddigii afargeesoodka ahaa ay imanayeen Muqdisho, SYL waxay horay u haysay dhammaan ajandayaashii sirta ahaa ee gumaysigu rabay inuu ku huriya qabaa’ilka, si looga soo horjeesto xornimada. Sidoo kale, gumaysigu wuxuu adeegsaday wax loogu yeero Borobogaando, si uu u tuso in Soomaalidu tahay dad aan is xukumi karin. SYL waxay ku jawaabtay xeeladda Qabyaalad-nacaybka. Aqoonyahan ku xeeldheer cilmiga siyaasadda ee Saadia Touval, oo u dhashay dalka Yuugoslaafiya oo maanta ah dalka Kroeeshiya, asalkiisuna yahay Yuhuudi ayaa ku xusay buuggiisa caanka ah ee “Somali Nationalism” oo la daabacay sannadkii 1963: “SYL waxay ku guulaysatay inay qabyaaladda u beddesho wax laga xishoodo. Waxay dhiseen nidaam qofka ka dhigaya inuu dareemo in waddaniyadu ay tahay heerka ugu sarreeya ee ilbaxnimada, halka qabiilku yahay dib-u-dhac.” Xeeladda qabyaaladnacaybka waxay ahayd silsilad lagu furfurayo fikirka xagjirka ah ee qabiilka. Sannadkii 1948, xilligii kacdoonkii “Ha Nolaato,” SYL waxay adeegsatay suugaan iyo khudbado lagu magacaabay “Dhimashada Qabyaaladda” si looga hortago sheekada gumaysiga ee la soo dhexmarinayay odayaal dhaqameedyada la iibsaday. Sidoo kale, maqaallo badan oo laga qoray doorka haweenka ayaa muujinaya in haweenku ay ahaayeen kuwa indhaha ku haya dhaqdhaqaaqa gumaystaha. Professor Mohamed Haji Mukhtar, ayaa ku qoray maqaalkiisa “The Emergence and Role of Political Parties in the Inter-River Region of Somalia”  oo la baahiyay sannadkii 1989: “Haweenka Soomaaliyeed waxay SYL u ahaayeen isha ugu weyn ee xogta. Waxay dhex gali jireen xeryaha ciidanka gumaysiga iyaga oo iska dhigaya kuwo caano iibinaya, waxayna keeni jireen xog sugan oo ku saabsan tirada ciidanka iyo goobaha ay ku wajahan yihiin.” Bishii Oktoobar 1949, markii Qaramada Midoobay ay ka doodayeen masiirka Soomaaliya, haweenka Muqdisho waxay dhiseen shabakado sirdoon oo farriimaha u kala gudbiya unugyada qarsoon ee ururka, si looga warhayo dhaqdhaqaaqa ciidanka Talyaaniga ee raba inay caburiyaan mudaaharaadyada. Markaan eegno nidaamkan, casharka ugu weyn ee aan ka baran karno  maanta waa: Si aad u jebiso fikir kasta oo khaldan waa inaad marka hore dhisataa sirdoon shacab oo ku dhex milan bulshada, kadibna aad keenta sheeko ka duwan midka jira oo midnimo iyo is-aqoonsi ku dhisan. Warbaahin Aan Hirar Gaagaaban iyo Kuwo Dhaadheer Midna Lahayn Bishii Maaj 1943, xubnihii aasaasay SYL waxaa hor yaallay caqabad weyn. Taas oo ahayd sida  loola hadli lahaa shacab 95% miyi deggan, aan waxna qorin waxna akhrin, isla markaasna aan haysan telefishin, raadiyow, ama wargeysyo madaxbannaan. Waxay hindiseen nidaam isgaarsiineed oo ku dhisan hiddaha iyo dhaqanka, kaas oo gumaysigu u waayay hab uu ku caburiyo ama ku joojiyo. Suugaanta, gaar ahaan gabayga, buraanburka, iyo heesta, waxay ahaayeen aaladda kaliya ee xogta lagu kaydiyo laguna faafiyo. Gabaygu ma ahayn oo kaliya madadaallo, wuxuu sidoo kale ahaa xog buuxda oo la isu gudbiyo. Markii SYL ay soo saarto farriin cusub, waxaa loo dhiibi jiray gabyaaga ururka. Gabaygaas oo xambaarsan farriin siyaasadeed sida midnimada ama diidmada canshuurta gumaysiga ayaa waxaa xifdin jiray dadka socotada ah iyo kuwa degaannada kala duwan u kala goosha. Professor Said S. Samatar, ayaa ku qoray buuggiisa caanka ah ee “Oral Poetry and Somali Nationalism” oo la baahiyay sannadkii 1982: “Gabaygu wuxuu Soomaalida u ahaa ‘Mass Media’. Markii gabay lagu tiriyo Muqdisho, waxaa looga celin jiray fagaarayaasha magaalooyinka fogfog, sida Gaalkacyo ama Jigjiga muddo maalmo gudaheed, iyadoo dadku ay u faafinayeen sidii mowjadaha raadiyaha.” SYL waxay adeegsatay nidaamka wadaxiriirka baahsan ah (horizontal communication), halkaas oo xubin kasta uu ahaa idaacad iskeed u socota oo farriinta gaarsiisa qofka ay isku heerka yihiin, taas oo meesha ka saartay baahidii loo qabay qalab isgaarsiineed oo heer sare. Bishii Abriil 1947, xilli ururku uu isu diyaarinayay imaanshaha Guddiga Afargeesoodka, waxay dejiyeen nidaam ah in xubin kasta oo ururka ka tirsan uu u qaabilsan yahay 10 qof oo kale. Tani waxay sahashay in hal habeen gudaheed farriin lagu gaarsiiyo kumanaan qof iyada oo aan hal waraaqo la qorin. Taariikhyahanka Sheekh Jaamac Cumar Ciise, ayaa ku xusay buuggiisa “Taariikhda Soomaaliya” oo qaybo kamid ah la baahiyay sannadkii 1976: “SYL ma lahayn raadiye, balse waxay lahaayeen ‘Codka Shacabka’. Farriimaha ururka waxaa lagu kala qaadan jiray goobaha ay dadku isugu yimaadaan sida Masaajidda, Ceelasha biyaha, iyo Shirarka reer miyiga, taas oo ka dhigtay mid aan gumaysigu xannibi karin.” Markii gumaysigu uu bilaabay inuu adeegsado raadiyaha sida Radio Mogadishu, si uu dadka u kala qaybiyo, SYL waxay billowday raadiyow shacab oo ku dhisan heesaha waddaniga ah. Tusaale, Heesta caanka ah ee “Soomaaliyeey Toosa” oo qoraalkeedii ugu horreeyay soo baxay qiyaastii 1947, waxay ahayd mid ka kooban casharro ku saabsan taariikhda, dhibaatada gumaysiga, iyo muhiimadda midnimada. Heestaas waxay gaartay miyi iyo magaalo, waxayna beddeshay habfikir badan oo qabyaalad ku dhisnaa. Bishii Janaayo 1948dii, xilligii kacdoonkii “Ha Nolaato,” farriintii lagu abaabulayay dadka waxay ku faaftay guud ahaan gobollada koonfureed muddo kooban, iyadoo SYL ay u adeegsatay nidaamka uu qofba qofka kale u gudbinayay xogta, taas oo keentay in warku gaaro miyi iyo magaalo iyadoo aan la adeegsan idaacad ama wargays, taas oo aad uga dheeraysay farriimihii gumaysiga. Haddaba, Dhallinyarada maanta ee haysta internedka, Fiber Optic-ga, iyo baraha bulshada, SYL waxay u haysaa cashar weyn oo ah: “Aaladda isgaarsiintu maaha waxa guusha keena, balse waa nuxurka farriinta iyo sida uu u aaminsan yahay qofka faafinaya. Xafiisyada ururka ee laga furayay gobollada dalka looma iibsan jirin qalab qaali ah; xubnaha ayaa keeni jiray kuraasta, miisaska, iyo guriga lagu shaqaynayo. Taariikhyahankii Biritishka ahaa ee I.M. Lewis, ayaa ku xusay buuggiisa “A Modern History of Somalia” oo la daabacay 1965: “SYL waxay si adag u diiday inay gacanta u fidiso gumaysiga ama quwadaha kale, iyagoo u arkayay in kaalmada dibadda ay tahay silsilad kale oo lagu addoonsado rabitaanka dadka.” Markii guddigii afargeesoodka ahaa ay weydiiyeen hoggaanka SYL sannadkii 1948 halka ay lacagta ka keenaan, waxay ugu jawaabeen: “Lacagtan waxaa iska leh dadka Soomaaliyeed, iyagaa iska soo ururiyay si ay xornimadooda u iibsadaan.” Haddaba, dhallinyarada maanta ee inta badan sugaya mashaariic dibadda laga maalgaliyo si ay u fuliyaan isbeddel, SYL waxay u haysaa cashar dahabi oo ah: “ Haddii aad rabto inaad lahaato go’aan madax-bannaan, waa inaad marka hore yeelataa dhaqaale madax-bannaan. Isku-fillaanshaha maaliyadeed waa gidaarka kaa difaaca ururka in la iibsado ama laga weeciyo hadafkiisa dhabta ah.” Bishii March 1943, 13-kii dhallinyaro ee yagleelay SYL ma ay haysan wax kamid ah agabka ay dhallinyarada maanta u arkaan inay fure u yihiin isbeddelka. Ma jirin internet, ma jirin baraha bulshada, xitaa ma jirin aqoonsi rasmi ah. Haddaba, sidee bay 83 sano kahor u ruxeen adduunka, halka dhallinyarada maanta ay weli raadinayaan jihadii midnimada? SYL waxay fahansanaayeen in internedka iyo baraha bulshada ee maanta la haysto ay yihiin uun Aalado, balse aanay ahayn Hadafka rasmiga ah. Casharka weyn waa in hadafku uu ka horreeyo aaladda. Professor David D. Laitin, ayaa ku qoray buuggiisa “Politics, Language, and Thought: The Somali Experience” oo la baahiyay sannadkii 1977: “Guusha SYL salku kuma hayn qalab ay haysteen, balse waxay ku dhisnayd awooddooda ay ku midayn kareen dad kala fog, iyaga oo adeegsanaya hal farriin oo qof kastaa dhuuxay. Waxay beddeleen maskaxda dadka kahor intaysan beddelin maamulka.” Dhanka kale, 13kii wiil waxay isku dhaarsadeen masiirka ummadda. Dhallinyarada maanta waxay u baahan yihiin inay ka gudbaan halganka baraha bulshada uun ku eg oo ay u guuraan wada-shaqayn dhab ah oo ka baxsan shaashadaha. Tusaale, markii SYL ay unugyada ka dhisayeen gobollada, waxay ku dhisaayeen kalsooni qofba qofka kale u qaadayay. Maanta, dhallinyaradu waxay ku lumiyaan wakhti badan doodo aan miradhal ahayn, taas oo sii fogaysay midnimada. Sida lagu xusay maqaalka cilmi-baarista ah ee “The Somali Youth League: A Study in Political Development” oo la baahiyay bishii Diseenbar 1960 ee ku soo baxay majalladda The Journal of Modern African Studies : “Dhallinyaradii SYL waxay dhiseen urur ka madaxbannaan dano shaqsi iyo mid qabiil. Maanta, casharka SYL nooga tagtay waa in horumarku billawdo markii la aaso “Reer Hebel” laguna beddelo “Qaran Hebel.” Taariikhyahan Sheekh Jaamac Cumar Ciise, ayaa ku xusay xusuusqorkiisa: “SYL waxay tustay Soomaalida in markii qofka uu iska saaro heeryada qabiilka, uu noqonayo mid aan la jabin karin.” Maanta dhallinyaradu waxay haystaan tignoolajiyad, balse waxay u baahan yihiin garaadkii SYL si ay u isticmaalaan. Gunaanadkii, siddeetan iyo saddex sano ka dib, SYL noogama dhiman diiwaanno taariikheed oo kaliya, waxay se nooga tagtay habdhismeed shaqaynaya oo haddii aan dib u baarno, kuna salayno duruufaheena, aynu ku xallin karno caqabadaha maanta. Dhallinyarada maanta waxay u baahan yihiin inay dib u furaan buuggii SYL, iyaga oo ka dhex akhrisanaya: ·      Dhismaha midnimo ku dhisan kalsooni dhab ah. · Yagleelidda hannaan dhaqaale oo madaxbannaan. ·      Abuuridda fikir ka xoog badan kan cadowga. Haddii 13kii dhallinyaro ee SYL ay dalka ka samatabixiyeen gumaysiga, iyagoo socodbarad ah oo aan haysan dhaqaale buuran iyo tignoolajiyad casri ah, maxaa hortaagan dhallinyarta maanta ee dunidu u fududaatay ee aqoon iyo isgaarsiinba haysta?

Ma jirin ciidan, ma jirin bangiyo lacageed, mana jirin aqoonsi caalami ah. Waxaase jirtay awood ka xoog badan intaas oo dhan, waxayna ahayd: awood iyo garaad midaysan iyo nidaam wadashaqayneed oo layaab lahaa. 15kii May 1943, maanta oo kale, waxaa dhashay kacdoonkii horseedka ahaa ee ugu weynaa sooyaalka Soomaalida ee Geeska Afrika degen. Somali Youth League (SYL) ma ahayn kaliya xisbi siyaasadeed, balse wuxuu ahaa madal hal-abuureed iyo urur dhallinyaro oo go’aansaday inay beddelaan jihada Sooyaalka. Gogashii ugu horraysay waxaa dhigay 13 dhallinyaro ah oo u dhignaa sida ‘unug sirdoon’ oo midaysan. Laga soo billaabo hoggaamintii Cabdulqaadir Sheekh Sakhaawaddiin, asaasihii Yaasiin Xaaji Cismaan, ilaa dhiirinaantii xubnihii kale sida Maxamed Xirsi Siyaad, Xaaji Maxamed Cabdulle, iyo Dheere Xaaji Dheere. Dhallinyaradan ma ahayn kaliya magacyo ku qoran warqad. Waxay se ahaayeen aqoonyahanno, shaqaale, iyo hal-abuuro isugu yimid inay dumiyaan gidaarka gumaysiga iyo qabyaaladda, iyagoo dhisay nidaam ay ku midoobeen 13kaas xubnood iyo boqollaal kale oo la dhabar-adaygay cadaadiskii gumaysiga. Kacdoonkan, oo uu hormuud u ahaa aqoonyahan Yaasiin Xaaji Cismaan iyo saaxiibbadiis, waxay u dhabar-adaygeen cadaadiskii labadii gumaysi ee isbeddelay. Waxay dhiseen nidaam maamul oo layaab leh, iyaga oo xafiisyo ka furtay dhulka Soomaaliyeed ee shanta ah, iyaga oo adeegsanaya qorshe isku xiran oo ku dhisan: xograadin, iskufillaansho dhaqaale, iyo wacyigelin bulsho. Inkastoo ay ka soo wareegtay wax ku dhow qarni, haddana maanta iskuma hawlayno inaan dib u akhrino taariikhdooda laga wada dharagsan yahay ee caadiga ah ee dugsiyada lagu dhigo. Waxaan rabaa inaan si qotodheer u lafagurno maskaxdii iyo matoorkii ka dambeeyay guusha SYL. Haddaba qodobbada aan ku dul istaagayno sadarradeena soo socdo waxaa ka mid ah: Sidee bay u maareeyeen dhaqaalahooda iyagoon cidna gacanta u fidin? Sidee bay u dhiseen sirdoon shacab oo ka dhex shaqeeya xaafadaha iyo xafiisyada gumaysiga? Sidee bay 13 dhallinyaro ah, oo aan haysan telefishin, raadiye, ama baraha bulshada, ku gaareen in farriintoodu ay gaarto miyi iyo magaalo? Maxayse tahay casharka ay ka baran karaan dhallinyarada maanta ee haysta internedka iyo baraha bulshada iyo agab kasta oo wax suuraggalin kara, balse weli raadinaya jihadii midnimada? Maqaalkan, waxaynu ku qaadaadhigaynaa istaraatiijiyaddii SYL, annagoo ka eegayna nidaamkoodii xeeladaysnaa ee lagula tacaalayay gumaysiga iyo qabyaaladda. Waxaynu adeegsanaynaa xigashooyin aan soo ururinnay iyo baaritaanno dhab ah, si ay noogu soo baxdo sheeko ka duwan sheekooyinkii caadiga ahaa ee SYL ku saabsanaa ee dhegaha dadka ku dhici jiray. Dawlad-hoosaad Dahsoon Baaritaannada casriga ah ee lagu sameeyay nidaamkii SYL, waxay muujinayaan in ururku uu dhisay nidaam loogu yeero dawlad-hoosaad qarsoon oo ka dhex shaqaynayay maamulkii gumaysiga. Dadkaas ku dhex beernaa xafiisyadii gumaysiga ma ahayn uun inay xogta keeni jireen, balse waxay gaareen heer ay faro-geliyaan go’aannada gumaysiga, iyaga oo adeegsanaya farsamooyin doqon-magarato ah. Sarkaal sirdoon oo Biritish ah oo la dhaho Major A.S. Pankhurst, ayaa ku qoray buuggiisa “Ex-Italian Somaliland” oo la baahiyay sannadkii 1951: “Ururka SYL wuxuu lahaa laan sirdoon oo layaab leh. Karraaniyiinta Soomaaliyeed ee xafiisyadayada u fadhiya waxay ahaayeen kuwo daacad u ah ururkooda in ka badan intay noo ahaayeen. Amarrada aan soo saarno waxay gaari jireen xarunta ururka kahor intaanan saxiixin.” Bishii Nofeenbar 1947dii, markii guddigii afargeesoodka ahaa ay imanayeen Muqdisho, SYL waxay horay u haysay dhammaan ajandayaashii sirta ahaa ee gumaysigu rabay inuu ku huriya qabaa’ilka, si looga soo horjeesto xornimada. Sidoo kale, gumaysigu wuxuu adeegsaday wax loogu yeero Borobogaando, si uu u tuso in Soomaalidu tahay dad aan is xukumi karin. SYL waxay ku jawaabtay xeeladda Qabyaalad-nacaybka. Aqoonyahan ku xeeldheer cilmiga siyaasadda ee Saadia Touval, oo u dhashay dalka Yuugoslaafiya oo maanta ah dalka Kroeeshiya, asalkiisuna yahay Yuhuudi ayaa ku xusay buuggiisa caanka ah ee “Somali Nationalism” oo la daabacay sannadkii 1963: “SYL waxay ku guulaysatay inay qabyaaladda u beddesho wax laga xishoodo. Warbaahin Aan Hirar Gaagaaban iyo Kuwo Dhaadheer Midna Lahayn Bishii Maaj 1943, xubnihii aasaasay SYL waxaa hor yaallay caqabad weyn. Lewis, ayaa ku xusay buuggiisa “A Modern History of Somalia” oo la daabacay 1965: “SYL waxay si adag u diiday inay gacanta u fidiso gumaysiga ama quwadaha kale, iyagoo u arkayay in kaalmada dibadda ay tahay silsilad kale oo lagu addoonsado rabitaanka dadka.” Markii guddigii afargeesoodka ahaa ay weydiiyeen hoggaanka SYL sannadkii 1948 halka ay lacagta ka keenaan, waxay ugu jawaabeen: “Lacagtan waxaa iska leh dadka Soomaaliyeed, iyagaa iska soo ururiyay si ay xornimadooda u iibsadaan.” Haddaba, dhallinyarada maanta ee inta badan sugaya mashaariic dibadda laga maalgaliyo si ay u fuliyaan isbeddel, SYL waxay u haysaa cashar dahabi oo ah: “ Haddii aad rabto inaad lahaato go’aan madax-bannaan, waa inaad marka hore yeelataa dhaqaale madax-bannaan. Isku-fillaanshaha maaliyadeed waa gidaarka kaa difaaca ururka in la iibsado ama laga weeciyo hadafkiisa dhabta ah.” Bishii March 1943, 13-kii dhallinyaro ee yagleelay SYL ma ay haysan wax kamid ah agabka ay dhallinyarada maanta u arkaan inay fure u yihiin isbeddelka. Ma jirin internet, ma jirin baraha bulshada, xitaa ma jirin aqoonsi rasmi ah. Haddaba, sidee bay 83 sano kahor u ruxeen adduunka, halka dhallinyarada maanta ay weli raadinayaan jihadii midnimada? SYL waxay fahansanaayeen in internedka iyo baraha bulshada ee maanta la haysto ay yihiin uun Aalado, balse aanay ahayn Hadafka rasmiga ah. Casharka weyn waa in hadafku uu ka horreeyo aaladda. Professor David D. Laitin, ayaa ku qoray buuggiisa “Politics, Language, and Thought: The Somali Experience” oo la baahiyay sannadkii 1977: “Guusha SYL salku kuma hayn qalab ay haysteen, balse waxay ku dhisnayd awooddooda ay ku midayn kareen dad kala fog, iyaga oo adeegsanaya hal farriin oo qof kastaa dhuuxay. Waxay beddeleen maskaxda dadka kahor intaysan beddelin maamulka.” Dhanka kale, 13kii wiil waxay isku dhaarsadeen masiirka ummadda. Dhallinyarada maanta waxay u baahan yihiin inay ka gudbaan halganka baraha bulshada uun ku eg oo ay u guuraan wada-shaqayn dhab ah oo ka baxsan shaashadaha. Tusaale, markii SYL ay unugyada ka dhisayeen gobollada, waxay ku dhisaayeen kalsooni qofba qofka kale u qaadayay. Maanta, dhallinyaradu waxay ku lumiyaan wakhti badan doodo aan miradhal ahayn, taas oo sii fogaysay midnimada. Sida lagu xusay maqaalka cilmi-baarista ah ee “The Somali Youth League: A Study in Political Development” oo la baahiyay bishii Diseenbar 1960 ee ku soo baxay majalladda The Journal of Modern African Studies : “Dhallinyaradii SYL waxay dhiseen urur ka madaxbannaan dano shaqsi iyo mid qabiil. Xubnuhu waxay dareemayeen inay qayb ka yihiin wax iyaga ka weyn, taas oo ahayd sirta ay ku fashiliyeen isku-dayadii gumaysiga.” SYL waxay qabyaaladda u arkayeen gumaysi labaad. Maanta, casharka SYL nooga tagtay waa in horumarku billawdo markii la aaso “Reer Hebel” laguna beddelo “Qaran Hebel.” Taariikhyahan Sheekh Jaamac Cumar Ciise, ayaa ku xusay xusuusqorkiisa: “SYL waxay tustay Soomaalida in markii qofka uu iska saaro heeryada qabiilka, uu noqonayo mid aan la jabin karin.” Maanta dhallinyaradu waxay haystaan tignoolajiyad, balse waxay u baahan yihiin garaadkii SYL si ay u isticmaalaan. Gunaanadkii, siddeetan iyo saddex sano ka dib, SYL noogama dhiman diiwaanno taariikheed oo kaliya, waxay se nooga tagtay habdhismeed shaqaynaya oo haddii aan dib u baarno, kuna salayno duruufaheena, aynu ku xallin karno caqabadaha maanta. Dhallinyarada maanta waxay u baahan yihiin inay dib u furaan buuggii SYL, iyaga oo ka dhex akhrisanaya: ·      Dhismaha midnimo ku dhisan kalsooni dhab ah. · Yagleelidda hannaan dhaqaale oo madaxbannaan. ·      Abuuridda fikir ka xoog badan kan cadowga. Haddii 13kii dhallinyaro ee SYL ay dalka ka samatabixiyeen gumaysiga, iyagoo socodbarad ah oo aan haysan dhaqaale buuran iyo tignoolajiyad casri ah, maxaa hortaagan dhallinyarta maanta ee dunidu u fududaatay ee aqoon iyo isgaarsiinba haysta?

items.title: Xog: Saciid Deni oo dayro kala kulmay Imaaraadka, ogol muddo kordhinta Xasan
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Puntland, Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni, oo magaalada Muqdisho uga qeybgalaya shirka u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo mucaaradka, ayaa lagu soo warramayaa inuu muddo-kordhin loo sameeyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud u arko fursad siyaasadeed oo dani ku qasbeyso. Ilo aad ugu dhow Deni ayaa Caasimada Online u sheegay in madaxweynaha Puntland, oo xiriir dhow la leh dowladda Imaaraadka Carabta, uu xilligan wajahayo caqabad dhaqaale oo saameyn ku yeelan karta ololihiisa doorashada madaxtinimada Soomaaliya. Ilahan ayaa sheegay in Imaaraadka Carabta uu Deni u caddeeyay inuusan xilligan awoodin inuu dhaqaale ku bixiyo ololihiisa doorashada, sababo la xiriira culeysyo dhaqaale iyo amni oo ka dhashay xiisadaha Bariga Dhexe, gaar ahaan dagaalladii iyo kacsanaantii la xiriirtay Iiraan iyo xulafada Mareykanka. Sida ay ilahaasi sheegeen, Abu Dhabi ayaa Deni ku wargelisay in aysan xilligan haysan dhaqaale badan oo loogu talagalay hawlgallo siyaasadeed oo dibadda ah, taas oo hoos u dhigtay rajadii uu ka qabay in lagu taageero ololihiisa doorashada soo socota. Arrintan ayaa la sheegay inay Deni ku riixeyso inuu doorbido in dowladda federaalka loo kordhiyo muddo u dhexeysa sanad iyo sanad iyo bar, si uu waqti ugu helo inuu dib u dhiso qorshihiisa siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaalihii uu ku gali lahaa doorashada madaxtinimada Soomaaliya. Saciid Deni ayaa, sida ay ilo siyaasadeed sheegayaan, rajeynaya in xaaladda Bariga Dhexe ay is beddesho, isla markaana dhaqaalaha Imaaraadka uu dib u xasilo, taas oo suuragal ka dhigi karta in uu helo taageero dhaqaale oo uu ku galo tartanka doorashada madaxtinimada. Imaaraadka ayaa sanadihii u dambeeyay wajahday culeysyo siyaasadeed iyo amni oo ka dhashay faragelinteeda gobolka, laga bilaabo Yemen ilaa Soomaaliya iyo Suudaan. Ka bixitaankeeda qeybo ka mid ah Yemen iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyadii laga soo sheegay saldhigga Boosaaso ayaa loo arkay dib-u-habeyn ku timid istiraatiijiyaddeeda gobolka. Dhinaca kale, madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo, ayaa la sheegay inuu fursad siyaasadeed u arko caqabadaha dhaqaale ee soo food saaray garabka Saciid Deni. Farmaajo ayaa si adag uga soo horjeeda muddo-kordhin loo sameeyo dowladda federaalka, iyadoo muddo-xileedka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh lagu sheegay inuu ku eg yahay 15-ka May. Ilo siyaasadeed ayaa sheegaya in Farmaajo uu haysto keyd dhaqaale oo uu ku geli karo doorashada soo socota haddii dhinacyadu ku heshiiyaan hannaan doorasho oo degdeg ah. Taas ayaa ka dhigeysa inuu daneynayo in doorashada la qabto sida ugu dhaqsaha badan, halkii dowladda hadda jirta loo sameyn lahaa muddo-kordhin. Shirka ka socda magaalada Muqdisho ee u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo mucaaradka ayaa laga sugayaa go’aanno masiiri ah oo saameyn ku yeelan kara jihada siyaasadda dalka. Waxaa si weyn loo hadal hayaa in dhinacyadu ka gaari karaan heshiis ku saabsan doorasho la isla oggol yahay iyo muddo farsamo oo dowladda loogu daro, taas oo lagu sheegay inay noqon karto hal sano. The post Xog: Saciid Deni oo dayro kala kulmay Imaaraadka, ogol muddo kordhinta Xasan appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Maamul cusub oo lagaga dhawaaqay Koonfur Bari Ee Somalia
Magacaabista Nadaara oo horey uga tirsanaa Shabaab oo dhalisay su’aalo culus
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa xil muhiim ah u magacaabay Ibraahim Aadan Ibraahim, oo loo yaqaanno Nadaara, kaas oo horay uga tirsanaa kooxda Al-Shabaab, sida ay sheegayaan ilo siyaasadeed iyo warar hore oo laga qoray taariikhdiisa. Ibraahim Nadaara ayaa loo magacaabay Agaasimaha Guud ee Shaqaalaha iyo Taakuleynta Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga, xil loo arko mid muhiim ah marka la eego kaalinta wasaaraddaas kaga jirto dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo maamulka arrimaha ciidanka. Magacaabistan ayaa dhalisay dood siyaasadeed iyo mid amni, maadaama Nadaara lagu tilmaamo mas’uul hore xilal uga soo qabtay Al-Shabaab, gaar ahaan deegaannada Bay iyo Bakool, ka hor inta uusan sheegay inuu ka baxay kooxdaas. Kadib markii uu ka soo goostay Al-Shabaab, dowladda federaalka ayaa Nadaara siisay xilal kala duwan. Waxaa horay loogu magacaabay Agaasime Ku-xigeenka Xarunta Qaran ee Tubsan, oo loo sameeyay ka hortagga iyo la dagaallanka fikradaha xagjirka ah ee rabshadaha wata. Xaruntaas ayaa sidoo kale door ku leh baxnaaninta, hubinta iyo dib-u-dhexgalka dadka ka soo baxa kooxaha xagjirka ah. Nadaara ayaa sidoo kale muddooyinkii dambe ahaa Agaasimaha Guud ee Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka, taas oo ka mid ahayd xilalka ugu sarreeya ee uu dowladda ka qabtay tan iyo markii uu ka soo baxay Al-Shabaab. Magacaabistiisa cusub ayaa dib u furtay su’aal muddo taagneyd oo ku saabsan sida dowladda federaalka ula tacaasho xubnaha ka soo goosta Al-Shabaab, gaar ahaan marka loo dhiibayo xilal dowladeed oo xasaasi ah. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa muddo dheer ku dhiirrigelinaysay xubnaha Al-Shabaab inay isa soo dhiibaan, taas oo qayb ka ah istiraatiijiyadda lagu wiiqayo kooxda. Hase yeeshee, dadka dhaliilsan habkaas waxay ku doodaan in barnaamijka dib-u-dhexgalka uusan mar walba la socon hufnaan, isla xisaabtan iyo nidaam dadweynuhu ku kalsoonaan karo. Dhaliilaha ugu waaweyn ayaa ah in dadka ka soo baxa Al-Shabaab mararka qaar si degdeg ah loogu abaalmariyo xilal iyo shaqooyin dowladeed, iyadoo aan si cad loo sheegin doorkii ay kooxda ku lahaayeen, in lala xisaabtamay iyo in si buuxda loo hubiyay inay ka tanaasuleen fikirkii ay horay u aaminsanaayeen. Dadka diidan magacaabista noocan ah waxay sheegayaan in aan la diidaneyn in qof ka soo goostay Al-Shabaab la baxnaaniyo ama bulshada dib loogu soo celiyo, balse ay tahay in la caddeeyo marxaladihii uu soo maray, heerka hubinta lagu sameeyay iyo sababta loogu aaminayo xilal muhiim ah. Ilaa hadda dowladda federaalka kama bixin faahfaahin ku saabsan habraaca loo maray magacaabista Nadaara, heerka hubinta amni ee lagu sameeyay iyo sababta loogu arkay inuu ku habboon yahay xilkan cusub. items.title: Xog: Sacuudiga oo riixaya heshiis taariikhi oo lala galo Iiraan lana mid ah kii Helsink
items.description: Riaydh (Caasimada Online) – Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa soo jeedisay qorshe heshiis is-weerarid la’aan ah oo dhexmara Iiraan iyo dalalka Bariga Dhexe. Qorshahan oo salka ku haya heshiis taariikhi ah oo xilligii Dagaalkii Qaboobaa dejiyay xiisadihii ka aloosnaa qaaradda Yurub sanadihii 1970-meeyadii, ayaa lagu daabacay warbixin uu Khamiistii baahiyay wargeyska The Financial Times . Dadaalladan diblomaasiyadeed ee xukuumadda Riyadh ayaa taageero buuxda ka helay waddamada iyo hay’adaha Midowga Yurub. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, weli ma cadda in Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ay garab istaagi doonaan qorshahan. Dhanka kale, Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa qaatay mowqif adag oo ka dhan ah Iiraan, isagoo si weyn ugu sii dhawaaday Israa’iil tan iyo markii uu qarxay dagaalka Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ay ku qaadeen Tehran. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa qaab-dhismeedka heshiiskan ka minguurisay Heshiiskii Helsinki ee sanadkii 1975-kii, kaas oo ay wada saxiixdeen Midowgii Soofiyeeti iyo xulafadiisii, Mareykanka, iyo dalalka Yurub. Heshiiskaas wuxuu xilligaas horseeday in la aqbalo xuduudihii Yurub ee Dagaalkii Labaad ee Adduunka kadib, iyadoo dhinacyadu ay isku raaceen ixtiraamka xuquuqda aadanaha iyo iskaashiga arrimaha dhaqaalaha, sayniska, iyo bini’aadanimada. Diblomaasi Carbeed oo la hadlay The Financial Times ayaa xusay in heshiis noocan oo kale ah oo laga hirgeliyo Bariga Dhexe ay si weyn u soo dhaweyn doonaan “inta badan dalalka Carabta iyo kuwa Islaamka, iyo sidoo kale Iiraan.” Xukuumadda Tehran ayaa dhankeeda horay ugu baaqday dalalka Khaliijka inay albaabada u laabaan saldhigyada milateri ee Mareykanku ku leeyahay gobolka. Waa mid adag in Israa’iil ay oggolaato heshiis kasta oo rasmi ah oo la doonayo in lagu qaboojiyo xiisadda u dhaxaysa dalalka Carabta iyo Iiraan. Sidoo kale, weli lama saadaalin karo sida ay Washington u aragto tallaabadan. Caqabadaha hortaagan heshiiskan waxaa ka mid ah sida laga yeelayo arrimaha xasaasiga ah, sida marinka istaraatiijiga ah ee Hormuz. Iiraan ayaa doonaysa inay saameyn buuxda ku yeelato marinkan, waxayna dhawaan soo rogtay nidaam iyada u gaar ah oo lagu maamulo isu-socodka badda, kaas oo ay ku jirto in canshuur laga qaado maraakiibta. Sacuudi Carabiya iyo dalalka kale ee Gacanka ayaa horay olole ugu galay in Mareykanku uusan weerarin Iiraan, iyagoo aaminsanaa in dagaalku uu Iiraan dhaawici doono balse uusan xididada u siibi doonin, taas beddelkeedana ay xukuumadda Islaamiga ah awoodeeda sii haysan doonto iyadoo ka sii dhiirran sidii hore. Warbixin sirdoon oo ka soo baxday hay’adda CIA-da Mareykanka ayaa muujinaysa in cabsidaas dalalka Khaliijku ay rumowday. Dukumiintiga ayaa xaqiijinaya in Iiraan ay weli haysato inta badan kaydkeedii gantaallada ballistic-ga ee dagaalka kahor, dowladduna aysan muujineyn wax calaamado burbur ah. Waddamada Gacanka ayaa si weyn isugu khilaafay qaabka looga falcelinayo dagaalka. Iiraan ayaa kumannaan gantaal iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn (drones) ku garaacday dalalka Gacanka, inkastoo ay isku dayeen inay iska fogeeyaan colaadda. Tani waxay keentay in wada-hadalladii ay Pakistan garwadeenka ka ahayd ee u dhexeeyay Mareykanka iyo Iiraan ay gebi ahaanba istaagaan. Kala fogaanshaha Imaaraadka iyo Sacuudiga ayaa sidoo kale ka dhex muuqda xiriirka ay la leeyihiin Israa’iil. Halka shakhsiyaad aad ugu dhow qoyska boqortooyada Sacuudiga ay dhaleeceeyeen Israa’iil, Imaaraadka ayaa isagu si xawli ah ugu sii dhawaaday Tel Aviv.
