items.title: Saddex hab oo Turkiga uu ku ciqaabi karo Israa’iil, haddii xiisadda ay ka sii darto
items.description: Ankara (Caasimada Online) – Dagaalka dhanka afka ah ee u dhexeeya dalalka Turkiga iyo Israa’iil ayaa si weyn u xoogeystay toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay, taas oo bannaanka soo dhigtay khilaaf qoto dheer oo u dhexeeya labadan awoodood ee gobolka. Wejiga ugu dambeeyay ee cadaawaddan ayaa billowday markii xafiiska Xeer-ilaaliyaha Guud ee magaalada Istanbul uu dacwad kusoo oogay 35 shakhsi, oo uu ku jiro Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil Benjamin Netanyahu. Eedeymahan ayaa salka ku haya weerarkii sanadkii hore lagu qaaday doonyaha gargaarka ee Global Sumud Flotilla xilli ay marayeen biyaha caalamiga ah. Dacwadda xeer-ilaaliyaha, oo lagu dalbaday xabsiyo dhaadheer, ayaa Netanyahu u arkay tallaabo sii hurinaysa xiisadda. Maadaama lagu jiro sanad doorasho, ra’iisul wasaaraha Israa’iil wuxuu u baahnaa inuu difaaco sumcaddiisa siyaasadeed, gaar ahaan xilli xabbad-joojinta Mareykanka iyo Iiraan ay hoos u dhigtay taageeradiisii gudaha dalkiisa. Si uu uga jawaabo, Netanyahu ayaa adeegsaday barta xiriirka bulshada ee X, isagoo ku eedeeyay Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan inuu xasuuqayo muwaadiniintiisa Kurdiyiinta ah. Netanyahu, weerarka uu ku qaaday Erdogan ayaa laga yaabaa inuu ahaa tallaabo siyaasadeed oo lagama maarmaan u ah si uu u kasbado cod-bixiyayaasha aan weli go’aanka gaarin. Isla xilligaas, Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ee Israa’iil, Naftali Bennett, ayaa isna soo dhexgalay khilaafka, isagoo weerar afka ah oo kulul ku qaaday Turkiga. Bennett ayaa Turkiga ku sifeeyay “Iiraanta cusub”, isagoo horay u sii tilmaamay in suurtagal ay tahay in tallaabo laga qaado Ankara, wuxuuna yiri “Iiraan kaddib, faro-laab kuma fadhin doonno.” Dagaalkan afka ah ma aha uun mid siyaasadeed, balse wuxuu abuuray cabsi ah in labada dal ay isku dhici karaan. Waa in la xusuusnaadaa in markii horeba ay jireen khilaafyo xooggan oo u dhexeeya labada waddan, kuwaas oo salka ku haya dagaalka xasuuqa ah ee Israa’iil ay ka waddo Gaza, dowladda cusub ee ka dhalatay Suuriya, iyo loollanka guud ee gobolka—oo ay ku jirto xiriirka sii xoogeysanaya ee Israa’iil ay la leedahay dalalka Greece iyo Qubrus. Haddaba, maxaa dhici kara haddii Turkiga iyo Israa’iil ay qaadaan tallaabooyin adag oo ay ku gooyaan xiriirkooda diblomaasiyadeed, ayna galaan iska-hor-imaad? Qulqulka shidaalka Falanqeeyayaal badan ayaa ku dooday in Turkigu uu joojin karo qulqulka shidaalka Azerbaijan ee soo mara dhuumaha Baku-Tbilisi-Ceyhan, haddii amnigiisa qaran uu halis galo. Shidaalkan ayaa la sheegay inuu daboolo qayb weyn oo ka mid ah baahida tamarta Israa’iil, isagoo bixiya ku dhawaad boqolkiiba 50 isticmaalkeeda shidaalka. Inkastoo Turkigu uu cunaqabateyn ganacsi saaray Israa’iil tan iyo bishii May 2024, haddana shidaalku wuu sii socday, iyadoo la sheegay in ganacsatada iyo iibsadayaashu ay adeegsanayaan habab isku-dhafan si ay u sii wadaan socodka shidaalka, oo ay ku jirto adeegsiga maraakiibta si qarsoodi ah u shaqeysa ee loo yaqaano (shadow fleet). Haddii Turkigu uu adeegsado awoodda uu ku leeyahay Azerbaijan oo uu xiro tuubooyinka, shaki la’aan waxay abuuri doontaa carqalad muddo gaaban ah, balse lama oga inta ay sii socon doonto. Xilligan, ma jiraan cunaqabateyno caalami ah oo dhanka tamarta ah oo saaran Israa’iil, waxayna shidaal ka iibsan kartaa suuqyada furan. Intaas waxaa dheer, mas’uuliyiinta Israa’iil ayaa muddo dheer ku doodayay in iibsashada shidaalka Azerbaijan ay u adeegayso ilaalinta xiriirka wanaagsan ee ay la leeyihiin xukuumadda Baku, isla markaana Asarbajaan ay dooneyso inay dhowrto iskaashigaas istaraatiijiyadeed. Xayiraadda hawada Tallaabo kale oo ciqaab ah oo inta badan laga doodo ayaa ah in Turkigu uu hawadiisa ka xiro duullimaadyada rayidka ah ee Israa’iil. Tani waxay horseedi kartaa koror ku yimaada qiimaha tikidhada shirkadaha diyaaradaha ee Israa’iil iyo kuwa caalamiga ah. Jidadka dhaadheer waxay ka dhigan yihiin isticmaalka shidaal badan, saacadaha shaqada shaqaalaha oo kordha iyo carqaladeyn ku timaada jadwalka duullimaadyada, kuwaas oo dhammaantood sababi kara in qiimaha tikidhada ay qaali ku noqdaan shacabka Israa’iil, faa’iidada shirkadahana ay hoos u dhacdo. Gaarista dalalka sida Ruushka iyo Azerbaijan ayaa noqon karta mid dhib badan, balse dhibaatooyinkaas waxaa lagu yareyn karaa in laga duulo dul-mareenka Badda Madow (Black Sea). Sidoo kale, duullimaadyada kale ayaa laga weecin karaa hawada Turkiga. Helitaanka Israa’iil ee marinnada hawada ee beddelka ah—sida hawada Sacuudi Carabiya iyo dalalka kale ee gobolka oo si tartiib-tartiib ah u furmayay sanadihii la soo dhaafay—ayaa si weyn u yareynaya saameynta istaraatiijiyadeed ee xayiraad kasta oo ka timaada Turkiga, balse dalalkaas ayaa suurta-gal ah in ay dib uga xertaan hawadooda Israa’iil. Ganacsiga laba geesoodka ah Ganacsiga laba geesoodka ah ee u dhexeeya Turkiga iyo Israa’iil ayaa si weyn hoos ugu dhacay tan iyo markii la soo rogay cunaqabateynta ganacsiga, balse qaar ka mid ah badeecadaha Turkiga ayaa weli Israa’iil ku gaara ayaga oo maraya dalal saddexaad. Dalxiisayaasha Israa’iil ee taga Turkiga, inkastoo ay gaareen tobanaan kun sanadkii 2025, haddana ma aha kuwo tiro ahaan saameyn weyn leh oo dhaawac dhaqaale gaarsiin kara Israa’iil haddii Ankara ay ka hor istaagto inay u safraan dalkeeda. Awoodda xaddidan ee Ankara ay ku leedahay Israa’iil ayaa ka dhalatay isku-tiirsanaan la’aanta dhabta ah ee u dhexaysa labada waddan. Ganacsiga laba geesoodka ah ayaa horay u ahaa mid si weyn faa’iido ugu leh Turkiga, balse in badan oo ka mid ah ayaa la hakiyay sababo la xiriira xasuuqa Gaza. Halka il ee laga yaabo in lagu gor-gortami karay waxay ahaan lahayd mashruuca dhuumaha gaaska ee EastMed oo muddo dheer laga wada hadlayay, kaas oo la doonayay inuu gaaska Israa’iil iyo Falastiin geyso Turkiga si looga dhoofiyo qaaradda Yurub. Balse dagaalka Israa’iil ay ku qaadday Gaza ayaa gabi ahaanba meesha ka saaray mashruucaas. Marka laga soo tago dhismaha awooddiisa milateri, maalgashiga warshadaha difaaca iyo xoojinta awooddiisa is-horteegga, xukuumadda Ankara waxay u muuqataa inay isku dayayso inay saameyn ku yeelato dhaqanka Israa’iil iyadoo sii xoojinaysa xiriirka ay la leedahay dalalka gaashaanbuurta NATO iyo isbaheysiga ay la leedahay awoodaha waaweyn ee gobolka sida Pakistan, Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Masar. Turkiga ayaa u muuqda mid aaminsan in xiriirka isku-dhafan ee uu la leeyahay Midowga Yurub, doorkiisa muhiimka ah ee qaab-dhismeedka amniga Yurub, xiriirka gaarka ah ee uu la leeyahay Ruushka iyo Ukraine, iyo cilaaqaadka sii kordhaya ee qaaradaha Afrika iyo Aasiya, ay ku filan yihiin inay abuuraan lakabyo difaac oo ka hortagi kara in xiisaddu ay gaarto heer gacan-ka-hadal ah mustaqbalka. Turkiga ayaa u muuqda mid aaminsan in xiriirka isku-dhafan ee uu la leeyahay Midowga Yurub, doorkiisa muhiimka ah ee qaab-dhismeedka amniga Yurub, xiriirka gaarka ah ee uu la leeyahay Ruushka iyo Ukraine, iyo cilaaqaadka sii kordhaya ee qaaradaha Afrika iyo Aasiya, ay ku filan yihiin inay abuuraan lakabyo difaac oo ka hortagi kara in xiisaddu ay gaarto heer gacan-ka-hadal ah mustaqbalka. items.title: Somalia hosts UN aid chief as humanitarian crisis deepens
items.description: Somalia’s Deputy Foreign Minister Issa Mohamud Abdirahman met with the UN’s top humanitarian official in Mogadishu on Sunday to address worsening aid access and funding shortfalls threatening millions across the Horn of Africa nation. The meeting between Abdirahman and UN Humanitarian Coordinator for Somalia George Conway comes as the country grapples with a complex emergency marked by recurring climate shocks, persistent conflict, and one of the world’s largest internal displacement crises. Nearly 7 million Somalis require humanitarian assistance this year, according to UN estimates. Deputy Foreign Minister Abdirahman said, “[QUOTE ABOUT GOVERNMENT COMMITMENT TO FACILITATE HUMANITARIAN ACCESS AND PROTECT AID WORKERS].” Conway reportedly emphasized that [INDIRECT QUOTE REGARDING URGENT NEED FOR SUSTAINED INTERNATIONAL FUNDING AND IMPROVED SECURITY CONDITIONS FOR DELIVERY OF AID]. The discussions focused on strengthening coordination between federal authorities and UN agencies operating in Somalia, where militant group Al-Shabaab continues to restrict access in vast rural areas. Humanitarian partners have repeatedly cited bureaucratic hurdles and security risks as major operational challenges. Somalia remains highly vulnerable to climate extremes. Back-to-back failed rainy seasons followed by devastating floods in late 2023 reversed recent gains in food security. The UN’s 2024 Humanitarian Response Plan, requiring $1.6 billion, remains significantly underfunded at just over 40 percent of target. Both officials reaffirmed commitments to the humanitarian-development-peace nexus approach, aiming to address root drivers of vulnerability rather than only responding to acute emergencies.

items.title: Muxuu daarranyahay Safarka Madaxweyne Deni ee Gobolka Sanaag ?
items.description: Madaxweynaha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa gaaray Sanaag xilli ay weli taagan yihiin su’aalo la xiriira ballan-qaadyadii uu sameeyay xilligii doorashada ee ku wajahnaa horumarinta iyo xasilinta gobolkaasi. Wararka laga helayo Sanaag ayaa sheegaya in Madaxweyne Deni uu halkaasi ka bilaabay kulamo uu la qaadanayo odayaasha dhaqanka, waxgaradka, iyo qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada, si uu uga dhagaysto cabashooyinka iyo aragtiyaha dadka deegaanka. Kulamadan ayaa ah kuwo muhiim u ah sidii loo yareyn lahaa tabashooyinka siyaasadeed ee ka jira gobolka, xilli madaxweyne Deni uu dhowaan ballanqaaday inuu saami kordhin siyaasadeed u samayn doono gobolkaas. Safarkan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli gobolka Sanaag uu ka jiro kala qeybsanaan siyaasadeed, iyadoo qaybo ka mid ah bulshada ay taageersan yihiin maamulka Puntland, halka kuwo kalena ay u janjeeraan dhinaca waqooyi Bari.

items.title: Duqeymo ka dhacay Shabeellaha Hoose iyo Jubada Dhexe oo lagu beegsaday goobo la tuhunsan yahay
items.description: Duqeymo ka dhacay Shabeellaha Hoose iyo Jubada Dhexe oo lagu beegsaday goobo la tuhunsan yahay Wararka ka imaanaya gobollada Koonfurta Soomaaliya ayaa sheegaya in duqeymo kala duwan ay ka dhaceen deegaanno ka tirsan Shabeellaha Hoose iyo Jubada Dhexe, kuwaas oo lagu beegsaday goobo la tuhunsan yahay in ay ku sugnaayeen maleeshiyaad iyo horjoogayaal. Duqeynta koowaad ayaa la sheegay inay ka dhacday degmada Jilib, halkaas oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday gaari la tuhunsanaa inuu siday xubno ka tirsan maleeshiyaad. Wararka hordhaca ah ayaa tilmaamaya in gaariga si toos ah loo beegsaday xilli uu marayay gudaha degmada. Duqeyn kale ayaa ka dhacday deegaanka Kuunya-Barrow ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, iyadoo la sheegay in lagu weeraray goob loo maleynayo inay ahayd xarun tababar ama mucaskar ay ku sugnaayeen maleeshiyaad. Sidoo kale, duqeyn saddexaad ayaa laga soo wariyay degmada Sablaale, halkaas oo la sheegay in lagu bartilmaameedsaday koox horjoogayaal ah oo shir ku lahaa deegaanka. Wararka ayaa intaas ku daraya in duqeyn kale ay ka dhacday miyiga ku teedsan degmada Yaaqbariweyne, iyadoo lagu beegsaday goob kale oo loo maleynayo inay ahayd xarun ay ku sugnaayeen maleeshiyaad. Ilaa iyo hadda ma jiro war rasmi ah oo ka soo baxay dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo ku saabsan duqeymahan, sidoo kalena lama xaqiijin khasaaraha dhabta ah ee ka dhashay. Xaaladda deegaannada la sheegay in duqeymaha ka dhaceen ayaa weli ah mid kacsan, waxaana la filayaa in saacadaha ama maalmaha soo socda ay soo baxaan faahfaahin dheeraad ah.

items.title: Su’aalo Waaweyn oo Ka Taagan Weerarkii Aqalka Cad—Trump Ma Ku Lug Leeyahay?
items.description: Falanqeeyayaal dhanka amniga ah oo dalka Mareykanka u dhashay ayaa si kulul uga hadlay weerarkii dhawaan ka dhacay munaasabaddii cashada ee Aqalka Cad, iyagoo sheegay in dhacdadaas ay fashil weyn ku tahay nidaamka ilaalinta madaxda sare. Khubaradan ayaa is weydiinaya sidee bay suurtagal u noqotay in nin hubeysan uu gudaha u galo meel si heer sare ah loo ilaaliyo oo madaxweynihii dalka uu joogo. Inkastoo baaritaannadu ay wali socdaan, baraha bulshada waxaa qabsaday aragtiyo kala duwan oo qaarkood ay leeyihiin weerarku wuxuu lahaa ujeeddooyin siyaasadeed, balse ilaa hadda ma jiraan cadeymo rasmi ah oo arrintaas ku saabsan. Hay’adaha sirdoonka ayaa xoogga saaraya sidii loo ogaan lahaa haddii uu jiro xiriir ka dambeeyay ninka weerarka geystay iyo cid kale oo gacan ku siisay. Dhacdadani waxay saameyn weyn ku yeelatay jawiga guud ee dalka Mareykanka, waxaana la dareemayaa qodobadan: Walaaca Amniga: Waxaa soo baxaya cabsi laga qabo in munaasabadaha kale ee waaweyn aysan ammaan ahayn, taas oo keentay in dib loo eego nidaamka ilaalinta Aqalka Cad. Wararka aan la xaqiijin: Qalalaasahan wuxuu muujiyay sida baraha bulshada ay ugu faafaan warar been abuur ah oo jahawareer ku dhex rida shacabka marka xaalad degdeg ah ay jirto. Badqabka Madaxda: In kasta oo Madaxweyne Trump iyo madaxdii kaleba si nabad ah looga saaray goobta, haddana falkan wuxuu calaamad su’aal saaray kalsoonidii lagu qabay awoodda ciidamada sirdoonka (Secret Service). Ugu dambeyn, baaritaannada ayaa hadda u muuqda kuwo lagu kordhinayo tallaabooyinka amniga, iyadoo la filayo in isbeddel weyn lagu sameeyo habraacyada dadka lagu baaro ka hor intaysan soo gelin goobaha ay ku sugan yihiin madaxda sare.

items.title: Dawladda Suuriya oo billowday maxkamadaynta saraakiishii la shaqayn jirtay Bishaar Al-Asad
items.description: Dawladda Suuriya ayaa si rasmi ah u billowday maxkamadaynta saraakiishii la shaqayn jiray nidaamkii Bishaar Al-Asad, gaar ahaan kuwii geystay xadgudubyada xilliyadii kacdoonka. Maxkamadayntan oo si weyn isha loogu hayay ayaa lagu bilaabay Atef Najib, Amjad Yusuf iyo rag kale oo hore u ahaa saraakiil sar sare oo ka tirsanaa ciidamada,iyadoo lagu eedeeyay dambiyo culus oo ka dhan ah shacabka. Dacwaddan ayaa sidoo kale lagu soo oogay siddeed xubnood oo kale oo ka tirsanaa hoggaankii hore, oo uu kamid yahay madaxweynihii hore Bashar al-Assad, inkastoo uu dibedda Qaxooti ku yahay. Eedeymaha loo jeediyay xubnahan ayaa isugu jira dilal ula kac ah iyo xadgudubyo kale oo halis ah oo ka dhan ah xuquuqda aadanaha, kuwaas oo dhacay intii uu socday kacdoonkii 2011-2024 iyo ka horba. Maxkamadda ayaa loo qabtay si furan, iyadoo ay goob joog ka ahaayeen wariyeyaal iyo dadweyne tiro badan, taas oo muujinaysa dadaal lagu doonayo hufnaan iyo kalsooni dhisid. Garsooraha ayaa xaqiijiyay in eedeysanayaasha iyo markhaatiyaashu ay joogaan, hase yeeshee wuxuu dib u dhigay wareysiga tooska ah ilaa bisha May, si loo dhamaystiro diyaarinta dacwadda iyo amniga goobta. Suuriya oo ku dhowaad 60 sano ku jirtay xukun keligii talis ah ayaa haatan gashay marxalad cusub, ayadoo layskula xisaabtamaya xadgudubyadii dhacay xilligii nidaamkii hore ee Bishaar Al-Asad iyo Aabihiis Xaafid Al-Asad.

items.title: Muwaadin Soomaaliyeed oo lagu dhex dilay goobtiisa ganacsiga
items.description: Cape town ( Raxanreeb Online) Kooxo hubeysan oo burcad ah ayaa muwaadin Soomaaliyeed waxa ay ku dileen xaafada Strand ee magaalada Cape town ee dalka Koonfur Afrika. Muwaadinka Soomaaliyeed ayaa la sheegay in lagu dhex toogtay goobtiisa ganacsiga, isaga oo shaqadiisa ku jiray, waxaana la tilmaamay in kooxihii dilka geystay ay goobta isaga baxsadeen. Marxuumka ayaa lagu magacaabi jiray Cabdullaahi Mukhtaar Cumar, waxa uuna kamid ahaa dhallinyarada ganacsiyada ku leh gudaha dalka Koonfur Afrika. Geesta kale xubno kamid ah Jaaliyada Soomaaliyeed ee Koonfur Afrika, ayaa sheegay in falka dilka uu ahaa mid lasii qorsheeyay oo ay kooxaha weerarka fuliyay muqaal ay ka dubeen. “In Muqaal toos ah la duubo iyado la fulinayo dil argagax leh ayaa ah mid cusub waxaana loo fasiran karaa fariin ay dirayaan kooxaha tirada badan ee burcada hubeeysan” ayuu yiri xubin kamid ah Jaaliyada Soomaaliyeed. Bishan gudaheda 7 somali ah ayaa lagu dilay Location-ada Hoos-taga Magalada Cape Town ee Dalka Koonfur Afrika mana jirto talaabo looga hortagayo oo ay qaadeyso dowladda dalkaasi. items.title: Heshiis u dhexeeya Jabhadda Xoreynta Azawad iyo Ciidamada Ruushka oo dowladda Maali dhar jabiyay
items.description: Jabhadda CSP-DPA (oo loo yaqaan Jabhadda Xoreynta Azawad) ayaa shaaca ka qaadday inay heshiis rasmi ah la galeen ciidamada dowladda Maali iyo xulafadooda Ruushka, kaas oo u oggolaanaya ciidamada Ruushka inay ka baxaan magaalada istiraatiijiga ah ee Kidal. Tani waxay timid ka dib markii ay jabhaddaha Azawad go’doomiyeen magaalada, iyagoo ku qasbay xoogagga shisheeye inay dib u gurasho sameeyaan. Markii ay ciidamadu baxeen, jabhadda ayaa ku dhowaaqday inay si buuxda ula wareegtay maamulka magaalada, taas oo dhabar-jab weyn ku ah saamaynta milateri ee dowladda Maali ku lahayd waqooyiga. Ciidamada Ruushka ee loo yaqaan Africa Corps (horena u ahaa Wagner), waxay Maali u joogeen inay fuliyaan ajandaha milateriga ee dalka Ruushka, kaas oo ku dhisnaa inay taageero siiyaan nidaamka milateriga ee Bamako ka dib markii ay eryeen ciidamadii Faransiiska. Ruushku wuxuu halkaas u joogay inuu tababaro ciidamada Maali, inuu ka qayb qaato hawlgallada ka dhanka ah jabhaddaha, iyo inuu ilaaliyo goobaha laga soo saaro kheyraadka dabiiciga ah. Kidal waxay u ahayd Ruushka xarun astaan u ah guushooda Afrika, maadaama ay gacan ka geysteen qabsashadeeda sannadkii 2023. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, isbahaysiga jabhaddaha ee u dagaallamaya xuquuqda dadka Azawad ayaa dhowaan kordhiyey weerarrada ay ku hayaan Ruushka, iyagoo gaarsiiyey khasaarihii ugu dhimashada badnaa ee ay abid la kulmaan calooshood u shaqaystayaasha Ruushka ee Afrika. Ka bixitaanka Kidal ee ciidamadan, oo lagu sifeeyey mid heshiis ku yimid balse dhab ahaantii ah mid ka dhashay cadaadis milateri, wuxuu muujinayaa in qorshihii Ruushka ee ahaa inuu xasiliyo Maali uu fashilmay, taasoo fursad cusub siisay jabhaddaha inay dib u soo ceshadaan dhulkoodii.

Ciidamada Ruushka ee loo yaqaan Africa Corps (horena u ahaa Wagner), waxay Maali u joogeen inay fuliyaan ajandaha milateriga ee dalka Ruushka, kaas oo ku dhisnaa inay taageero siiyaan nidaamka milateriga ee Bamako ka dib markii ay eryeen ciidamadii Faransiiska. Ruushku wuxuu halkaas u joogay inuu tababaro ciidamada Maali, inuu ka qayb qaato hawlgallada ka dhanka ah jabhaddaha, iyo inuu ilaaliyo goobaha laga soo saaro kheyraadka dabiiciga ah. Kidal waxay u ahayd Ruushka xarun astaan u ah guushooda Afrika, maadaama ay gacan ka geysteen qabsashadeeda sannadkii 2023. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, isbahaysiga jabhaddaha ee u dagaallamaya xuquuqda dadka Azawad ayaa dhowaan kordhiyey weerarrada ay ku hayaan Ruushka, iyagoo gaarsiiyey khasaarihii ugu dhimashada badnaa ee ay abid la kulmaan calooshood u shaqaystayaasha Ruushka ee Afrika. Ka bixitaanka Kidal ee ciidamadan, oo lagu sifeeyey mid heshiis ku yimid balse dhab ahaantii ah mid ka dhashay cadaadis milateri, wuxuu muujinayaa in qorshihii Ruushka ee ahaa inuu xasiliyo Maali uu fashilmay, taasoo fursad cusub siisay jabhaddaha inay dib u soo ceshadaan dhulkoodii.

items.title: Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Iran oo cadeeyay xiriirka adag ee kala dhaxeeya Ruushka
items.description: Ruushka (Raxanreeb Online) Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ee Iiraan, Cabaas Araghchi, ayaa gaaray magaalada St. Petersburg ee dalka Ruushka. Wasiir Cabaas ayaa sheegay sheegay in mar walba Ruushka la leeyihiin wadatashi dhow iyo xiriir laba geesood ah oo joogto ah, balse waxaa jiray hakad ku yimid kulamada sababo la xiriira dagaalka mudada socda”, ayuu Cabaa. Isaga oo intaas ku daray in ay hadda timid fursad ay kula tashadaan oo ay isku arkaan iyaga iyo saaxiibkooda Ruushka. wasiirka ayaa hore safari ugu soo maray dalalka Pakistaan iyo Cumaan, isaga oo intii uu ku sugnaa Pakistaan wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ee Iiraan sheegay in Pakistaan ay door muhiim ah ka qaadatay dhex-dhexaadinta wadahadallada Iiraan iyo Maraykanka,. “waxaana muhiim ahayd in laga wada hadlo horumarradii ugu dambeeyay,waxaan la yeelanay kulan wanaagsan saaxiibadeenna Pakistan, taas oo Ilaahay mahaddii ahayd iyo safar aad u guuleystay” ayuu yiri wasiir Cabaas. Waxaan dib u eegnay wixii dhacay, waxaana ka wada hadalnay waddada iyo shuruudaha ay wadahadalladu ku sii socon karaan”. Waxa uu sidoo kale, safarkiisii Cumaan ku tilmaamay mid lagama maarmaan u ahaa xiriirka ay la leeyihiin waddamada Khaliijka, “Annaga iyo Cumaan waxaan nahay laba dal oo xeeb ku leh Marinka Hormuz, ayuu hadalkiisa ku daray wasiir Cabaas. Sidoo kale waxa uu xusay in lagama maarmaan ahayd in arrintan laga tashado, bad-qabka isku socodka Hormuz ay muhiimad gooni ah lee dahay. Waxa uuna tilmaamay in loo baahan yahay isku-duwid dhow si loo xaqiijiyo danaha wadajirka ah, ee Cumaan, Iiraan iyo dalalka kale ee ku teedsan Hormuz. items.title: Shabaab loo diyaarinayay inay weeraraan Itoobiya oo la duqeeyay + Khasaaraha
items.description: Jilib (Caasimada Online) – Faah-faahinno dheeraad ah ayaa waxaa laga helayaa khasaaraha ka dhashay duqeymo diyaaradeed oo saacadihii ugu dambeeyay ka dhacay gobollada Jubbada Dhexe iyo Shabeellaha Hoose ee Jubbada iyo Koonfur Galbeed, kuwaas oo lala beegsaday kooxda Al-Shabaab. Duqeymo is xig-xigay oo ka kala dhacay degmooyinka Sablaale, Kunyobarrow iyo deegaanka Yaaqbariweyne ayaa waxaa lagu beegsaday dagaalamayaal ka tirsanaa kooxda Al-Shabaab, iyada oo lagu dilay ugu yaraan ilaa 30 xubnood. Ilo wareedyo amni ayaa sheegay in xubnahan lagu diyaarinayay goobaha lagu duqeeyay, ujeedkoodana uu ahaa inay weerarro ka fuliyaan gudaha Itoobiya, haseyeeshee laga hortegay qorshahooda, kadibna cagta la mariyay. Sidoo kale, waxaaa la burburiyay xarumo muhiim ah oo ay ku jiraan kaydad hub oo ay lahaayeen maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab ee la duqeeyay. Dhinaca kale, duqeyn kale oo iyana ka dhacday degmada Jilib ee xarunta gobolka Jubbada Dhexe ayaa waxaa lala beegsaday hoggaamiyeyaal ka tirsanaa Khawaarijta oo la socday gaari, kaas oo dhulka lala simay. Horjoogayaashaas oo isugu jiray Soomaali iyo Ajaaniib ayaa saarnaa baabuurka la beegsaday, waxaana la sheegay inay u socdeen shir kooxda ah, balse kahor lala helay gantaal culus, halkaas oo ay dhimasho iyo dhaawac ku noqdeen. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa la filayaa in war rasmi ay kasoo saarto weerarkan cusub, soona bandhigto khasaaraha guud ee gaaray Al-Shabaab. Muddooyinkii u dambeeyay ciidamada dowladda iyo saaxibada caalamiga ah ayaa sare u qaaday howlgallada ka socda koonfurta iyo bartamaha Soomaaliya, iyada oo laga soo hooyay guullo wax ku ool ah, maadaaama ciidamadu ay dib ula wareegeen deegaano muhiim ah oo laga saaray kooxda.     duqeyn jilib gaari shir ku socdeen, hoggaamiyeyaah Sablaale, Kunyobarrow iyo Yaaqbariweyne 30 dagaalmie qaybtood lo diyarayanya deegaano kamid ha dalka tobiya goobta tababarja dqeyn xarumo kayd ah duqeymaha hub, uto hubbaland ilo areedyo amniga xliii loogu talalagay duqeyn d= The post Shabaab loo diyaarinayay inay weeraraan Itoobiya oo la duqeeyay + Khasaaraha appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Xogta markab siday xamuul oo lagu afduubtay Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Koox burcad badeed ah ayaa afduubatay markab nooca xamuulka qaada ah oo ay saarnaayeen 16 qof oo shaqaale ah, xilli uu marayay xeebaha gobolka Mudug ee Puntland, sida ay xaqiijiyeen ilo amniga ah. Markabka ayaa ku gooshayay Calanka Panama, waxaana lasoo wariyay inuu kusii jeeday dhana dalka Mozambique, sida ay xaqiijiyeen ilo wareedyadu. Shaqaalaha saaran markabka ayaa 10 kamid ah waxaa la xaqiijiyey inay yihiin Carab, waxaana la baxsaday burcadda hubeysan. Wararka ayaa intaasi kusii daraya in markabka la afduubtay uu alaab kala duwan u siday shirkad xamuul ah oo laga leeyahay Yurub. Markabkani xamuulka ah ayaa sidoo kale leh Wiish awood u leh in uu deked la’aan agabyo ku dajiya doon ama markab kale, taas oo shaki abuurtay, maadaama xiliga la qabsanayay uu ku jiray biyaha Soomaaliya, kana durgay biyaha caalamiga ah. Waa afduubkii labaad oo maalmo gudahood ah ka dhacaya biyaha Soomaaliya, waxaana dhawaan sidaan oo kale loo afduubay markab qaada shidaalka oo ay saarnaayeen 17 qof oo shaqaale ah. Markabkaas oo lagu magacaabo Honour 25 , ayaa waxaa gacan-ku-hayntiisa la wareegay lix nin oo hubeysan goor dambe oo Arbacadii ah, xilligaas oo uu qiyaastii 30 mayl-badeed u jiray xeebta. Qiyaastii ilaa 3 sano ka hor, falalka burcad-badeednimada ayaa u muuqday kuwo gabi ahaanba ka ciribtirmay biyaha Badweynta Hindiya oo horay ugu caan baxay afduubka, balse dib ayay arrintaas u soo laabatay iyadoo inta badan la beegsanayo doonyaha kalluumeysiga iyo maraakiibta xamuulka. items.title: Maxay Mareykanka, Shiinaha, iyo Taiwan ugu hardamayaan Somaliland?
items.description: Taiwan Ministry of Foreign Affairs Qoraalka sawirka, Somaliland iyo Taiwan waxay sanadihii u dambeeyay yeesheen xiriir dhow. Sannadkii 2024, wafdi ka socda Somaliland ayaa booqday Taiwan, halkaas oo ay la kulmeen Madaxweynaha Taiwan Lai Ching-te (ka shanaad midig). Article Information Author, Lü Jiahong Role, BBC Chinese 26 Abriil 2026 Waqtiga akhriska: 8 daqiiqo Booqashadii la qorsheeyay ee Madaxweynaha Taiwan, Lai Ching‑te, uu ku tegi lahaa Eswatini — oo ah saaxiibka diblomaasiyadeed ee keliya ee ay Taiwan ku leedahay Afrika — ayaa la baajiyay Talaadadii (21‑ka Abriil), kadib markii waddamo Afrikaan ah ay baajiyeen oggolaanshaha duullimaadyada hawada. Arrintani waxay mar kale muujisay xaaladda adag ee diblomaasiyadeed ee Taiwan ka haysata Afrika. Dhanka kale ee qaaradda Afrika, Taiwan waxay si degdeg ah u xoojinaysaa xiriirka ay la leedahay Somaliland, taas oo iyaduna aanay Qaramada Midoobay aqoonsan. Iyadoo Israa’iil ay si rasmi ah u aqoonsatay Somaliland dhammaadka sanadkii 2025, isla markaana xaaladda tamarta Bariga Dhexe ay weli tahay mid kacsan, dhulkan ku yaalla afka Gacanka Cadmeed, hodanna ku ah macdanno muhiim ah sida macdanta dhifka ah ee dhulka laga helo, ayaa noqonaya goob cusub oo ay ku hardamayaan Mareykanka, Shiinaha, iyo Taiwan. BBC Laanta Afka Shiinaha ayaa wareysatay wakiilka Taiwan ee Somaliland, maalgashadayaal Mareykan ah, iyo khubarro goboleed, si loo sahamiyo sida Taiwan uga faa’iidaysan karto awooddeeda dhaqaale iyo tignoolajiyadeed si ay ula shaqeyso saaxiibbadeeda una abuurato saldhigyo cusub waxa loogu yeero “lamadegaanka diblomaasiyadda,” isla markaana iftiiminaysa tartanka u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Shiinaha ee “Geeska Afrika.” Dadka Taiwan ee ku sugan Geeska Afrika Waxa loo yaqaanno “Geeska Afrika” waa gobolka jasiiradeed ee ku fidsan waqooyi‑bari Afrika, kaas oo inta badan ka kooban Soomaaliya, Somaliland, Itoobiya, Eritrea, iyo Jabuuti — oo ah dal yar oo ay ku sugan yihiin ciidamo ka kala socda Mareykanka, Jabaan, Shiinaha, iyo dalal kale. Gobolkani waa mid ka mid ah meelaha istaraatiijiga ah ee ugu muhiimsan dunida ee loo yaqaan “xannibaadaha ganacsiga”, maaddaama uu xakameeyo marin‑biyoodka Bab‑el‑Mandeb oo isku xira Badda Cas, Kanaalka Suweys, iyo Badweynta Hindiya, isla markaana uu maro qiyaastii boqolkiiba 10 ilaa 12 ganacsiga caalamiga ah (gaar ahaan saliidda iyo gaaska dareeraha ah – LNG). Dekedda Berbera, oo ah dekedda ugu weyn Somaliland, waa deked istaraatiiji ah oo ku taalla Geeska Afrika. Iyadoo xakameynaysa marinka badda ee u dhexeeya Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, waxaa hadda deked casri ah ka dhigeysa shirkadda DP World. Dekeddani waa marin-badeed aad muhiim ugu ah dalal dhul‑xiran sida Itoobiya, oo ay ku nool yihiin boqollaal milyan oo dad ah, waxayna leedahay awood dhaqaale iyo mid ganacsi oo aad u ballaaran. Xigashada Sawirka, Taiwan Ministry of Foreign Affairs Qoraalka sawirka, Luo Zhenhua (ka labaad bidix) waa wakiilka Taiwan ee Somaliland Sannadkii 2020, xilligii uu bilaabmay faafidda cudurka COVID‑19, wakiilka Taiwan, Luo Zhenhua, ayaa lagu amray in laga wareejiyo Sucuudi Carabiya loona diro Somaliland si uu xilkiisa halkaas uga qabto. Wareysi uu siiyay BBC Chinese, Luo Zhenhua wuxuu dib u xusuustay in markii ugu horreysay ee uu tegay deegaanka lix sano ka hor, ay dadka badankood u maleyn jireen inuu ka yimid dhulweynaha Shiinaha. Marka uu waddooyinka marayo, dadka ag maraya ayaa inta badan ku qeylin jiray “Shiinaha.” Si deggan ayuu kadib ugu sharxi jiray, “Maya, waxaan ka imid Taiwan.” Xitaa mar ayuu gabar yar oo deegaanka u dhalatay oo uu ku arkay xeebta, farta ku fiiqday, iyadoo ku qaylineysa “COVID‑19.”

Xigashada Sawirka, Taiwan Ministry of Foreign Affairs Qoraalka sawirka, Luo Zhenhua (ka labaad bidix) waa wakiilka Taiwan ee Somaliland Sannadkii 2020, xilligii uu bilaabmay faafidda cudurka COVID‑19, wakiilka Taiwan, Luo Zhenhua, ayaa lagu amray in laga wareejiyo Sucuudi Carabiya loona diro Somaliland si uu xilkiisa halkaas uga qabto. Wareysi uu siiyay BBC Chinese, Luo Zhenhua wuxuu dib u xusuustay in markii ugu horreysay ee uu tegay deegaanka lix sano ka hor, ay dadka badankood u maleyn jireen inuu ka yimid dhulweynaha Shiinaha. Marka uu waddooyinka marayo, dadka ag maraya ayaa inta badan ku qeylin jiray “Shiinaha.” Si deggan ayuu kadib ugu sharxi jiray, “Maya, waxaan ka imid Taiwan.” Xitaa mar ayuu gabar yar oo deegaanka u dhalatay oo uu ku arkay xeebta, farta ku fiiqday, iyadoo ku qaylineysa “COVID‑19.”

items.title: Somaliland oo sheegtay inay ka naxday isku daygii dil ee madaxweyne TRUMP
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Maamulka Somailand, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullahi (Cirro) ayaa ka hadlay isku daygii dil ee uu ka bad-baaday Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump, xilli uu nin hubeysan ku weeraray hoteelka Washington Hilton. Cabdiraxmaan Cirro ayaa shaaca ka qaaday inuu ka naxay weerarka lagu qaaday Trump, isaga oo si adag u cambaareeyay. Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in Xukuumadda Somaliland ay garab taagan tahay dowladda Mareykanka, sida uu ku caddeeyay qoraalkiisa. “Aad ayaan uga naxay ugana xumahay isku daygii weerar ee lagu qaaday madaxweyne Trump. Waxaan garab taaganahay Mareykanka” ayuu yiri Cirro. Trump ayaa habeenkii Sabtida fadhiyay masraxa hoteelka Washington Hilton, oo ay ka socotay casho-sharafeedka wariyeyaasha Aqalka Cad (White House Correspondents’ Dinner), waxaana wehlinayay Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka JD Vance, afhayeenka Aqalka Cad Karoline Leavitt iyo mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan ururka wariyeyaasha Aqalka Cad, iyadoo si lama filaan ah loo maqlay dhawaqa rasaas xooggan xilli martidu ay ku guda jireen cunteynta hoolka weyn ee munaasabadda. Madaxweynaha ayaa dib ka sheegay in markii hore uu u qaatay in saxan weyn uu dhacay maadaama dhawaqu ula muuqday mid “aad u fog,” balse wuxuu xusay in marwada koowaad ay si degdeg ah u dareentay khatarta. “Waxaan u malaynayaa inay markiiba ogaatay waxa dhacay,” ayuu Trump u sheegay suxufiyiinta isagoo ku sugan Aqalka Cad, wuxuuna xusuustay in Melania Trump ay ku tiri: “Kani waa dhawaq xun.” Donald Trump ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in ciidamada ilaalada ay si degdeg ah uga dejiyeen masraxa, isaga oo xaqiijiyay in ciidamadu ay qabteen shakhsigii laga shakiyay, isla markaana hal askari oo ka tirsan ilaalada gaarka ah uu ka badbaaday xabbad meel dhow lagaga dhuftay jaakaddiisa xabadda celiysa. Si kastaba, ninka eedeysanaha ah ee weerarka gaystay ayaa waxaa magaciisa lagu sheegay Cole Allen, oo 31 jir ah, kaaas oo kasoo jeeda Torrance, California, sida ay sheegeen laba sarkaal oo ka tirsan hay’adaha amniga oo xog-ogaal u ah baaritaanka. Booliska ayaa sheegay in Allen uu marti ka ahaa hoteelka Washington Hilton, halkaas oo munaasabadda lagu qabtay, isla markaana uu watay qori, bastoolad iyo mindiyo. items.title: A Rare Moment of Unity: Mogadishu Hosts Grand Inauguration Uniting Government and Opposition
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Mogadishu shimmered with color, ceremony, and collective pride today as the capital hosted one of the most unifying public gatherings seen in years. The inauguration of Ugaas Cabdirisaaq Ugaas Cabdullaahi Ugaas Xaashi Ugaas Faracade unfolded as a jubilant celebration—an event that blended centuries‑old tradition with the modern aspirations of a nation eager for stability and togetherness. The atmosphere was electric. Leaders from across Somalia’s political spectrum arrived side by side, offering a rare tableau of harmony in a country where political disagreements often dominate the national conversation. Among the distinguished attendees were President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, former President Sheikh Sharif, Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre, and Speaker of the Upper House Abdi Hashi Abdullahi. They were joined by former national leaders, ministers, lawmakers, regional representatives, diplomats, traditional elders, business figures, and civil society voices. What made the day remarkable was not simply the scale of attendance—but the spirit behind it. Government officials and opposition figures shared the same hall, the same stage, and the same applause. For many Somalis watching, it was a refreshing reminder that unity is still possible, even in challenging times. Held in the heart of Mogadishu, the ceremony radiated optimism. Prayers and blessings were offered for the newly crowned Ugaas, with speakers expressing hope that he will serve as a symbol of peace and a bridge between communities. Traditional leaders highlighted the enduring cultural role of the Ugaas institution—one that has long helped mediate disputes, preserve heritage, and foster social cohesion. The event was overshadowed by the decision to grant speaking time to Hassan Mohamed Hussein Muungaab, the Governor of Banaadir and Mayor of Mogadishu—a figure whose tenure continues to generate deep controversy. Critics accuse Mungaab of presiding over policies that have eroded public trust, particularly regarding land management in the capital. Allegations of large-scale land appropriation and displacement have fueled claims that hundreds of thousands of residents have been pushed into vulnerable conditions, with limited safeguards or compensation. His administration has also faced scrutiny over the handling of international development funds, including support from institutions such as the World Bank. Observers argue that visible improvements in infrastructure have failed to match the scale of funding received, pointing instead to deteriorating urban conditions, including flooding and poor road maintenance. Economic policy has become another flashpoint. Business owners and residents alike have voiced frustration over what they describe as heavy taxation, which they say has stifled commercial activity and slowed the city’s economic momentum. For many attendees, the mayor’s appearance at the event was not a moment of unity—but a stark reminder of the unresolved grievances surrounding his leadership. For many observers, the significance of the day extended far beyond the ceremonial crowning of a traditional leader. It was a vivid demonstration of how cultural institutions can bring together voices that might otherwise remain apart. In a political landscape often marked by tension, the inauguration offered a moment of shared pride and collective hope. As the ceremony concluded, Mogadishu felt transformed—if only for a day—into a stage where unity overshadowed division, and where the promise of a more harmonious future felt within reach. The city was not defined by competing interests, but by a powerful reminder of what Somalis can achieve when they stand together. items.title: Waa kuma Cole Tomas Allen? – Ninkii isku dayey inuu dilo madaxweyne Trump
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada ammaanka Mareykanka ayaa xiray nin hubeysan oo lagu eedeeyay inuu xoog ku galay barxadda hore ee hoolka ay ka socotay Casho-sharafeedka Wariyeyaasha Aqalka Cad (WHCA) oo ka dhacaysay hoteel ku yaalla magaalada Washington, DC, taas oo uu ka qaybgalayay Madaxweyne Donald Trump. Dhawaqa rasaasta ayaa sababtay in si degdeg ah goobta looga saaro madaxweynaha iyo xubnaha golihiisa wasiirrada, iyagoo laga fogeynayo munaasabadda warbaahinta ee habeenkii Sabtida ka socotay hoteelka Washington Hilton. Madaxweyne Trump ayaa markii dambe dhacdadan ku tilmaamay weerar uu geystay “shakhsi doonayay inuu khaarajiyo”. Ciidamada ammaanka ayaa rasaas ku furay eedeysanaha kaddib markii uu xoog ku dhaafay bar-koontarool oo ku taalla bannaanka hoolka hoteelka, halkaas oo ay isugu yimaadeen madaxweynaha, Marwada Koowaad Melania Trump, mas’uuliyiin sarsare iyo boqollaal marti sharaf ah. Ninkan oo warbaahinta Mareykanku ay magaciisa ku sheegtay Cole Tomas Allen oo 31 jir ah, ayaa lagu xiray goobta ay wax ka dhaceen, inkastoo aan weli la soo saarin xaqiijin rasmi ah oo ka timid laamaha dowladda. Xaalad argagax leh ayaa hareereysay madasha, iyadoo dadku ay gabaad ka dhigteen miisaska hoostooda xilli ciidamada ilaalada gaarka ah ee Secret Service ay buux dhaafiyeen munaasabadda quruxda badan ee sanadlaha ah. “Nin ku hubeysan hub kala duwan ayaa soo weeraray bar-koontarool oo ammaan ah, waxaana dhulka dhigay xubno aad u geesiyaal ah oo ka tirsan Secret Service-ka,” ayuu Trump ku yiri shir jaraa’id oo uu ku qabtay Aqalka Cad wax yar kaddib markii ay dhacdadani dhacday. Madaxweynaha ayaa intaas raaciyay in laamaha amnigu ay aaminsan yihiin in ninku uu ahaa gacan-ku-dhiigle keligiis socday, isaguna uu dareenkaas la qabo. Hadalkan ayuu jeediyay kaddib markii uu soo bandhigay muuqaal muujinaya eedeysanaha oo si xawli ah ku dhaafaya ciidamada amniga iyadoo ilaaladuna ay qoryahooda la soo baxayaan. Maxaa laga og yahay Cole Tomas Allen? Saraakiisha fulinta sharciga oo aan wali si rasmi ah u shaacin magaca ninkan ayaa sheegay inuu deggen yahay magaalada xeebta ah ee Torrance ee gobolka California, taas oo ku taalla xaafadda South Bay ee u dhow Los Angeles. Taliyaha waaxda booliska ee Washington, DC ayaa sheegay in baarayaashu ay aaminsan yihiin in eedeysanuhu uu hoteelka deggenaa maadaama uu marti ku ahaa, inkastoo aan wali la ogaan ujeeddada dhabta ah ee falkan ku riixday. Qoraallo la soo dhigay barta Facebook oo u muuqda inay la xiriiraan Allen ayaa muujinaya in bishii Diseembar 2024 loo aqoonsaday “Macallinkii Bisha” ee laanta Torrance ee xarunta C2 Education, oo ah shirkad bixisa tababarro gaar ah iyo diyaargarowga imtixaannada ardayda u socota jaamacadaha. Sidoo kale, boggiisa xiriirka xirfadleyda ee LinkedIn ayaa ninkan ku sifeeyay inuu yahay injineer farsamo iyo saynisyahan kombuyuutar, horumariye Games, iyo inuu yahay macallin dabiici ah. Diiwaannada maaliyadda ee ololaha doorashooyinka federaalka ayaa muujinaya in Allen uu 25 doolar ugu deeqay guddi taageerayay ololihii madaxweynenimo ee Kamala Harris sanadkii 2024. Dhanka kale, Madaxweyne Trump oo la hadlay suxufiyiinta ayaa meesha ka saaray in toogashadan ay xiriir la leedahay dagaalka Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ay kula jiraan Iiraan, isagoo caddeeyay in aysan jirin wax caddaynaya arrintaas, weerarkuna uusan ka hor istaagi doonin guusha dagaalkaas. Marka la eego tallaabooyinka amniga ee hoteelka, sii-hayaha xilka taliyaha booliska caasimadda, Jeffery Carroll, ayaa saxafiyiinta u sheegay Sabtidii in baarayaashu rumeysan yihiin in eedeysanaha uu deggenaa hoteelka, taasina ay tahay sida uu ugu suurtagashay inuu halkaas ku sugnaado xilliga munaasabadda. Hoteelka ayaa guud ahaan laga xiray dadweynaha laga bilaabo 2-dii duhurnimo ee Sabtida si loogu diyaar-garoobo cashada oo bilaabanaysay 8-dii fiidnimo. Iridda hore, tobanaan qof oo dibadbaxayaal ah ayaa isugu yimid roobka dhexdiisa, kuwaas oo inta badan dhaliilayay warbaahinta ka qaybgalaysay munaasabadda. Gelitaanka hoteelka ayaa lagu xaddiday martida halkaas deggen, dadka sita tikidhada cashada, dadka haysta casuumaad, ama dokumiintiyo cadeynaya inay ka tirsan yihiin munaasabadda. Ku dhawaad 2,300 oo marti ah oo ku sugnaa hoolka weyn ee dhulka hoostiisa ah ayaa maray baaritaanno dhowr ah oo adag oo ay ka mid ahaayeen in la marsiiyo aaladaha baarista biraha ee ay gacanta ku hayeen hay’adaha amniga. Muuqaal uu faafiyay Trump ayaa muujinayay eedeysanaha oo orod ku dhaafaya saraakiil amni oo u muuqday inay furfurayaan aaladaha baarista biraha. Maadaama madaxweynuhu uu fariistay hoolka, lama oggolayn in dad dheeraad ah ay soo galaan aagga la sugay, waana sababta aaladahaas loo furfurayay. Agaasimaha Secret Service-ka, Sean Curran, iyo Taliye Carroll ayaa labaduba isku raacay in nidaamkii amniga ee la qorsheeyay uu si buuxda u shaqeeyay. Balse, wariye Richard Gaisford oo Al Jazeera uga soo warramayay Washington, DC ayaa sheegay in isha lagu hayn doono bal in amnigu ahaa mid ku filan iyo in kale, isagoo intaas ku daray in maanta heli doono xog dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan ujeeddada ninkan. Isku dayadii hore ee ka dhanka ahaa Trump? Dhacdadani ma aha tii ugu horreysay ee la beegsado Madaxweyne Trump. Wuxuu horay ula kulmay dhowr isku-day khaarajin iyo hanjabaado dil ah intii uu xilka hayay iyo xilliyadii ololaha. Weerarkii ugu halista badnaa wuxuu dhacay bishii Luulyo 2024 isu-soo-bax ka dhacay Butler, Pennsylvania, markaas oo nin hubeysan uu rasaas kasoo riday saqafka kore ee dhisme u dhowaa masraxa. Dhacdadaas waxaa lagu dilay hal qof, Trump ayaa dhegta laga dhaawacay, ilaaladuna waxay toogasho ku dileen ninkii weerarka soo qaaday oo 20 jir ahaa lana oran jiray Thomas Crooks. Bilo kaddib, bishii Sebtembar, mas’uuliyiinta ayaa sheegay in nin hubeysan uu ku dhuuntay garoonka Golf-ka ee Trump ee West Palm Beach, isagoo qorsheynayay inuu dilo madaxweynaha. Eedeysanahaas, Ryan Routh, ayaa la qabtay ka hor inta uusan rasaas ridin, wuxuuna bishii Febraayo ee sanadkan ku mutaystay xukun xabsi daa’im ah. Isla bishaas Febraayo, wiil 21 jir ah oo lagu magacaabo Austin Tucker Martin ayaa isna toogasho lagu dilay kaddib markii uu qori la galay xarunta nasashada ee Mar-a-Lago ee gobolka Florida, inkastoo madaxweynuhu uusan xilligaas ku sugnayn dhismaha. Taliyaha waaxda booliska ee Washington, DC ayaa sheegay in baarayaashu ay aaminsan yihiin in eedeysanuhu uu hoteelka deggenaa maadaama uu marti ku ahaa, inkastoo aan wali la ogaan ujeeddada dhabta ah ee falkan ku riixday. Qoraallo la soo dhigay barta Facebook oo u muuqda inay la xiriiraan Allen ayaa muujinaya in bishii Diseembar 2024 loo aqoonsaday “Macallinkii Bisha” ee laanta Torrance ee xarunta C2 Education, oo ah shirkad bixisa tababarro gaar ah iyo diyaargarowga imtixaannada ardayda u socota jaamacadaha. Sidoo kale, boggiisa xiriirka xirfadleyda ee LinkedIn ayaa ninkan ku sifeeyay inuu yahay injineer farsamo iyo saynisyahan kombuyuutar, horumariye Games, iyo inuu yahay macallin dabiici ah. Diiwaannada maaliyadda ee ololaha doorashooyinka federaalka ayaa muujinaya in Allen uu 25 doolar ugu deeqay guddi taageerayay ololihii madaxweynenimo ee Kamala Harris sanadkii 2024. Dhanka kale, Madaxweyne Trump oo la hadlay suxufiyiinta ayaa meesha ka saaray in toogashadan ay xiriir la leedahay dagaalka Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ay kula jiraan Iiraan, isagoo caddeeyay in aysan jirin wax caddaynaya arrintaas, weerarkuna uusan ka hor istaagi doonin guusha dagaalkaas. Marka la eego tallaabooyinka amniga ee hoteelka, sii-hayaha xilka taliyaha booliska caasimadda, Jeffery Carroll, ayaa saxafiyiinta u sheegay Sabtidii in baarayaashu rumeysan yihiin in eedeysanaha uu deggenaa hoteelka, taasina ay tahay sida uu ugu suurtagashay inuu halkaas ku sugnaado xilliga munaasabadda. Hoteelka ayaa guud ahaan laga xiray dadweynaha laga bilaabo 2-dii duhurnimo ee Sabtida si loogu diyaar-garoobo cashada oo bilaabanaysay 8-dii fiidnimo. Iridda hore, tobanaan qof oo dibadbaxayaal ah ayaa isugu yimid roobka dhexdiisa, kuwaas oo inta badan dhaliilayay warbaahinta ka qaybgalaysay munaasabadda. Gelitaanka hoteelka ayaa lagu xaddiday martida halkaas deggen, dadka sita tikidhada cashada, dadka haysta casuumaad, ama dokumiintiyo cadeynaya inay ka tirsan yihiin munaasabadda. Ku dhawaad 2,300 oo marti ah oo ku sugnaa hoolka weyn ee dhulka hoostiisa ah ayaa maray baaritaanno dhowr ah oo adag oo ay ka mid ahaayeen in la marsiiyo aaladaha baarista biraha ee ay gacanta ku hayeen hay’adaha amniga. Muuqaal uu faafiyay Trump ayaa muujinayay eedeysanaha oo orod ku dhaafaya saraakiil amni oo u muuqday inay furfurayaan aaladaha baarista biraha. Maadaama madaxweynuhu uu fariistay hoolka, lama oggolayn in dad dheeraad ah ay soo galaan aagga la sugay, waana sababta aaladahaas loo furfurayay. Agaasimaha Secret Service-ka, Sean Curran, iyo Taliye Carroll ayaa labaduba isku raacay in nidaamkii amniga ee la qorsheeyay uu si buuxda u shaqeeyay. Balse, wariye Richard Gaisford oo Al Jazeera uga soo warramayay Washington, DC ayaa sheegay in isha lagu hayn doono bal in amnigu ahaa mid ku filan iyo in kale, isagoo intaas ku daray in maanta heli doono xog dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan ujeeddada ninkan. Isku dayadii hore ee ka dhanka ahaa Trump? Dhacdadani ma aha tii ugu horreysay ee la beegsado Madaxweyne Trump. Wuxuu horay ula kulmay dhowr isku-day khaarajin iyo hanjabaado dil ah intii uu xilka hayay iyo xilliyadii ololaha. Weerarkii ugu halista badnaa wuxuu dhacay bishii Luulyo 2024 isu-soo-bax ka dhacay Butler, Pennsylvania, markaas oo nin hubeysan uu rasaas kasoo riday saqafka kore ee dhisme u dhowaa masraxa. Dhacdadaas waxaa lagu dilay hal qof, Trump ayaa dhegta laga dhaawacay, ilaaladuna waxay toogasho ku dileen ninkii weerarka soo qaaday oo 20 jir ahaa lana oran jiray Thomas Crooks. Bilo kaddib, bishii Sebtembar, mas’uuliyiinta ayaa sheegay in nin hubeysan uu ku dhuuntay garoonka Golf-ka ee Trump ee West Palm Beach, isagoo qorsheynayay inuu dilo madaxweynaha. Eedeysanahaas, Ryan Routh, ayaa la qabtay ka hor inta uusan rasaas ridin, wuxuuna bishii Febraayo ee sanadkan ku mutaystay xukun xabsi daa’im ah. Isla bishaas Febraayo, wiil 21 jir ah oo lagu magacaabo Austin Tucker Martin ayaa isna toogasho lagu dilay kaddib markii uu qori la galay xarunta nasashada ee Mar-a-Lago ee gobolka Florida, inkastoo madaxweynuhu uusan xilligaas ku sugnayn dhismaha. items.title: Golaha Wasiirrada Israel oo go’aan ka gaaray safiirkii loo magacaabay Somaliland
items.description: Tel Aviv (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Wasiirrada Israel ayaa ansixiyay magacaabista Michael Lotem oo noqonaya safiirkii ugu horreeyay ee u qaabilsan Somaliland, kadib markii ay aqbaleen soo jeedintii Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda, Gideon Sa’ar. Sida lagu sheegay bayaan kasoo baxay dowladda Axadda maanta, Lotem oo ahaa ergeyga meertada ah ee Israel u qaabilsan arrimaha dhaqaalaha qaaradda Afrika ayaa haatan shaqadiisa u gudan doona si aan deggenaansho rasmi ah lahayn (non-resident). Hore waxa uu u soo noqday safiirka Israel u fadhiya dalalka Kenya, Azerbaijan iyo Kazakhstan. Sidoo kale, mas’uuliyiinta ayaa sheegay in magacaabistan uu hore u meel mariyay Guddiga Wasiirrada ee Magacaabista Diblomaasiyadda. Tallaabadan ayaa timid bilo uun kadib markii Israel iyo Somaliland ay yeesheen xiriir diblomaasiyadeed bishii December 2025, taas oo ka dhigtay Israel dalkii ugu horreeyay ee aqoonsada madax-bannaanida Somaliland tan iyo markii ay ku dhawaaqday inay ka go’day Soomaaliya sanadkii 1991-kii. Heshiiskaas oo la saxiixay 26-kii December ayaa dhigayay in labada dhinac ay kala furtaan safaarado, isla markaana is dhaafsadaan safiirro. Bishii Febraayo ee sanadkan, Somaliland ayaa iyaduna dhankeeda magacawday Maxamed Xaaji inuu noqdo safiirkeeda u fadhiya Israel. Intaas waxaa sii dheeraa booqasho uu Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Israel, Gideon Sa’ar ku tagay Somaliland bishii Janaayo ee sanadkan. Somaliland ayaa leh meel istiraatiiji ah oo ku taalla Gacanka Cadmeed (Gulf of Aden), waxayna muddo dheer raadinaysay aqoonsi caalami ah, iyadoo waddamo badan ay ka cabsi qabaan in arrintaasi ay ka caraysiiso Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, isla markaana ay dhiirrigeliso dhaq-dhaqaaqyada kale ee gooni-u-goosadka ah ee qaaradda Afrika. Falcelinta Soomaaliya iyo beesha caalamka Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa si adag u cambaaraysay, isla markaana gaashaanka u daruurtay aqoonsiga Israel, iyadoo ku adkaysanaysa in Somaliland ay tahay qayb kamid ah dhulkeeda. Xukuumadda Muqdisho ayaa xustay in xiriir kasta oo diblomaasiyadeed oo dowlad shisheeye ay la yeelato Somaliland uu yahay xadgudub ka dhan ah madax-bannaanideeda, iyadoo booqashadii Sa’ar ku tilmaantay “soo-galid aan oggolaansho loo haysan” (unauthorized incursion). Dhanka kale, aqoonsiga Israel ayaa waxaa cambaareeyay Midowga Afrika iyo Jaamacadda Carabta, kuwaas oo labaduba sheegay in go’aankaasi uu wax u dhimayo madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, Midowga Yurub ayaa dhaleeceeyay tallaabadan, halka dowladda Mareykanka ay xaqiijisay inay sii wadi doonto aqoonsiga madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, taas oo ay sheegeen in “uu ku jiro dhulka Somaliland.” Muhiimadda istiraatiijiyadeed ee Badda Cas Goobta ay ku taallo Somaliland ee Geeska Afrika oo kasoo horjeedda xeebaha Yemen, halkaas oo ay ka taliyaan kooxda Xuutiyiinta ayaa ka dhigaysa deegaan xambaarsan miisaan istiraatiijiyadeed oo weyn. Khubarada gobolka ayaa aaminsan in xiriirka Somaliland uu Israel siinayo marin sahlan oo ay ku gaarto Badda Cas, taas oo u sahlaysa inay bartilmaameedsato falaagada Xuutiyiinta ee dalka Yemen. Kooxdan ayaa weerarro is-daba-joog ah ku qaadayay Israel iyo maraakiibta badda intii u dhaxaysay Nofembar 2023 iyo Oktoobar 2025, kahor inta aan xabbad-joojin laga gaarin xiisadda Gaza. Dhanka kale, bishii Janaayo ee sanadkan, dowladda Somaliland ayaa si adag u beenisay warar sheegayay inay oggolaatay inay qaabiso qaxooti reer Falastiin ah oo ka yimid Gaza ama ay Israel u ogolaato inay saldhigyo milatari ka sameysato dhulkeeda si loogu beddelo aqoonsiga. Hadalkan ayaa yimid kadib markii Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya ay sheegtay in heshiiskaas qaabkaas loo dhigay. Ugu dambayn, kulankan Golaha Wasiirrada Israel ee go’aamadan lagu gaaray ayaa sidoo kale lagu ansixiyay Yahel Vilan inuu noqdo safiirka Israel u fadhiya dalka Singapore. Vilan ayaa hore u soo noqday ergeyga Israel ee dalka Kenya. The post Golaha Wasiirrada Israel oo go’aan ka gaaray safiirkii loo magacaabay Somaliland appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay baaritaanka ninka loo soo qabtay weerarka uu Trump ka badbaaday
items.description: Baareyaasha Mareykanka ayaa weli su’aalo weydiinaya ninka ay ciidamada amniga u soo qabteen toogashadii xalay ka dhacday meel u dhow Aqalka Cad, oo Madaxweyne Donald Trump iyo Kuxigeenkiisa JD Vance ay kaga qaybgelayeen munaasabad casho sharaf oo ay lahaayeen Wariyeyaasha Aqalka Cad. Warbaahinta Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in ninkan lagu hayo saldhig boolis oo ku yaala waqooyi galbeed Washington DC, laguna wado in Isniinta la horkeeno maxkamad federaal ah. Eedeysanaha ayaa magaciisa lagu sheegay Cole Tomas Allen, kaasoo la sheegay inuu yahay 31 jir ka soo jeeda Magaalada Torrance ee Gobolka California. Saraakiisha Booliska ayaa goor sii horreysay sheegay in ninkaasi loo taxaabay xabsiga, ka dib markii ay sheegeen in uu orod kaga gudbay bar kontorool, isla-markaana uu rasaas ku furay Hotel Washington Hilton, halkaas oo la sheegay inay ku sugnaayeen Madaxda Mareykanka iyo Marwada 1aad Melania Trump. Baareyaasha ayaa laga soo xigtay in weerarka uu u muuqdo mid loola dan lahaa Madaxweyne Donald Trump iyo Kaaliyeyaashiisa sare. Baareyaasha ayaa waxay sheegeen inay weli eegayaan qoraalo uu ninkaasi qoray ka hor weerarka, isla-markaana uu ku dhalleeceynayo Maamulka Madaxweyne Trump. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in weerarku uu carqaladeeyay xafladdii ka socotay hotelka, qof walbana uu ku argagaxay rasaastii ay is dhaafsadeen ninkaasi iyo ciidamadii ku sugnaa xeendaabka amniga ee hotelka. Ka dib dhacdadaasi, Madaxweyne Trump oo Axaddan wareysi siiyay Fox News ayaa sheegay in xalay uu ahaa habeen murugo leh, wuxuuna sheegay in isaga iyo Marwada Koowaadba ay badqabaan. Trump ayaa eedeysanaha ku eedeeyay in uu yahay mid uu qalbigiisu naceyb ka buuxo, isla-markaana ka been sheegay Diinta Kirishtaanka. Weerarkan ayaa soo jiitay indhaha caalamka, waxaana uu imanaya, iyadoo weli ay taagan tahay xiisadda Mareykanka iyo Iran. Warbaahinta ayaa si dhow ula socon doonto maxkamadaynta ninkaasi, isagoona Isniinta ka soo muuqan doona maxkamaddii ugu horreysay.

items.title: Somaliland oo ka qayb gashay qayb gashay kulanka Global Fund (GC8) Oo ka dhacay….
items.description: Wafti uu hoggaaminayo Agaasimaha Guud ee Wasaaradda Horumarinta Caafimaadka Somaliland, Dr. Axmed Maxamuud Jaamac, kana kooban masuuliyiin Wasaaradda Horumarinta Caafimaadka ah iyo Komishanka Xakaaynta AIDS-ka, oo ku sugan magaalada Nairobi, ayaa ka qaybgalaya Kulanka Global Fund (GC8). Kulankan waxaa diiradda lagu saarayaa soo bandhigista iyo ka doodista mudnaanta caafimaad ee Somaliland ee la xidhiidha cudurrada HIV, qaaxada (TB), iyo duumada (malaria). Wafdigu wuxuu muujinayaa sida ay Somaliland uga go’an tahay yareynta saameynta cudurradan ku leeyihiin bulshada, iyada oo la adeegsanayo qorsheyaal istaraatiiji ah, tallaabooyin ku saleysan xog, iyo xoojinta nidaamka adeegyada caafimaadka. Kulankan ayaa intii uu socday waxaa si dhow loogu gorfeeyey mudnaanta istaraatiijiga ah ee Somaliland ee la xidhiidha cudurrada HIV, qaaxada (TB), iyo duumada (malaria), iyadoo si qoto dheer loo falanqeeyey caqabadaha jira, fursadaha horumarineed, iyo sida ugu habboon ee loo waafajin karo taageerada Global Fund (GC8) baahiyaha dhabta ah ee dalka. Sidoo kale, waxaa diiradda la saaray xoojinta nidaamyada caafimaadka, horumarinta adeegyada ka hortagga iyo daaweynta, iyo kor u qaadidda wada-shaqaynta u dhaxaysa Wasaaradda Horumarinta Caafimaadka Somaliland iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah ee ay ka mid yihiin UNICEF iyo World Health Organization, si loo xaqiijiyo adeegyo caafimaad oo tayo leh, loo siman yahay, isla markaana waara. Wasaaradda Horumarinta Caafimaadka Somaliland waxay si dhow ula shaqaynaysaa hay’adaha caalamiga ah sida Global Financing Facility (GFF), Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO), UNICEF, iyo World Health Organization, si loo horumariyo tayada, helitaanka, iyo adkeysiga adeegyada caafimaadka ee dalka Somaliland.

Wasaaradda Horumarinta Caafimaadka Somaliland waxay si dhow ula shaqaynaysaa hay’adaha caalamiga ah sida Global Financing Facility (GFF), Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO), UNICEF, iyo World Health Organization, si loo horumariyo tayada, helitaanka, iyo adkeysiga adeegyada caafimaadka ee dalka Somaliland.

items.title: Xasan oo wada qorshe uu ugu guuleysanayo doorashada – Maxaa dhacay maanta?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, ahna Guddoomiyaha Urur-Siyaasadeedka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP), Dr. Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa shir guddoomiyay kulanka guddiga fulinta ee ururka. Shirka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray dardar-gelinta doorashooyinka isku sidkan ee golayaasha deegaanka iyo golayaasha wakiillada ee dowlad-goboleedyada. Madaxweynaha ayaa si gaar ah u bogaadiyay guddiga fulinta, isagoo ku ammaanay kaalinta muuqata ee ay ka qaadanayaan hirgelinta qorshayaasha ururka, kuna dhiirrigeliyay inay sii xoojiyaan dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo doorashooyinka qof iyo cod. Guddiga doorashooyinka ayaa doonaya in 28-ka bishan ay maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ka qabtaan doorashooyinka isku sidkan, iyadoo sidoo kale 13-ka bisha May ay u qorsheeyeen in deegaannada maamullada Galmudug iyo Hirshabeelle ay ka dhacaan doorashooyinka qof iyo cod ah ee dadweynuhu ugu codeynayaan wakiilladooda. Halka doorashada golaha deegaanka ee maamulka Waqooyi Bari ay qabsoomi doonto 30-ka bisha June, maadaama uu leeyahay maamul dhameystiran oo leh golihiisa wakiillada iyo xukuumad. Xisbiga JSP ee uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa ku dadaalaya sidii uu u hanan lahaa codadka ugu badan ee doorashooyinka isku sidkan ee golayaasha deegaanka iyo golayaasha wakiillada ee dowlad-goboleedyada, taasoo qorshaheeda uu bilaabay, xilli mucaaradku diidan yihiin hanaanka doorashooyinka socda. Shalay, xisbiga ayaa, si waafaqsan dastuurka iyo xeerarka JSP, guddoonka sare ee ururka u dalacsiiyay Dr. Xuseen Sheekh Maxamuud, oo ahaa ku-xigeenka xoghayaha guud, inuu si rasmi ah u noqdo xoghayaha guud ee Ururka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP). Sidoo kale, guddoonka sare ee ururka ayaa Xildhibaan Xuseen Maxamed Nuur (Dhagaweyne), oo ahaa xoghayaha arrimaha gudaha iyo siyaasadda, u dalacsiiyay inuu noqdo xoghayaha ku-xigeenka guud ee ururka. items.title: Banadir Rescue Teams Battle Mogadishu Flash Floods
items.description: The Banadir Emergency Department has launched large-scale rescue operations across Somalia’s capital after heavy seasonal rains triggered sudden flash flooding, displacing hundreds of residents and submerging major roads since early Monday. The extreme weather, part of the ongoing Gu rainy season, has overwhelmed drainage systems in low-lying districts, including Hodan and Bondhere, leaving families trapped inside collapsed homes. Emergency crews are using motorboats to evacuate vulnerable civilians as local authorities warn that rising water levels could worsen disease risks, including acute watery diarrhea, in makeshift camps. “Our teams have rescued over 250 people from rooftops and flooded buildings since dawn, and we are deploying additional pumps to clear the main supply routes,” said Mohamed Ali Barre, spokesperson for the Banadir Emergency Department, in a telephone interview. He added that shelters have been opened in three districts, though capacity remains strained. According to a senior official at the Somali Disaster Management Agency, who requested anonymity, early warning systems failed to reach many riverbank communities before the downpour intensified late Sunday. The official noted that at least seven neighborhoods remain inaccessible, and aerial assessments are underway to determine the full scale of property damage. The Gu rains, which typically last from March to June, have become increasingly unpredictable due to climate variability. Following several years of devastating drought, the region now faces the opposite extreme-flash floods that erode soil, contaminate water sources, and cut off humanitarian corridors. The Banadir region’s outdated infrastructure, much of it damaged by decades of conflict, has proven ill-equipped to absorb sudden runoff. Rescue efforts are further complicated by limited heavy machinery and fuel shortages, according to local civil society reports. The emergency department has appealed for sandbags, portable bridges, and medical supplies to prevent a secondary health crisis in flooded zones.
